rows.GRD_DESC: Service Code lookup for Service Code Exclusions in Supplier
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM   r5descriptions d, r5serviceproblemcodes, r5supplierservicecodes ssc,r5objectservicecodes
WHERE  d.des_rentity = 'SVPB' 
	AND d.des_lang = :parameter.language
	AND d.des_code = spb_code
	AND spb_org = d.des_org 
    	AND COALESCE(spb_notused, '+') = '-'
	AND ssc.sps_servicecode = spb_code 
	AND ssc.sps_servicecode_org = spb_org
	AND ssc.sps_company = :param.suppliercode 
	AND ssc.sps_company_org = :param.supplierorg
	AND osc_servicecode = spb_code 
	AND osc_servicecode_org = spb_org
	AND (osc_object = :parameter.object AND osc_object_org = :parameter.objectorg) 
	AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5supplierservicecodeexcl sse
		WHERE sse.sse_osppk = (select osp_pk from r5objectsuppliers where osp_object = :parameter.object 
								AND osp_object_org = :parameter.objectorg AND OSP_SUPPLIER = :param.suppliercode 
								AND OSP_SUPPLIER_ORG = :param.supplierorg)
		AND sse.sse_oscpk = osc_pk)
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM   r5descriptions d, r5serviceproblemcodes , r5userorganization u, r5organization, r5supplierservicecodes ssc,r5objectservicecodes
WHERE  d.des_rentity = 'SVPB'
	AND d.des_lang = :parameter.language
	AND d.des_code = spb_code
	AND spb_org = d.des_org
    	AND COALESCE(spb_notused, '+') = '-'
	AND u.uog_org = spb_org
	AND u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
	AND u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
	AND ( u.uog_common = '+' or u.uog_org = :parameter.objectorg or org_common = '+' )
	AND org_code = :parameter.objectorg
	AND ssc.sps_servicecode = spb_code
	AND ssc.sps_servicecode_org = spb_org
	AND ssc.sps_company = :param.suppliercode
	AND ssc.sps_company_org = :param.supplierorg
	AND osc_servicecode = spb_code
	AND osc_servicecode_org = spb_org
	AND (osc_object = :parameter.object AND osc_object_org = :parameter.objectorg)
	AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5supplierservicecodeexcl sse
		WHERE sse.sse_osppk = (select osp_pk from r5objectsuppliers where osp_object = :parameter.object
								AND osp_object_org = :parameter.objectorg AND OSP_SUPPLIER = :param.suppliercode
								AND OSP_SUPPLIER_ORG = :param.supplierorg)
		AND sse.sse_oscpk = osc_pk)
        AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization uo, r5tabpermissions t
	WHERE uo.uog_group = t.trp_group
	AND   t.trp_insert = '+'
	AND   t.trp_function = :parameter.function
	AND   t.trp_tab = 'SSE'
	AND   uo.uog_org = spb_org
	AND   uo.uog_user = :parameter.r5user )

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from user_tab_columns 
where table_name = 'R5ACCOUNTDETAIL' 
and column_name like 'ACD_SEGMENT%'

FROM ( SELECT c.glc_codecombinationid, c.glc_description  
FROM r5glcodecombinations c, r5invoices i 
WHERE c.glc_accounttype = 'L' 
AND c.glc_enabledflag = 'Y' 
AND c.glc_detailpostingallowedflag = 'Y' 
AND i.inv_code = :parameter.invoicecode 
AND i.inv_org = :parameter.invoiceorg 
AND i.inv_date BETWEEN  ISNULL( c.glc_startdateactive, dbo.o7gttime2( :parameter.invoiceorg ) - 1 ) 
	AND  ISNULL( c.glc_enddateactive, dbo.o7gttime2( :parameter.invoiceorg ) + 1 ) 
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'  
			FROM r5organization o, r5gl_sets_of_books b 
			WHERE o.org_bookid = b.name 
			AND b.chart_of_accounts_id = c.glc_chartofaccountsid  
			AND o.org_code = :parameter.invoiceorg )  
UNION ALL

FROM r5webservicemapping, r5functions
 WHERE wsg_function = fun_code

            AND (   (    fun_parentfunction IS NULL

   AND wsg_action IN ('ADD', 'DELETE', 'SYNC')

                                      FROM r5wspnotallowed

                                      AND COALESCE(wpa_tab, 'HDR') = COALESCE(wsg_tab,'HDR')

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5tasks,  
    (
    select tc.* , null jobsequence, '' jobcode, '' ispreplanned 
    from r5taskchecklists tc, r5tasks t
    where tc.tch_task = t.tsk_code 
    and tc.tch_taskrev = t.tsk_revision
    and t.tsk_code = :param.task 
    and t.tsk_revision = :param.revision
  union
    select tc.* , tj.tpj_seq jobsequence, tj.tpj_jobplan jobcode, 
	coalesce(t.tsk_reusable, '+') ispreplanned 
    from r5taskchecklists tc, r5taskplanjobs tj, r5tasks t
    where tc.tch_task = t.tsk_code 
    and tc.tch_taskrev = t.tsk_revision
    and tc.tch_task = tj.tpj_jobplan
    and COALESCE(t.tsk_reusable, '+') = '-'
    and tc.tch_taskrev = 
        case when :param.taskplanrstatus = 'A' 
             then (select max(tsk_revision) from r5tasks where tsk_code = tj.tpj_jobplan and tsk_revrstatus = 'A')
             else (select max(tsk_revision) from r5tasks where tsk_code = tj.tpj_jobplan) end
    and tj.tpj_task = :param.task 
    and tj.tpj_taskrev = :param.revision
    and :param.taskplanrstatus not in ('C','J','S')
  union
    select tc.* , tj.tpj_seq jobsequence, tj.tpj_jobplan jobcode, 
	coalesce(t.tsk_reusable, '+') ispreplanned 
    from r5taskchecklists tc, r5taskplanjobs tj, r5tasks t
    where tc.tch_task = t.tsk_code 
    and tc.tch_taskrev = t.tsk_revision
    and tc.tch_task = tj.tpj_jobplan
    and COALESCE(t.tsk_reusable, '+') = '+'
    and tc.tch_taskrev = (select max(tsk_revision) from r5tasks  where tsk_code = tj.tpj_jobplan and tsk_revrstatus = 'A')
    and tj.tpj_task = :param.task 
    and tj.tpj_taskrev = :param.revision
) tc 
where tc.tch_task = tsk_code
and tc.tch_taskrev = tsk_revision
and (coalesce(:param.headerjobcode, 'TCH_SHOWALLRECORDS') = 'TCH_SHOWALLRECORDS' or tsk_code = :param.headerjobcode)
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
from r5tasks, r5tabpermissions, r5userorganization,
    (
    select tc.*, null jobsequence, '' jobcode, '' ispreplanned
    from r5taskchecklists tc, r5tasks t
    where tc.tch_task = t.tsk_code
    and tc.tch_taskrev = t.tsk_revision
    and t.tsk_code = :param.task
    and t.tsk_revision = :param.revision
  union
    select tc.* , tj.tpj_seq jobsequence, tj.tpj_jobplan jobcode,
	coalesce(t.tsk_reusable, '+') ispreplanned
    from r5taskchecklists tc, r5taskplanjobs tj, r5tasks t
    where tc.tch_task = t.tsk_code
    and tc.tch_taskrev = t.tsk_revision
    and tc.tch_task = tj.tpj_jobplan
    and COALESCE(t.tsk_reusable, '+') = '-'
    and tc.tch_taskrev =
        case when :param.taskplanrstatus = 'A'
             then (select max(tsk_revision) from r5tasks where tsk_code = tj.tpj_jobplan and tsk_revrstatus = 'A')
             else (select max(tsk_revision) from r5tasks where tsk_code = tj.tpj_jobplan) end
    and tj.tpj_task = :param.task
    and tj.tpj_taskrev = :param.revision
    and :param.taskplanrstatus not in ('C','J','S')
  union
    select tc.* , tj.tpj_seq jobsequence, tj.tpj_jobplan jobcode,
	coalesce(t.tsk_reusable, '+') ispreplanned
    from r5taskchecklists tc, r5taskplanjobs tj, r5tasks t
    where tc.tch_task = t.tsk_code
    and tc.tch_taskrev = t.tsk_revision
    and tc.tch_task = tj.tpj_jobplan
    and COALESCE(t.tsk_reusable, '+') = '+'
    and tc.tch_taskrev = (select max(tsk_revision) from r5tasks  where tsk_code = tj.tpj_jobplan and tsk_revrstatus = 'A')
    and tj.tpj_task = :param.task
    and tj.tpj_taskrev = :param.revision
    and  (tch_objectclass_org is null or exists (
           select 1
           from r5organization
           where org_code = tch_objectclass_org
           and ((coalesce(org_common, '-') = '+' or org_code = :param.taskorg))))
    and  (tch_objectcategory is null or exists (
           select 1
           from r5categories
           where cat_code = tch_objectcategory
           and ((cat_class = '*' and cat_class_org = '*') or (cat_class = tch_objectclass and cat_class_org = tch_objectclass_org))))
    and  (tch_followuptask is null or exists (
           select 1
           from r5organization, r5tasks where tsk_org = org_code and tsk_code = tch_followuptask
           and ((coalesce(org_common, '-') = '+' or org_code = :param.taskorg))))
    ) tc
where tc.tch_task = tsk_code
and tc.tch_taskrev = tsk_revision
and uog_org = :param.taskorg
and uog_user = :parameter.r5user
and uog_role = :parameter.r5role
and uog_group = trp_group
and trp_select = '?'
and trp_function = :parameter.userfunction
and trp_tab = 'TCH'
and (coalesce(:param.headerjobcode, 'TCH_SHOWALLRECORDS') = 'TCH_SHOWALLRECORDS' or tsk_code = :param.headerjobcode)

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5calcevents, r5events 
 WHERE cev_event = evt_code
AND cev_rstatus <> 'T'

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5calcevents, r5events
WHERE cev_event = evt_code
AND cev_rstatus <> 'T'
AND EXISTS
 (
  SELECT 1 FROM r5permissions p, r5userorganization u
  WHERE u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
  AND u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
  AND u.uog_org=evt_org
  AND u.uog_group = p.prm_group
  AND p.prm_select = '?'
  AND p.prm_function = :parameter.userfunction
 )
 AND (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM    r5objects      a,
            r5install      i,
            r5install      i2,
	    r5events       e
WHERE  coalesce(EVT_ORG ,'@#$') = (CASE WHEN :param.org IS NULL THEN coalesce(EVT_ORG,'@#$') ELSE :param.org END)
AND    coalesce(EVT_CODE ,'@#$') LIKE (CASE WHEN :param.event IS NULL THEN coalesce(EVT_CODE,'@#$') ELSE :param.event END)
AND    coalesce(EVT_ROUTESTATUS ,'@#$') = (CASE WHEN :param.routestatus IS NULL THEN coalesce(EVT_ROUTESTATUS,'@#$') ELSE :param.routestatus END)
AND    coalesce(EVT_ROUTE ,'@#$') LIKE (CASE WHEN :param.route IS NULL THEN coalesce(EVT_ROUTE ,'@#$')ELSE :param.route END)
AND    COALESCE(COALESCE(obj_loaneddept, obj_mrc), '@#$') LIKE
       (CASE WHEN :param.dept IS NULL THEN COALESCE(COALESCE(obj_loaneddept, obj_mrc), '@#$') ELSE :param.dept END)
AND    coalesce(EVT_OBTYPE ,'@#$') = (CASE WHEN :param.obtype IS NULL THEN coalesce(EVT_OBTYPE,'@#$') ELSE :param.obtype END)
AND    coalesce(EVT_PPM ,'@#$') LIKE (CASE WHEN :param.pm IS NULL THEN coalesce(EVT_PPM ,'@#$')ELSE :param.pm END)
AND    coalesce(EVT_OBJECT ,'@#$') LIKE (CASE WHEN :param.object IS NULL THEN coalesce(EVT_OBJECT,'@#$') ELSE :param.object END)
AND    coalesce(OBJ_LOCATION ,'@#$') LIKE (CASE WHEN :param.location IS NULL THEN coalesce(OBJ_LOCATION ,'@#$')ELSE :param.location END)
AND    coalesce(OBJ_CLASS ,'@#$') LIKE (CASE WHEN :param.objclass IS NULL THEN coalesce(OBJ_CLASS ,'@#$')ELSE :param.objclass END)
AND    coalesce(OBJ_CATEGORY ,'@#$') LIKE (CASE WHEN :param.category IS NULL THEN coalesce(OBJ_CATEGORY ,'@#$')ELSE :param.category END)
AND    EVT_OBTYPE    = OBJ_OBTYPE
AND    EVT_OBJECT     = OBJ_CODE
AND    EVT_OBJECT_ORG     = OBJ_ORG 
AND    EVT_RTYPE IN ('JOB','PPM') 
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM R5EVENTPOINTS WHERE EPO_EVENT = EVT_CODE )
AND    i2.ins_code = 'DEPTSEC'
AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' FROM  r5departmentsecurity d WHERE d.dse_mrc = e.evt_mrc
               AND d.dse_user = :parameter.r5user AND d.dse_readonly = '-' ) OR UPPER( coalesce( i2.ins_desc, 'OFF' ) ) <> 'ON' )
AND    i.ins_code = 'JTAUTH'
AND (exists (select 'x' from   r5install I  where  i.ins_code = 'JTAUTH' and upper( i.ins_desc ) not in ( 'YES', '+' ) )
     or exists (select 'x'  from  r5jobtypeauth j  where  j.jta_jobtype = e.evt_jobtype and j.jta_status  = e.evt_status and j.jta_update = '+'
               and  (j.jta_group= '*' or j.jta_group in (select uog_group from   r5userorganization where  uog_user = :parameter.r5user and uog_role = :parameter.r5role )))
    or (exists (select 'x'  from   r5jobtypeauth j where  j.jta_jobtype = e.evt_jobtype and    j.jta_status  = 'ALLSTATS' and    j.jta_update = '+'
               and   (j.jta_group= '*' or j.jta_group in (select uog_group from   r5userorganization   where  uog_user = :parameter.r5user and uog_role = :parameter.r5role )))
        and not exists (select 'x' from   r5jobtypeauth j where  j.jta_jobtype = e.evt_jobtype and    j.jta_status  = e.evt_status
                        and    (j.jta_group= '*' or j.jta_group in (select uog_group  from   r5userorganization where  uog_user = :parameter.r5user and uog_role = :parameter.r5role )))))

rows.GRD_DESC: Asset List on Supplier Return Form with DEPTSEC, to bypass set param
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5objects o left outer join r5lots l on (l.lot_code = ISNULL(o.obj_lot,'*'))
WHERE o.obj_obrtype = 'A'
AND o.obj_part = :partcode
AND o.obj_part_org = :partorganization
AND ISNULL( ISNULL( o.obj_bin, :bincode ), '%' ) like ISNULL( :bincode, '%' )
AND ISNULL( ISNULL( o.obj_lot, :lotcode ), '%' ) like ISNULL( :lotcode, '%' )
AND ( ( :polinertype <> 'RE'
AND ISNULL( o.obj_order, '%' ) like ISNULL(:purchaseordercode, '%')
AND ISNULL( o.obj_order_org, '%' ) like ISNULL(:purchaseorderorganization, '%') ) OR (:polinertype = 'RE'
AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' FROM   r5translines
WHERE  trl_rtype = 'RECV'
AND trl_order = :purchaseordercode
AND  trl_order_org  = :purchaseorderorganization
AND trl_object = o.obj_code AND  trl_object_org = o.obj_org ))))
AND ( ( o.obj_rstatus in ( 'B', 'C' ) AND o.obj_store = :storecode )
 OR ( o.obj_rstatus = 'T'
  AND EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' FROM r5transtock
  WHERE  tst_object = o.obj_code
  AND tst_object_org = o.obj_org
  AND tst_store = :storecode
  AND tst_torentity  = 'EVNT'))
 OR ( o.obj_rstatus = 'I'
  AND  o.obj_parent IS NULL
  AND  o.obj_location IS NULL
  AND  :fromrentity ='EVNT'))

  AND o.obj_part_org = :partorganization
  AND ISNULL( ISNULL( o.obj_bin, :bincode ), '%' ) like ISNULL( :bincode, '%' )
  AND ISNULL( ISNULL( o.obj_lot, :lotcode ), '%' ) like ISNULL( :lotcode, '%' )
  AND ( ( :polinertype <> 'RE'
  AND ISNULL( o.obj_order, '%' ) like ISNULL(:purchaseordercode, '%')
  AND ISNULL( o.obj_order_org, '%' ) like ISNULL(:purchaseorderorganization, '%') ) OR (:polinertype = 'RE'
  AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' FROM r5translines
  WHERE  trl_rtype = 'RECV'

  AND trl_order_org  = :purchaseorderorganization
  AND  trl_object = o.obj_code AND  trl_object_org = o.obj_org ))))

rows.GRD_DESC: Asset Lookup for Active Lines of PO Receipts
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5objects o, r5repairbins r  
WHERE o.obj_part = :param.partcode
      AND o.obj_part_org = :param.partorg 
      AND dbo.o7IsAssetOnPOReceiptLine( o.obj_code, o.obj_org ) = '-'
      AND (	(:param.linetype <> 'RE'  
      			AND o.obj_rstatus = 'A'
			AND ( ( o.obj_order IS NULL ) 
				OR ( o.obj_order = :param.pocode 
					AND 	o.obj_order_org = :param.poorganization ) ) )
 		OR   (:param.linetype = 'RE'
      			AND o.obj_rstatus = 'CIR' 
      			AND o.obj_part = r.rpb_part 
      			AND o.obj_part_org = r.rpb_part_org 
      			AND r.rpb_event = :param.workodercode))
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5objects o, r5repairbins r, r5userorganization u, r5organization g
WHERE o.obj_part = :param.partcode
      AND o.obj_part_org = :param.partorg
      AND dbo.o7IsAssetOnPOReceiptLine( o.obj_code, o.obj_org ) = '-'
      AND        o.obj_org = u.uog_org
      AND        u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
      AND        u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
      AND        ( ( g.org_code = :param.partorg
      AND             ISNULL(g.org_common, '-') <> '+'
      AND             u.uog_org = :param.receiptorg )
      OR          ( g.org_code = :param.partorg
      AND          ISNULL(g.org_common,'-') = '+'
      AND          ( ISNULL(u.uog_common,'-') = '+'
      OR              u.uog_org = :param.receiptorg ) ) )
      AND (	(:param.linetype <> 'RE'
      			AND o.obj_rstatus = 'A'
			AND ( ( o.obj_order IS NULL )
				OR ( o.obj_order = :param.pocode
					AND 	o.obj_order_org = :param.poorganization ) ) )
 		OR   (:param.linetype = 'RE'
      			AND o.obj_rstatus = 'CIR'
      			AND o.obj_part = r.rpb_part
      			AND o.obj_part_org = r.rpb_part_org
      			AND r.rpb_event = :param.workodercode))

FROM r5userorganization u, r5stores s, r5objects o LEFT OUTER JOIN r5repairbins r ON (r.rpb_part = o.obj_part AND r.rpb_part_org = o.obj_part_org AND r.rpb_store = o.obj_store AND r.rpb_bin = o.obj_bin AND r.rpb_lot = ISNULL(o.obj_lot,'*') AND r.rpb_object = o.obj_code AND r.rpb_object_org = o.obj_org AND r.rpb_req = :param.requisitioncode AND r.rpb_reqline = :param.requisitionline )
WHERE o.obj_store = :param.storecode
AND       o.obj_part = :param.partcode
AND       o.obj_part_org = :param.partorganization
AND       o.obj_rstatus = 'CRR'
AND       s.str_code = o.obj_store
AND       u.uog_org = s.str_org
AND       u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND       u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND       EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' FROM r5userorganization u2 WHERE u2.uog_org = o.obj_org AND u2.uog_user = :parameter.r5user )
AND       ((r.rpb_req IS NOT NULL AND r.rpb_reqline IS NOT NULL) OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' FROM r5repairbins r2 WHERE r2.rpb_object = o.obj_code AND r2.rpb_object_org = o.obj_org ))
AND       NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' FROM r5repairbins r2 WHERE r2.rpb_object = o.obj_code AND r2.rpb_object_org = o.obj_org AND ( r2.rpb_req <> :param.requisitioncode OR r2.rpb_reqline <> :param.requisitionline ) )
AND       NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' FROM r5structures s WHERE s.stc_child = o.obj_code AND s.stc_child_org = o.obj_org AND s.stc_rolldown = '+' AND s.stc_childrtype = o.obj_obrtype AND s.stc_parentrtype <> 'L' )
AND       :param.trackbyasset = -1
UNION
SELECT <FIELDLIST_2>
FROM r5userorganization u, r5stores s, r5binstock b LEFT OUTER JOIN r5repairbins r ON (r.rpb_part = b.bis_part AND r.rpb_part_org = b.bis_part_org AND r.rpb_store = b.bis_store AND r.rpb_bin = b.bis_bin AND r.rpb_lot = b.bis_lot AND r.rpb_req = :param.requisitioncode AND r.rpb_reqline = :param.requisitionline )
WHERE b.bis_store = :param.storecode
AND        b.bis_part = :param.partcode
AND        b.bis_part_org = :param.partorganization
AND        b.bis_repairqty > 0
AND        s.str_code = b.bis_store
AND        u.uog_org = s.str_org
AND        u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND        u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND        :param.trackbyasset = 0

rows.GRD_DESC: Assigned Resources for MS Project with DEPTSEC
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
SELECT  <FIELDLIST_1>
FROM   R5ACTSCHEDULES a, r5personnel p 
WHERE  a.acs_responsible IS NOT NULL
AND    a.acs_shiftschedulesession IS NULL
AND    a.acs_responsible = p.per_code
AND    EXISTS (SELECT NULL FROM r5mpactivities ma
               WHERE a.acs_event      = ma.mpa_event 
               AND   a.acs_activity   = ma.mpa_act
               AND   ma.mpa_mpproj    = :param.mpproj)  
AND (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR 
(per_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = per_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-')))   
UNION ALL         
SELECT  <FIELDLIST_2>
FROM   R5ACTSCHEDULES a
WHERE  a.acs_object IS NOT NULL
AND    a.acs_shiftschedulesession IS NULL
AND    EXISTS (SELECT NULL FROM r5mpactivities ma
               WHERE a.acs_event      = ma.mpa_event 
               AND   a.acs_activity   = ma.mpa_act
               AND   ma.mpa_mpproj    = :param.mpproj)               
UNION  ALL                                     
SELECT  <FIELDLIST_3>
FROM   r5toolreq t, r5tools tl
WHERE  tor_tool = tl.too_code
AND    EXISTS (SELECT NULL FROM r5mpactivities ma
               WHERE t.tor_event      = ma.mpa_event 
               AND   t.tor_act        = ma.mpa_act
               AND   ma.mpa_mpproj    = :param.mpproj) 
UNION ALL    
SELECT  <FIELDLIST_4>
FROM   r5mpassignedsuppliers mas
WHERE  EXISTS (SELECT NULL FROM r5mpactivities ma
               WHERE mas.mas_event     = ma.mpa_event 
               AND   mas.mas_act       = ma.mpa_act
               AND   ma.mpa_mpproj     = :param.mpproj)
order by workorder, activity, resourcetype, resourcename,resourceorg

FROM r5descriptions d, r5functions f

(FUN_CLASS IN ('REPA','REPB','REPC','BREP')

))
AND FUN_CODE NOT IN ('BSFLOW','BSSFLW','BSTART','BSSTRT')

rows.GRD_DESC: Available screen/report Lookup for hyperlink setup
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5descriptions d, r5functions f
WHERE d.des_code = f.fun_code
AND d.des_rentity = 'FUNC'
AND d.des_lang = :parameter.language
AND ((f.fun_class = 'WEBL' AND COALESCE(:parameter.webonlyclass, 'false') = 'false' AND (f.fun_subtype = 'M' OR f.fun_subtype = 'N'))
    OR (f.fun_class = 'WEB' AND f.fun_subtype IN('M', 'N'))
    OR (f.fun_class IN ('WEBD', 'BREP') AND COALESCE(:parameter.webonlyclass, 'false') = 'false' )
    OR ( f.fun_subtype != 'X' AND f.fun_class IN ( 'REPA',  'REPB',  'REPC' )  AND COALESCE(:parameter.webonlyclass, 'false') = 'false'  ) )
AND f.fun_code NOT IN ('BSFLOW', 'BSSFLW', 'BSTART', 'BSSTRT')
AND f.fun_mekey LIKE :parameter.mekey

from r5functions
where fun_class IN( 'WEBC', 'SFUN')

from r5bins left outer join r5binstock on (bin_code = bis_bin and bin_store = bis_store )
where  bin_store = :param.storecode
and coalesce(bin_notused,'-') = '-'       
and    (coalesce(:allbins, 'false') = 'true' or  (coalesce(:allbins, 'false') = 'false' and ((coalesce(:forhelditems, 'false') = 'false' and coalesce(bin_forstock, '-') = '+') 
     or (coalesce(:forhelditems, 'false') = 'true' and coalesce(bin_forhelditems, '-') = '+'))))
and	   ((:param.dspyid = 'ALL' or :param.dspyid is null) or
	    (:param.dspyid = 'FORPART' and bis_part = :param.partcode and bis_part_org = :param.partorganization) or
	    (:param.dspyid = 'EMPTY'  and not exists (select null 
									from r5binstock s 
									where s.bis_bin = bin_code 
									and   s.bis_store = bin_store)))
AND	   (COALESCE(:nonporeceipts, 'false') = 'false' OR (COALESCE(:nonporeceipts, 'false') = 'true' AND (COALESCE(bin_forstock, '-') = '+' OR COALESCE(bin_forhelditems, '-') = '+') 
          AND COALESCE(bin_forhelditems, '-') = (CASE WHEN :param.workorder IS NOT NULL OR :param.activity IS NOT NULL THEN '+' ELSE COALESCE(bin_forhelditems, '-') END)))
@GROUPBYCLAUSE { group by bin_code, bin_desc, bin_forstock, bin_forhelditems }

    where obj_code = :param.equip
    and obj_org = :param.equiporg
    and obj_sdmpresent = '+'
    union all
    select stc_parent equip, stc_parent_org org
    from dbo.F_GETSDMINHERITEDEQUIPMENT (:param.equip, :param.equiporg)
    where not exists ( select 1 from r5objects
                       where obj_code = :param.equip

  where sdm_object = equip

        or ( sdm_supplier_check <> '+'
             and coalesce(sdm_supplier, '#') = coalesce(:param.supplier, sdm_supplier, '#')
             and coalesce(sdm_supplier_org, '#') = coalesce(:param.supplierorg, sdm_supplier_org, '#') ) )
  and ( sdm_servicecategory_check = '+'

rows.GRD_DESC: Call Center Service Category Lookup for Simplified SDM
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM   r5pscategories sc
WHERE  COALESCE( sc.psc_notused, '-' ) <> '+'
AND    EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                 FROM   r5servicecatservicecodes s
                 WHERE  s.scs_category_code    = sc.psc_code
                 AND    s.scs_category_org     = sc.psc_org
                 AND    s.scs_servicecode     = COALESCE( :param.serviceproblemcode,  s.scs_servicecode )
                 AND    s.scs_servicecode_org = COALESCE( :param.serviceproblemcodeorg,s.scs_servicecode_org ) ) 
AND    ( :param.supplier IS NULL OR
         EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                 FROM   r5supplierservicecodes sps, r5servicecatservicecodes scs
                 WHERE  scs.scs_category_code   = sc.psc_code
                 AND    scs.scs_category_org    = sc.psc_org
                 AND    sps.sps_servicecode     = scs.scs_servicecode
                 AND    sps.sps_servicecode_org = scs.scs_servicecode_org
                 AND    sps.sps_company         = :param.supplier
                 AND    sps.sps_company_org     = :param.supplierorg ) )
  AND     ( :param.equipmentcode IS NULL OR
        EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                FROM   r5servicecatservicecodes s
                WHERE  s.scs_category_code   = sc.psc_code
                AND    s.scs_category_org    = sc.psc_org
                AND  ( s.scs_servicecode+'#'+s.scs_servicecode_org) IN ( SELECT o1.osc_servicecode+'#'+o1.osc_servicecode_org
                FROM   r5objectservicecodes o1 
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objectservicecodes o3 ON ( o3.osc_pk = o1.osc_parent ),
         ( SELECT parent stc_parent, parentorg stc_parent_org, lev + 1 lev
           FROM   dbo.o7getequipchildparent( :param.equipmentcode, :param.equipmentorg )
           UNION
           SELECT :param.equipmentcode, :param.equipmentorg, 1
           FROM   dual ) tree
  WHERE  tree.stc_parent     = o1.osc_object
  AND    tree.stc_parent_org = o1.osc_object_org  
  AND    tree.lev = ( SELECT MIN( tree2.lev )
                      FROM   r5objectservicecodes o2, 
                             ( SELECT parent stc_parent, parentorg stc_parent_org, lev + 1 lev
                               FROM   dbo.o7getequipchildparent( :param.equipmentcode, :param.equipmentorg )
                               UNION
                               SELECT :param.equipmentcode, :param.equipmentorg, 1
                               FROM   dual  ) tree2
                      WHERE  tree2.stc_parent     = o2.osc_object
                      AND    tree2.stc_parent_org = o2.osc_object_org  
                      AND    o2.osc_servicecode      = o1.osc_servicecode
                      AND    o2.osc_servicecode_org  = o1.osc_servicecode_org )
    AND   (    ( tree.lev = 1 AND o1.osc_skipthislevel = '-' )
          OR ( tree.lev > 1 AND o1.osc_applytochildren = '+' ) )
  AND   NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                    FROM   r5objectsuppliers osp, r5supplierservicecodeexcl sse
                    WHERE  sse.sse_osppk     = osp.osp_pk
                    AND    sse.sse_oscpk          = o1.osc_pk
                    AND    osp.osp_supplier        = :param.supplier
                    AND    osp.osp_supplier_org    = :param.supplierorg ) ) ) )

WHERE  sc.spb_org = u.uog_org  AND    u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user  AND o.org_code = :control.org AND ( org_common = '+' OR uog_common = '+' OR sc.spb_org = o.org_code ) AND    COALESCE( sc.spb_notused, '-' ) <> '+'  AND (COALESCE(sc.spb_general,'-') = '+'
OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 from r5servicecodeequipclasses, r5objects 
   WHERE ecl_servicecode = sc.spb_code 
   AND ecl_servicecode_org = sc.spb_org  AND obj_code = :param.equipmentcode  AND obj_org = :param.equipmentorg AND ((ecl_object IS NOT NULL AND ecl_object = obj_code AND ecl_object_org = obj_org ) 
   OR (ecl_category IS NOT NULL AND ecl_category = obj_category) OR (ecl_category IS NULL AND ecl_class IS NOT NULL AND ecl_class = obj_class AND ecl_class_org = obj_class_org)))))
AND    ( :param.servicecategory IS NULL OR EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
        FROM   r5servicecatservicecodes scs
       WHERE  scs.scs_servicecode = sc.spb_code AND  scs.scs_servicecode_org = sc.spb_org
       AND scs.scs_category_code  = :param.servicecategory AND scs.scs_category_org = :param.servicecategoryorg ) )
AND    ( :param.supplier IS NULL OR
   EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
       FROM   r5supplierservicecodes sps
       WHERE  sps.sps_servicecode = sc.spb_code
       AND sps.sps_servicecode_org = sc.spb_org
       AND sps.sps_company  = :param.supplier
       AND sps.sps_company_org  = :param.supplierorg ) )
AND  ( spb_code, spb_org ) IN ( SELECT o1.osc_servicecode, o1.osc_servicecode_org
       FROM   r5objectservicecodes o1 
            LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objectservicecodes o3 ON ( o3.osc_pk = o1.osc_parent ), 
            ( WITH RECURSIVE t ( stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, level ) AS (
             SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, 1
             FROM   r5structures
             WHERE stc_child = :param.equipmentcode
             AND stc_child_org = :param.equipmentorg
             UNION
             SELECT s.stc_parent, s.stc_parent_org, s.stc_child, s.stc_child_org, t.level+1
             FROM   r5structures s 
                  JOIN t ON ( t.stc_parent = s.stc_child AND t.stc_parent_org = s.stc_child_org ) )
             SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, level + 1 lev
             FROM   t
             UNION
             SELECT :param.equipmentcode, :param.equipmentorg, 1
             FROM   dual ) tree
       WHERE  tree.stc_parent     = o1.osc_object
       AND    tree.stc_parent_org = o1.osc_object_org  
       AND    tree.lev =  ( SELECT MIN( tree2.lev )
         FROM   r5objectservicecodes o2, 
            ( WITH RECURSIVE t ( stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, level ) AS (
             SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, 1
             FROM   r5structures WHERE  stc_child = :param.equipmentcode AND stc_child_org = :param.equipmentorg
            UNION
            SELECT s.stc_parent, s.stc_parent_org, s.stc_child, s.stc_child_org, t.level+1
            FROM   r5structures s 
               JOIN t ON ( t.stc_parent = s.stc_child AND t.stc_parent_org = s.stc_child_org ) )
            SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, level + 1 lev
            FROM   t
            UNION
            SELECT :param.equipmentcode, :param.equipmentorg, 1
            FROM   dual ) tree2
      WHERE  tree2.stc_parent  = o2.osc_object AND tree2.stc_parent_org = o2.osc_object_org  AND o2.osc_servicecode  = o1.osc_servicecode AND o2.osc_servicecode_org = o1.osc_servicecode_org ) AND ( ( tree.lev = 1 AND   o1.osc_skipthislevel = '-' )
         OR ( tree.lev > 1 AND o1.osc_applytochildren = '+' ) )
       AND   NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
         FROM   r5objectsuppliers osp, r5supplierservicecodeexcl sse
         WHERE  sse.sse_osppk  = osp.osp_pk AND  sse.sse_oscpk  =  o1.osc_pk AND osp.osp_object  = o1.osc_object
         AND osp.osp_object_org  = o1.osc_object_org  AND osp.osp_supplier  = :param.supplier  AND osp.osp_supplier_org = :param.supplierorg ) )

rows.GRD_DESC: Call Center Supplier Lookup for SDM
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5companies c, 
( SELECT distinct sdm_supplier, sdm_supplier_org
  FROM r5objectsdm,
  ( SELECT obj_code equip, obj_org org
    FROM r5objects
    WHERE obj_code = :param.equip
    AND obj_org = :param.equiporg
    AND obj_sdmpresent = '+'
    union all
    SELECT stc_parent equip, stc_parent_org org
    FROM dbo.F_GETSDMINHERITEDEQUIPMENT ( :param.equip, :param.equiporg )
    WHERE not exists ( SELECT 1 FROM r5objects
                       WHERE obj_code = :param.equip
                       AND obj_org = :param.equiporg
                       AND ( obj_sdmpath = '-' or obj_sdmpresent = '+' ) ) ) derivedtable1
  WHERE sdm_object = equip
  AND sdm_object_org = org
  AND ( sdm_mrc_check = '+' or COALESCE(sdm_mrc, '#') = COALESCE(:param.mrc, sdm_mrc, '#') )
  AND ( sdm_servicecategory_check = '+'
        or ( COALESCE(sdm_servicecategory, '#') = COALESCE(:param.servicecategory, sdm_servicecategory, '#')
             AND COALESCE(sdm_servicecategory_org, '#') = COALESCE(:param.servicecategoryorg, sdm_servicecategory_org, '#') ) )
  AND ( sdm_serviceproblem_check = '+'
        or ( COALESCE(sdm_serviceproblem, '#') = COALESCE(:param.serviceproblemcode, sdm_serviceproblem, '#')
             AND COALESCE(sdm_serviceproblem_org, '#') = COALESCE(:param.serviceproblemcodeorg, sdm_serviceproblem_org, '#') ) )
  AND ( sdm_supplier is not null or sdm_supplier_check = '+' ) ) derivedtable2
WHERE c.com_code = COALESCE(sdm_supplier, c.com_code)
AND c.com_org = COALESCE(sdm_supplier_org, c.com_org)
AND COALESCE(c.com_notused, '-') <> '+'
AND   COALESCE( c.com_people, '-' ) = '+' 
AND   (c.com_code <> '*' OR c.com_org <> '*')

FROM r5companies c, 
( SELECT DISTINCT sdm_supplier, sdm_supplier_org
  FROM r5objectsdm,
  ( SELECT obj_code equip, obj_org org
    FROM r5objects
    WHERE obj_code = :param.equip
    AND obj_org = :param.equiporg
    AND obj_sdmpresent = '+'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT stc_parent equip , stc_parent_org org 
    FROM (
		WITH RECURSIVE t ( stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, obj_sdmpath, obj_sdmpresent ) AS (
		SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, obj_sdmpath, obj_sdmpresent
		FROM r5objects, r5structures
		WHERE  obj_code       = stc_parent
		AND    obj_org        = stc_parent_org
		AND    stc_child      = :param.equip
		AND    stc_child_org  = :param.equiporg
		UNION
		SELECT s.stc_parent, s.stc_parent_org, s.stc_child, s.stc_child_org, o.obj_sdmpath, o.obj_sdmpresent
		FROM   r5objects o, r5structures s 
		JOIN t ON ( t.stc_parent = s.stc_child 
				AND t.stc_parent_org = s.stc_child_org 
				AND t.obj_sdmpath = '+' 
				AND t.obj_sdmpresent = '-' ) 
		WHERE  o.obj_code = s.stc_parent
		AND    o.obj_org  = s.stc_parent_org )
		SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org
		FROM   t
		WHERE  obj_sdmpath    = '+'
		AND    obj_sdmpresent = '+'
	)
     WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5objects
                      WHERE obj_code = :param.equip
                      AND obj_org = :param.equiporg
                      AND ( obj_sdmpath = '-' OR obj_sdmpresent = '+' ) ) )
  WHERE sdm_object = equip
  AND sdm_object_org = org
  AND ( sdm_mrc_check = '+' OR COALESCE(sdm_mrc, '#') = COALESCE(:param.mrc, sdm_mrc, '#') )
  AND ( sdm_servicecategory_check = '+'
        OR ( COALESCE(sdm_servicecategory, '#') = COALESCE(:param.servicecategory, sdm_servicecategory, '#')
             AND COALESCE(sdm_servicecategory_org, '#') = COALESCE(:param.servicecategoryorg, sdm_servicecategory_org, '#') ) )
  AND ( sdm_serviceproblem_check = '+'
        OR ( COALESCE(sdm_serviceproblem, '#') = COALESCE(:param.serviceproblemcode, sdm_serviceproblem, '#')
             AND COALESCE(sdm_serviceproblem_org, '#') = COALESCE(:param.serviceproblemcodeorg, sdm_serviceproblem_org, '#') ) )
  AND ( sdm_supplier IS NOT NULL OR sdm_supplier_check = '+' ) )
WHERE c.com_code = COALESCE(sdm_supplier, c.com_code)
AND c.com_org = COALESCE(sdm_supplier_org, c.com_org)
AND COALESCE(c.com_notused, '-') <> '+'
AND   COALESCE( c.com_people, '-' ) = '+' 
AND   (c.com_code <> '*' OR c.com_org <> '*')

rows.GRD_DESC: Call Center Supplier Lookup for Simplified SDM
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM   r5companies c
WHERE  COALESCE( c.com_notused, '-' ) <> '+'
AND    COALESCE( c.com_people, '-' ) = '+' 
AND    NOT ( c.com_code = '*' AND c.com_org = '*' )
AND    ( :param.serviceproblemcode IS NULL OR
         EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                 FROM   r5supplierservicecodes s
                 WHERE  s.sps_company         = c.com_code
                 AND    s.sps_company_org     = c.com_org
                 AND    s.sps_servicecode     = :param.serviceproblemcode
                 AND    s.sps_servicecode_org = :param.serviceproblemcodeorg ) )
AND  ( com_code+'#'+com_org ) IN 
( SELECT o1.osp_supplier+'#'+o1.osp_supplier_org
  FROM   r5objectsuppliers o1 
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objectsuppliers o3 ON ( o3.osp_pk = o1.osp_parent ), 
         ( SELECT parent stc_parent, parentorg stc_parent_org, lev + 1 lev
           FROM   dbo.o7getequipchildparent( :param.equipmentcode, :param.equipmentorg )
           UNION
           SELECT :param.equipmentcode, :param.equipmentorg, 1
           FROM   dual ) tree
  WHERE  tree.stc_parent     = o1.osp_object
  AND    tree.stc_parent_org = o1.osp_object_org  
  AND    tree.lev = ( SELECT MIN( tree2.lev )
                      FROM   r5objectsuppliers o2, 
                             ( SELECT parent stc_parent, parentorg stc_parent_org, lev + 1 lev
                               FROM   dbo.o7getequipchildparent( :param.equipmentcode, :param.equipmentorg )
                               UNION
                               SELECT :param.equipmentcode, :param.equipmentorg, 1
                               FROM   dual  ) tree2
                      WHERE  tree2.stc_parent     = o2.osp_object
                      AND    tree2.stc_parent_org = o2.osp_object_org  
                      AND    o2.osp_supplier      = o1.osp_supplier
                      AND    o2.osp_supplier_org  = o1.osp_supplier_org )
  AND   (    ( tree.lev = 1 AND o1.osp_skipthislevel = '-' )
          OR ( tree.lev > 1 AND o1.osp_applytochildren = '+' ) )
  AND   NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                    FROM   r5objectservicecodes osc, r5supplierservicecodeexcl sse
                    WHERE  sse.sse_osppk           = o1.osp_pk
                    AND    sse.sse_oscpk           = osc.osc_pk
                    AND    osc.osc_servicecode     = :param.serviceproblemcode
                    AND    osc.osc_servicecode_org = :param.serviceproblemcodeorg ) )

                  FROM   dual ) tree2
         WHERE  tree2.stc_parent     = o2.osp_object

         AND    o2.osp_supplier      = o1.osp_supplier

FROM r5organization o, r5userorganization u, r5companies c

AND    u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND    o.org_code = :control.org

                 AND    s.sps_company_org     = c.com_org
                 AND    s.sps_servicecode     = :param.serviceproblemcode
                 AND    s.sps_servicecode_org = :param.serviceproblemcodeorg ) )
AND  ( com_code, com_org ) IN 
     ( SELECT o1.osp_supplier, o1.osp_supplier_org
       FROM   r5objectsuppliers o1 
              LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objectsuppliers o3 ON ( o3.osp_pk = o1.osp_parent ), 
              ( WITH RECURSIVE t ( stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, level ) AS (
                  SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, 1
                  FROM   r5structures
                  WHERE  stc_child = :param.equipmentcode
                  AND    stc_child_org = :param.equipmentorg
                  UNION
                  SELECT s.stc_parent, s.stc_parent_org, s.stc_child, s.stc_child_org, t.level+1
                  FROM   r5structures s 
                         JOIN t ON ( t.stc_parent = s.stc_child AND t.stc_parent_org = s.stc_child_org ) )
                SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, level + 1 lev
                FROM   t
                UNION
                SELECT :param.equipmentcode, :param.equipmentorg, 1
                FROM   dual ) tree
       WHERE  tree.stc_parent     = o1.osp_object
       AND    tree.stc_parent_org = o1.osp_object_org  
       AND    tree.lev = 
       ( SELECT MIN( tree2.lev )
         FROM   r5objectsuppliers o2, 
                ( WITH RECURSIVE t ( stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, level ) AS (
                    SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, 1
                    FROM   r5structures
                    WHERE  stc_child = :param.equipmentcode
                    AND    stc_child_org = :param.equipmentorg
                    UNION
                    SELECT s.stc_parent, s.stc_parent_org, s.stc_child, s.stc_child_org, t.level+1
                    FROM   r5structures s 
                           JOIN t ON ( t.stc_parent = s.stc_child AND t.stc_parent_org = s.stc_child_org ) )
                  SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, level + 1 lev
                  FROM   t
                  UNION
                  SELECT :param.equipmentcode, :param.equipmentorg, 1
                  FROM   dual ) tree2
         WHERE  tree2.stc_parent     = o2.osp_object
         AND    tree2.stc_parent_org = o2.osp_object_org  
         AND    o2.osp_supplier      = o1.osp_supplier
         AND    o2.osp_supplier_org  = o1.osp_supplier_org )
              AND   (    ( tree.lev = 1 AND o1.osp_skipthislevel = '-')
               OR ( tree.lev > 1 AND o1.osp_applytochildren = '+' ) )
       AND   NOT EXISTS
				( SELECT 'x'
				 FROM   r5objectservicecodes osc, r5supplierservicecodeexcl sse
				 WHERE  sse.sse_osppk           = o1.osp_pk
				 AND    sse.sse_oscpk           = osc.osc_pk

from r5causes 
where (cau_gen = '+' or 
exists 
( 
	select null from r5causeclasses 
	where cac_cause = cau_code 
	and 
	(
	  cac_class = :param.objclass 
	  or

		(
			select obj_class from r5objects 
			where   obj_code=:param.objcode 
				and  obj_org =ISNULL(:param.objorg,obj_org) 
				and obj_class = ISNULL(:param.objclass,obj_class) 
		)
	)
	and 
	(
	  cac_class_org = :param.objclassorg 
	  or 
	  cac_class_org in 
		(
			select obj_class_org from r5objects 
				where	obj_code=:param.objcode 
					and  obj_org = ISNULL(:param.objorg,obj_org) 
					and  obj_class_org = ISNULL(:param.objclassorg,obj_class_org) 
		)
	)
)) and coalesce(cau_notused, '-') <> '+' and coalesce(cau_partfailure, '-') <> '+'

rows.GRD_DESC: Check atleast one child WO is Closed
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM  r5events e
WHERE e.evt_jobtype='MEC'
AND EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM  r5events p
   WHERE e.evt_parent = p.evt_code
   AND p.evt_rstatus = 'R'
   AND p.evt_rtype IN ('JOB','PPM')
   AND ( ISNULL(e.evt_updated,e.evt_created) > :parameter.lastupdated
      OR ISNULL(p.evt_updated,p.evt_created) > :parameter.lastupdated)
   AND
   (
      (  ISNULL(:parameter.womrc,'N') <> 'Y'
         AND
         (  EXISTS
            (  SELECT 1
               FROM r5personnel
               WHERE per_user = :parameter.r5user
               AND p.evt_person = per_code
            )
            OR EXISTS
            (  SELECT 1
               FROM r5actschedules, r5personnel
               WHERE acs_event = p.evt_code
               AND per_user = :parameter.r5user
               AND acs_responsible = per_code
            )
         )
      )
      OR
      (  ISNULL(:parameter.womrc,'N') = 'Y'
         AND (p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc1 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc2 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc3 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc4 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc5 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc6 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc7 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc8 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc9 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc10)
      )
   )
   AND EXISTS
   (  SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes
      WHERE uco_rentity = 'JBTP'
      AND uco_code = p.evt_jobtype
      AND uco_rcode IN ('*','BR','ST','PM','CAL','RP')
   )
)

       FROM r5requircodes

              cau_notused rqm_notused,

              cau_group rqm_group
       FROM r5causes
       UNION
       SELECT fal_code rqm_code,
              fal_desc rqm_desc,
              fal_gen rqm_gen,
              fal_partfailure rqm_partfailure,
              fal_notused rqm_notused,
              'F' mod_name,

              fal_group rqm_group
       FROM r5failures
	   UNION
       SELECT sym_code rqm_code,
              sym_desc rqm_desc,

              sym_notused rqm_notused,

rows.GRD_DESC: Code lookup on SalesPrices of ContractTemplate
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5userorganization u, r5descriptions
  LEFT OUTER JOIN r5parts ON des_code = par_code
                         AND des_org = par_org
  LEFT OUTER JOIN r5tasks ON des_code = tsk_code
                         AND des_org = tsk_org
  LEFT OUTER JOIN r5serviceproblemcodes ON des_code = spb_code
                                       AND des_org = spb_org
  LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ppms ON des_code = ppm_code
                        AND des_org = ppm_org
  LEFT OUTER JOIN r5standworks ON des_code = stw_code
                              AND des_org = stw_org
 WHERE  des_lang = :parameter.language
   AND des_rentity = :parameter.rentity
   AND des_org = u.uog_org
   AND u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
   AND u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
   AND 'A' = (CASE WHEN des_rentity = 'TASK' then tsk_revrstatus  WHEN des_rentity = 'PPM' then ppm_revrstatus ELSE 'A' END)
   AND '-' = (CASE WHEN des_rentity = 'TASK' then COALESCE(tsk_isolationmethod, '-') ELSE '-' END)
   AND '-' = (CASE WHEN des_rentity = 'PART' then COALESCE(par_notused, '-')
                     WHEN des_rentity = 'TASK' then COALESCE(tsk_notused, '-')
                     WHEN des_rentity = 'PPM'  then COALESCE(ppm_notused, '-')
                     WHEN des_rentity = 'SVPB'  then COALESCE(spb_notused, '-')
                     WHEN des_rentity = 'STWO'  then COALESCE(stw_notused, '-')
                     ELSE '-' END)
   AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1
                  FROM r5userorganization u1
                 WHERE u1.uog_org = :control.org
                   AND u1.uog_common = '+') OR
        (u.uog_common = '+' or u.uog_org = :control.org))

rows.GRD_DESC: Condition code on Issue Return Screen
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM   r5descriptions, r5partctplconditions, r5parts p 
WHERE  p.par_conditiontpl = ptc_template
AND    p.par_conditiontpl_org  = ptc_template_org
AND    p.par_condition = ptc_condition
AND    exists ( SELECT 1 from  r5parts p2 
                WHERE  p2.par_code = :parameter.partcode 
                AND    p2.par_org  = :parameter.partorganization
                AND    ptc_template = p2.par_conditiontpl
                AND    ptc_template_org = p2.par_conditiontpl_org 
                AND    p2.par_org = p.par_org
                AND (  p.par_parentpart = p2.par_code OR p2.par_parentpart = p.par_parentpart ))
AND     exists (SELECT 1 FROM r5stock 
			WHERE sto_part = par_code 
			AND sto_part_org = par_org 
			AND (sto_store = :parameter.store OR :parameter.store IS NULL))
AND    des_code = ptc_template + '#' + ptc_condition
AND    des_org = ptc_template_org
AND    des_lang = :parameter.language
AND    des_rentity = 'CPCT'
AND    COALESCE(ptc_preventissue,'-') <> '+'
AND    ptc_condition <> '*'

rows.GRD_DESC: Condition lookup for kit template for parts
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5parts p
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5parts op WHERE op.par_code = :parameter.partcode AND op.par_org = :parameter.partorg
AND COALESCE(op.par_parentpart, :parameter.partcode) = p.par_parentpart AND op.par_org = p.par_org)
AND ( p.par_condition <> '*' OR :parameter.excludestar = 'false' )
FROM r5conditions WHERE 1=1

from r5pointconditions a, r5points b,r5conditions c
	   		where (
				(
			 	   ( :param.objectrtype IN ('A','P','S') AND 
					poc_object = (select obj_category FROM r5objects A  
							where A.obj_code = :param.objectcode 
							and   A.obj_org = :param.organization )
					 AND 
					( poc_point + ' '+ poc_pointtype + ' ' + poc_condition ) NOT IN 
					( SELECT p1.poc_point + ' ' + p1.poc_pointtype + ' ' + p1.poc_condition
					   FROM r5pointconditions p1
					   WHERE p1.poc_object = :param.objectcode  
					   AND p1.poc_object_org =:param.organization
					) 
				  )
					 or 
			 		( a.poc_object=:param.objectcode  and a.poc_object_org =:param.organization )
				)
		  and a.poc_object = b.poi_object	
		  and a.poc_object_org = b.poi_object_org
		  and a.poc_obtype=b.poi_obtype
		  and a.poc_point=b.poi_point
		  and a.poc_pointtype=b.poi_pointtype
		  and c.cnd_code = a.poc_condition
	  )

AND ( ptc_condition <> :parameter.condition OR COALESCE(:parameter.excludecondition, 'false') = 'false' )

FROM (SELECT  d.des_code costtype,
       d.des_text costtype_display,
       dbo.o7pjcost_estimatedcost(prj_code, uco_rcode) estimated,
       dbo.o7pjcost_remcost(prj_code, uco_rcode) onorder,
       dbo.o7pjcost_actcost(prj_code, uco_rcode) actual,
       dbo.o7pjcost_pidcost(prj_code, uco_rcode) invoicediff,
       dbo.o7pjcost_totcost(prj_code, uco_rcode) totalcost,
       dbo.o7pjcost_opencost(prj_code, uco_rcode) freebudget,
       dbo.o7pjcost_pnocost(prj_code, uco_rcode) planned
  FROM r5projects, r5descriptions d, r5ucodes
 WHERE prj_code = :param.projectcode
   AND d.des_lang = :parameter.language
   AND d.des_rentity = 'UCOD'
   AND d.des_rtype = 'CSTP'
   AND des_code = uco_code
   AND uco_rentity = 'CSTP'
   AND uco_rcode not in ('S', '*')
  UNION
  SELECT '7', bt.bot_text costtype_display,
       SUM(dbo.o7pjcost_estimatedcost(prj_code, uco_rcode)) estimated,
       SUM(dbo.o7pjcost_remcost(prj_code, uco_rcode)) onorder,
       SUM(dbo.o7pjcost_actcost(prj_code, uco_rcode)) actual,
       SUM(dbo.o7pjcost_pidcost(prj_code, uco_rcode)) invoicediff,
       SUM(dbo.o7pjcost_totcost(prj_code, uco_rcode)) totalcost,
       SUM(dbo.o7pjcost_opencost(prj_code, uco_rcode)) freebudget,
       SUM(dbo.o7pjcost_pnocost(prj_code, uco_rcode)) planned
  FROM r5projects, r5descriptions d, r5ucodes,
       (SELECT bot_text 
        FROM r5boilertexts 
        WHERE bot_function = 'JSPROJ' 
        AND bot_fld1 = 'CST_TOTALS' 
        AND bot_lang = :parameter.language) bt
 WHERE prj_code = :param.projectcode
   AND d.des_lang = :parameter.language
   AND d.des_rentity = 'UCOD'
   AND d.des_rtype = 'CSTP'
   AND des_code = uco_code
   AND uco_rentity = 'CSTP'
   AND uco_rcode not in ('S', '*') 
   GROUP BY bt.bot_text ) pc 
WHERE 1 = 1

      SELECT act_event, act_act, act_parent, act_topparent, act_hire, act_defermaintenance, act_note, act_seq, act_supplier, act_supplier_org, act_start, act_trade, case when (select tsk_reusable from r5tasks where tsk_code = act_task and tsk_revision = act_taskrev) =  '+' then act_task else null end act_task, act_taskrev, act_ordrtype, act_ordtype, act_order, act_relatedwo

     LEFT OUTER JOIN r5activities p ON a.act_parent = p.act_act AND a.act_event = p.act_event  
    LEFT OUTER JOIN r5tasks t ON coalesce(a.act_task,p.act_task) = t.tsk_code AND coalesce(a.act_taskrev, p.act_taskrev) = t.tsk_revision

FROM R5GLPROCESSDEF WHERE 1=1

from (
select
cast(XTH_SEQNUM as nvarchar) SEQNUM,
XTH_TRANTYPE TRANSTYPE,
XTH_CREATE TIMESTAMP,
case xth_trantype
  when 'POSTJOURNAL' then case isnull(XTH_MESSAGE,'#@!%$') when '#@!%$' then 'DONE' else 'ERROR' end 
  else  'DONE'
end STATUS
from R5XMLTRANSTATUSHIST
UNION ALL
select
cast(XTS_SEQNUM as nvarchar) SEQNUM,
XTS_TRANTYPE TRANSTYPE,
XTS_CREATE TIMESTAMP,
case isnull(XTS_MESSAGE,'#@!%$') 
when '#@!%$' then 'PENDING' 
else case substring(XTS_MESSAGE,1,4) when 'Info' then 'PENDING' else 'ERROR' end
end STATUS
from R5XMLTRANSTATUS
) a

FROM r5boilertexts, r5defaultpagelayout
 WHERE bot_lang = :parameter.language

FROM R5ECSESSIONDETAILS
WHERE csd_session = :param.sessionid

FROM   r5orders o, r5organization g, r5orderlines ol, r5events e2, r5activities a, r5translines l, r5events e, r5transactions t
WHERE  l.trl_object IS NULL
AND l.trl_io = 0
AND ( ( COALESCE( l.trl_routerec, '-' ) <> '+' AND :param.whichparts = 'ALL')  OR ( :param.whichparts = 'DEFERRED' AND l.trl_origqty IS NULL ) )
AND l.trl_event = e.evt_code
AND l.trl_trans = t.tra_code
AND l.trl_order = o.ord_code
AND l.trl_order_org = o.ord_org
AND l.trl_order = ol.orl_order
AND l.trl_order_org = ol.orl_order_org
AND l.trl_ordline = ol.orl_ordline
AND t.tra_rstatus = 'A'
AND e.evt_org = g.org_code
AND e2.evt_code = :param.pworkorder
AND l.trl_event = a.act_event
AND l.trl_act = a.act_act 
AND a.act_parent IS NULL 
AND l.trl_rtype IN ( 'RECV', 'RETN' )
AND ( e.evt_rstatus = 'R' OR 
       ( e.evt_rstatus = 'C'
  AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( g.org_code ), 'DD') <= 
      dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( e.evt_completed + CAST( COALESCE( ( SELECT ins_desc FROM r5install WHERE ins_code = 'RTNDAYS' ), '0' ) AS INT ), 'DD' )
  AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( e.evt_completed, 'DD' ) > 
      dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( ( SELECT COALESCE( MAX( c.clp_closed ), CAST( '01-01-1900' AS DATETIME ) ) FROM r5closedperiods c ), 'DD' ) ) )
AND NOT( l.trl_event = :param.pworkorder AND l.trl_act = :param.pactivity )
AND e.evt_org = :param.porganization
AND ( :param.whichparts = 'ALL' OR 
      ( ( ( act_deferredorigwo = :param.porigdefworkorder AND act_deferredorigact = :param.porigdefactivity ) OR
          ( e.evt_routeparent = :param.porigdefworkorder AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x' FROM r5activities a2 WHERE a2.act_event = e2.evt_code
            AND a2.act_relatedwo = a.act_event AND a2.act_act = a.act_act AND a2.act_parent IS NULL  ) ) OR
          ( act_event = :param.porigdefworkorder AND act_act = :param.porigdefactivity ) ) 
        AND  e.evt_object = e2.evt_object 
        AND  e.evt_object_org = e2.evt_object_org ) )
GROUP BY e.evt_code, e.evt_org, e.evt_rstatus, l.trl_act, l.trl_part, l.trl_part_org, COALESCE( l.trl_lot, '*' ),
       l.trl_order,l.trl_order_org, o.ord_code, o.ord_org, o.ord_status, o.ord_store, o.ord_date, o.ord_supplier, 
       o.ord_supplier_org, l.trl_ordline, ol.orl_status, ol.orl_due, ol.orl_ordqty, ol.orl_price, ol.orl_event, l.trl_lot,
       a.act_deferredorigwo, a.act_deferredorigact, e2.evt_multiequip
HAVING SUM( COALESCE( l.trl_origqty, l.trl_qty ) * CASE trl_rtype WHEN 'RECV' THEN 1 WHEN 'RETN' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END ) > 0

LEFT OUTER JOIN r5contactinfo on ctr_contactinfoid = cti_code AND COALESCE(cti_notused, '-') <> '+'
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5casemanagement on ctr_case = csm_code
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5serviceproblemcodes on ctr_serviceproblem = spb_code and ctr_serviceproblem_org = spb_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events e on ctr_event = e.evt_code and ctr_event_org = e.evt_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events e1 on ctr_followupevent = e1.evt_code and ctr_event_org = e1.evt_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5equipmentusabilities ON ctr_eqpusability=eub_eqpusability AND ctr_eqpusabilityorg=eub_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects ON ctr_object = obj_code AND ctr_object_org = obj_org AND COALESCE(ctr_multiequip, '-') = '-'
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5permissions, r5userorganization
WHERE uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND uog_org = ctr_org
AND uog_group = prm_group AND prm_select = '?' AND prm_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND (uog_org = :control.org OR uog_common = '+'   ) )
AND CTR_RSTATUS NOT IN ('C','CL')
AND ctr_object = :parameter.object
AND ctr_object_org = :parameter.objectorg
AND ctr_serviceproblem = :parameter.servicecode
AND ctr_serviceproblem_org = :parameter.servicecodeorg
AND ctr_duplicaterequest is null
AND NOT (ctr_code = COALESCE( :parameter.servicerequest, 'x' ) AND ctr_org = COALESCE( :control.org, 'x' ) )

rows.GRD_DESC: EAM Mobile WO List with Address for Windows 8
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM  r5events e
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5personnel ON per_code=evt_person
JOIN R5OBJECTS o ON
    e.evt_object = o.obj_code
    AND e.evt_object_org = o.obj_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address m ON
    m.adr_rentity='OBJ'
    AND m.adr_rtype='M'
    AND CHARINDEX('#', m.adr_code)>0
    AND SUBSTRING(m.adr_code,1,CHARINDEX('#', m.adr_code)-1)=e.evt_object
    AND SUBSTRING(m.adr_code,CHARINDEX('#', m.adr_code)+1, 15)=e.evt_object_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address d ON
    d.adr_rentity='OBJ'
    AND d.adr_rtype='D'
    AND CHARINDEX('#', d.adr_code)>0
    AND SUBSTRING(d.adr_code,1,CHARINDEX('#', d.adr_code)-1)=e.evt_object
    AND SUBSTRING(d.adr_code,CHARINDEX('#', d.adr_code)+1, 15)=e.evt_object_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address i ON
    i.adr_rentity='OBJ'
    AND i.adr_rtype='I'
    AND CHARINDEX('#', i.adr_code)>0
    AND SUBSTRING(i.adr_code,1,CHARINDEX('#', i.adr_code)-1)=e.evt_object
    AND SUBSTRING(i.adr_code,CHARINDEX('#', i.adr_code)+1, 15)=e.evt_object_org
WHERE evt_rstatus IN ('Q','R')
AND evt_rtype IN ('JOB','PPM')
AND EXISTS
(  SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes
   WHERE uco_rentity = 'JBTP'
   AND uco_code = evt_jobtype
   AND uco_rcode IN ('*','BR','ST','PM','CAL','RP')
)
    AND ( (:parameter.deptsec = 'OFF')
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user = :parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization
            WHERE uog_org = o.obj_org
            AND uog_user = :parameter.r5user
            AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role)
AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r5objects a
JOIN dbo.O7GETEQUIPCHILDRENS(:parameter.systemcode, :parameter.systemorg) c ON
a.obj_code = c.child AND a.obj_org = c.childorg
WHERE o.obj_code = a.obj_code AND o.obj_org = a.obj_org)
OR (o.obj_code = :parameter.systemcode
    AND o.obj_org = :parameter.systemorg))
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_EDB:
FROM  r5events e
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5personnel ON per_code=evt_person
JOIN R5OBJECTS o ON
    e.evt_object = o.obj_code
    AND e.evt_object_org = o.obj_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address m ON 
    m.adr_rentity='OBJ' AND m.adr_rtype='M'
	AND m.adr_code like e.evt_object || '%'
	AND SUBSTR(m.adr_code,1,INSTR(m.adr_code,'#')-1)=e.evt_object
	AND SUBSTR(m.adr_code,INSTR(m.adr_code,'#')+1)=e.evt_object_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address d ON
    d.adr_rentity='OBJ' AND d.adr_rtype='D'
	AND d.adr_code like e.evt_object || '%'
	AND SUBSTR(d.adr_code,1,INSTR(d.adr_code,'#')-1)=e.evt_object
	AND SUBSTR(d.adr_code,INSTR(d.adr_code,'#')+1)=e.evt_object_org    
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5address i ON
    i.adr_rentity='OBJ' AND i.adr_rtype='M'
	AND i.adr_code like e.evt_object || '%'
	AND SUBSTR(i.adr_code,1,INSTR(i.adr_code,'#')-1)=e.evt_object
	AND SUBSTR(i.adr_code,INSTR(i.adr_code,'#')+1)=e.evt_object_org    
WHERE evt_rstatus IN ('Q','R')
AND evt_rtype IN ('JOB','PPM')
AND EXISTS
(  SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes
   WHERE uco_rentity = 'JBTP'
   AND uco_code = evt_jobtype
   AND uco_rcode IN ('*','BR','ST','PM','CAL','RP')
)
    AND ( (:parameter.deptsec = 'OFF')  
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user = :parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization
            WHERE uog_org = evt_org 
            AND uog_user     = :parameter.r5user)
AND   ( o.obj_code, o.obj_org ) IN
      ( WITH RECURSIVE t ( stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org ) AS (
          SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org
          FROM   r5structures
          WHERE  stc_parent = :parameter.systemcode
          AND    stc_parent_org = :parameter.systemorg
          UNION
          SELECT s.stc_parent, s.stc_parent_org, s.stc_child, s.stc_child_org
          FROM   r5structures s 
                 JOIN t ON ( s.stc_parent = t.stc_child AND s.stc_parent_org = t.stc_child_org ) )
        SELECT stc_child, stc_child_org
        FROM   t
        UNION
        SELECT :parameter.systemcode, :parameter.systemorg
        FROM   dual )

rows.GRD_DESC: Employee Lookup with Qualification check with DEPTSEC, to bypass set param
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5personnel p
where COALESCE(p.per_notused, '-') = '-'
and per_code <> '*'
AND COALESCE(p.per_tradesperson, '-') = '+'
and   (:parameter.per_type is null
or exists ( select pet_person
            from r5pertypes
            where per_code = pet_person and pet_type = :parameter.per_type) )
and not exists (SELECT 'x'
                FROM   R5ACTQUALIFICATIONS
                WHERE  AQU_EVENT    = :parameter.wonum
                AND    AQU_ACTIVITY = :parameter.woact
                AND    AQU_QUALIFICATION NOT IN
       ( SELECT pq.pqu_qualification
         FROM   R5PERSONNELQUALIFICATIONS pq
         WHERE  AQU_QUALIFICATION = pq.pqu_qualification
         AND    pq.pqu_person = p.per_code
         AND    ISNULL(pq.pqu_tempdisqualified, '-') = '-'
         AND    ISNULL(:parameter.sched, dbo.o7gttime2(N'' )) <= COALESCE (pq.pqu_expiration, :parameter.sched, dbo.o7gttime2(N'' ))
         AND    dbo.f_trunc_date(pq.pqu_QUALIFICATIONSTART , N'DD') <=  ISNULL(:parameter.sched, dbo.o7gttime2(N'' ))))
AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR
(per_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = per_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))
AND (COALESCE(CAST(:param.sessionid AS VARCHAR(18)),'false') = 'false' OR per_code IN (SELECT wlo_person FROM r5wolaborschedemp WHERE wlo_sessionid = :param.sessionid and COALESCE(wlo_related, '-') = '-'))

	  		   		( select

			  				case 
								 when ( upper(ins_desc) in ('YES', 'Y', 'TRUE', '+','ON' ))  then 1 
								 else 0

						  ) ins_desc_value
						 from r5install where ins_code = 'CALSTD'

where par_calstandard = '+' 
and par_notused = '-' 
and par_code = obj_part 
and par_org = obj_part_org 
and obj_notused = '-'

FROM r5mrcs m ,r5organization org, r5objects o  LEFT OUTER JOIN 
(SELECT  crt_object,crt_object_org,crt_code,crt_desc ,crt_org,crt_status,crt_rstatus,crt_customer,crt_issuedate,crt_returndate,crt_class,crt_class_org,  crt_estimatedissuedate, crt_estimatedreturndate, dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'UCOD', crt_status,'RNST', null) as contractstatusdesc FROM  r5customerrentals WHERE crt_rstatus IN ('U','I') OR :parameter.customerrentalcode = crt_code UNION ALL

cc.cct_org as  crt_org,cc.cct_status as crt_status,cc.cct_rstatus as  crt_rstatus ,cc.cct_customer as  crt_customer,cc.cct_startdate as  crt_issuedate,cc.cct_enddate as  crt_returndate,cc.cct_class as  crt_class ,cc.cct_class_org as crt_class_org,CAST(NULL AS DATE) as crt_estimatedissuedate, CAST(NULL 
AS DATE) as crt_estimatedreturndate, dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language, 'UCOD', cc.cct_status, 'CCST', null) as contractstatusdesc FROM  (SELECT * FROM r5contractitems , r5customercontracts

AND (:parameter.customerrentalcode = crt_code OR (
		obj_vehicletype IS NULL OR COALESCE(:parameter.vehicletype, COALESCE(obj_vehicletype, '#')) = COALESCE(obj_vehicletype, '#') 
	))
AND (obj_location IS NULL OR COALESCE(:parameter.location, COALESCE(obj_location, '#')) = COALESCE(obj_location, '#') AND COALESCE(:parameter.locationorg, COALESCE(obj_location_org, '#')) = COALESCE(obj_location_org, '#'))
AND 1 = 
    CASE WHEN 
         (:parameter.estimatedissuedate IS NULL OR :parameter.estimatedreturndate IS NULL OR crt_estimatedissuedate IS NULL OR crt_estimatedreturndate IS NULL OR :parameter.customerrentalcode = crt_code OR (crt_rstatus NOT IN ('U','I'))) 
    THEN 
        1 
    ELSE 
	CASE WHEN crt_estimatedissuedate >= :parameter.estimatedreturndate OR crt_estimatedreturndate <= :parameter.estimatedissuedate THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
    END
AND (o.obj_org=:parameter.rentalorg OR org.org_common='+')  
AND (o.obj_customer IS NOT NULL AND ( ( COALESCE(:parameter.rencustomer,'-')='-' ) AND (( ('-'=(SELECT org_common FROM r5organization WHERE org_code=o.obj_customer_org)) AND o.obj_customer_org=:parameter.rentalorg )
		OR o.obj_customer_org IN (SELECT org_code FROM r5organization WHERE org_code=o.obj_customer_org AND org_common='+'))) 
		OR  (( COALESCE(:parameter.rencustomer,'-')=:parameter.rencustomer ) AND o.obj_customer=:parameter.rencustomer) 
	OR o.obj_customer IS NULL)
AND  (:param.bypassdeptsecurity  = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec = 'OFF' OR
        (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = 
(CASE WHEN :param.loantodept = 'true' THEN COALESCE(o.obj_loaneddept, o.obj_mrc) ELSE o.obj_mrc END)  
 AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))

AND CASE WHEN o.obj_rstatus = 'B' THEN 'C' ELSE o.obj_rstatus END = CASE WHEN o.obj_store IS NULL THEN 'I' ELSE 'C' END
AND  NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x' FROM   r5structures WHERE stc_child = o.obj_code AND stc_child_org = o.obj_org AND stc_parentrtype = :param.parentrtype )
AND ( :parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR
o.obj_mrc IN ( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = o.obj_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))
and (:parameter.storesec = 'OFF' OR o.obj_rstatus = 'I' 
      or exists( select 1 from r5storesecurity
                 where ssc_group = :parameter.r5usergroup
                 and ssc_store = obj_store
                 and coalesce( ssc_issuereturn,'-' ) = '+' ) )
AND  (((coalesce( :param.child, '#' ) = '#' AND coalesce( :param.childorg, '#' ) = '#')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM r5structures WHERE stc_parent=:param.parent AND stc_parent_org=:param.parentorg AND stc_parentrtype = 'P' AND stc_childrtype='A' AND stc_childrtype=o.obj_obrtype

        OR o.obj_part IN (SELECT par_code 
                          FROM   r5parts 
                          WHERE  par_trackbycondition = '+'
                          AND    par_parentpart       = (SELECT par_parentpart 
                                                         FROM   r5parts

                                                         AND    par_org  = :param.partorg )))

AND    coalesce( o.obj_category, 'x' ) = coalesce( :param.category, 'x' )

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG: from (select o1.obj_code,o1.obj_org from  (select distinct obj_code as equip_code, obj_org as equip_org, obj_mrc from r5objects where not exists (select distinct ppo_object from r5ppmobjects, r5ppms where r5objects.obj_code = r5ppmobjects.ppo_object and r5objects.obj_org = r5ppmobjects.ppo_object_org and ppo_ppm = ppm_code and ppm_plan is not null) AND obj_obrtype IN ( 'A', 'S', 'P','L')) EquipmentList Inner Join (select obj_obtype, obj_desc, obj_org, obj_code, obj_obrtype from r5objects, r5ppmplan, r5userorganization where (COALESCE(r5objects.obj_class, '#') = COALESCE(r5ppmplan.pmp_objectclass, r5objects.obj_class, '#') AND COALESCE(r5objects.obj_class_org, '#') = COALESCE(r5ppmplan.pmp_objectclass_org,r5objects.obj_class_org, '#') )  and  r5ppmplan.pmp_code = :param.pmplan and coalesce(r5objects.obj_notused,'-') <> '+' and (r5objects.obj_rstatus = 'B' OR r5objects.obj_rstatus = 'C' OR r5objects.obj_rstatus = 'CIR' OR r5objects.obj_rstatus = 'CRR'  OR r5objects.obj_rstatus = 'I') and r5objects.obj_code <> '*'  and r5objects.obj_org =  r5userorganization.uog_org and r5userorganization.uog_user = :parameter.r5user and uog_role = :parameter.r5role and (r5userorganization.uog_common = '+' or r5userorganization.uog_org = :param.organization)) o1 ON EquipmentList.equip_code = o1.obj_code and EquipmentList.equip_org = o1.obj_org  AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR (obj_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = obj_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))) e1, r5mrcs m, r5objects o where o.obj_mrc = m.mrc_code and e1.obj_code = o.obj_code and e1.obj_org = o.obj_org

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
SELECT <FIELDLIST_1> 
FROM   r5ddfield t1 , 
       dbo.o7getddfields( ( SELECT RTRIM( LTRIM(CAST( substring( ( UPPER(grd_basequery ) ), CHARINDEX( 'FROM', ( UPPER( grd_basequery ) ) )+4,CHARINDEX( 'WHERE', ( UPPER( grd_basequery ) ) )-6 ) as varchar ) ) ) FROM r5grid WHERE grd_gridid = :param.gridid ) ) 
WHERE  ddf_fieldid = fieldid 
<FILTER_1> 
GROUP BY t1.ddf_sourcename,t1.ddf_tablename 
UNION 
SELECT <FIELDLIST_2>
FROM   user_tab_columns WHERE  table_name <> 'R5SESSIONS'
<FILTER_2> 
UNION
SELECT <FIELDLIST_3> 
FROM   r5userfunctiondefs WHERE 1=1
<FILTER_3>
<SORT_BY>
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_EDB:
SELECT <FIELDLIST_1> 
from r5ddfield t1 
where regexp_instr(o7splitin.o7quetrunc(to_char(:param.gridid),to_char(1),t1.ddf_tablename),'[,]+'||upper(t1.ddf_tablename)||'[,]+')<>0
and  ( instr( t1.ddf_sourcename, '.' ) = 0 or 
       regexp_INSTR(upper(t1.ddf_sourcename),o7splitin.o7quetrunc(to_char(:param.gridid),to_char(2),t1.ddf_tablename))>0 )
<FILTER_1> 
group by t1.ddf_sourcename,t1.ddf_tablename

from r5depots dp, r5fuels f left outer join r5descriptions d
on ( d.des_code = f.fue_code 
 and d.des_rentity = 'FUEL' 
 and d.des_lang = :parameter.language )
where f.fue_notused = '-'
and dp.dep_code + '#' + dp.dep_org = CASE
         WHEN (:param.depot IS NOT NULL AND :param.depotorg IS NOT NULL) THEN
          :param.depot + '#' + :param.depotorg
         ELSE
          coalesce(:param.defaultdepot + '#' + :param.defaultdepotorg,
                   (select MRC_DEPOT + '#' + MRC_DEPOT_ORG
                      from r5mrcs, r5objects
                     where mrc_code = obj_mrc
                       and obj_code = :param.objectcode
                       AND OBJ_ORG = :param.objectorg))
       END
and ( 
  case when f.fue_blended = '+' then 0 else 1 end +
  case when f.fue_blendfuel1 is null then 0 else 1 end +
  case when f.fue_blendfuel2 is null then 0 else 1 end +
  case when f.fue_blendfuel3 is null then 0 else 1 end +
  case when f.fue_blendfuel4 is null then 0 else 1 end +
  case when f.fue_blendfuel5 is null then 0 else 1 end =
  ( select count(distinct t.tan_fuel)
    from r5tanks t, r5tankpumps p
    where p.tpu_depot = t.tan_depot
    and p.tpu_depot_org = t.tan_depot_org
    and p.tpu_tank = t.tan_code
    and p.tpu_active = '+'
    and t.tan_fuel in( f.fue_code, f.fue_blendfuel1, f.fue_blendfuel2, 
                       f.fue_blendfuel3, f.fue_blendfuel4, f.fue_blendfuel5 )
    and p.tpu_depot + '#' + p.tpu_depot_org = CASE
                        WHEN (:param.depot IS NOT NULL AND
                             :param.depotorg IS NOT NULL) THEN
                         :param.depot + '#' + :param.depotorg
                        ELSE
                         coalesce(:param.defaultdepot + '#' +
                                  :param.defaultdepotorg,
                                  (select MRC_DEPOT + '#' + MRC_DEPOT_ORG
                                     from r5mrcs, r5objects
                                    where mrc_code = obj_mrc
                                      and obj_code = :param.objectcode
                                      AND OBJ_ORG = :param.objectorg))
                      END) or dp.dep_external = '+')

FROM
(
SELECT 'OSGEQUIP' as GridName, -1 as DataSpyID, 'BEGEQ' as FunctionName, 'Equipment' as Description, 1 as ListOrder
UNION
SELECT 'OSGWO' as GridName, 1522 as DataSpyID, 'BEGEQC' as FunctionName, 'Equipment and cost details' as Description, 2 as ListOrder
UNION
SELECT 'OSGWO' as GridName, 1521 as DataSpyID, 'BEGEQE' as FunctionName, 'Equipment and event details' as Description, 3 as ListOrder
UNION
SELECT 'OSGWOACT' as GridName, -1 as DataSpyID, 'BEGWAC' as FunctionName, 'Work order and activity details' as Description, 4 as ListOrder
UNION
SELECT 'OSGWO' as GridName, 1504 as DataSpyID, 'BEGWEQ' as FunctionName, 'Work order and equipment details' as Description, 5 as ListOrder
UNION
SELECT grd_gridname as GridName, -1 as DataSpyId, fun_code as FunctionName, grd_desc, 6 as ListOrder
FROM r5grid LEFT OUTER JOIN r5functions ON SUBSTRING(grd_gridname, 1, CASE CHARINDEX( '_', grd_gridname ) WHEN 0 THEN LEN( grd_gridname ) ELSE CHARINDEX( '_', grd_gridname ) -1 END ) = fun_code
WHERE grd_gridtype in (2,8) AND grd_gridname NOT LIKE 'LV%' AND (grd_complex = '-' OR grd_gridname='WSJOBS') AND COALESCE( grd_gisdatafilter, '-' ) = '+' AND COALESCE( grd_active, '-' ) = '+'
) as Grids, r5permissions WHERE prm_function = functionname AND prm_select = '?' AND prm_group IN (SELECT DISTINCT uog_group FROM r5userorganization WHERE uog_user = :parameter.r5user AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role)
