from r5auth a, r5descriptions d, r5entities e
where ( a.aut_user = :parameter.r5user or a.aut_group in (select uog_group from r5userorganization where uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role and uog_org = :parameter.r5organization) and a.aut_user = '*')
and   ( a.aut_status = '*' or a.aut_status = '-' )
and     a.aut_rentity = 'EVNT'
and     a.aut_type = '+'
and     a.aut_statnew <> '-'
and     not exists ( select * from r5auth x where  x.aut_group in (select uog_group from r5userorganization where uog_user = :parameter.r5user and uog_role = :parameter.r5role and uog_org = :parameter.r5organization) and x.aut_user = :parameter.r5user and ( x.aut_status = '*' or x.aut_status = '-' ) and x.aut_rentity = 'EVNT' and x.aut_type = '-' )
and     d.des_rentity = 'UCOD'
and     e.ent_rentity = 'EVNT'
and     e.ent_statent = d.des_rtype
and     d.des_code = a.aut_statnew
and     d.des_lang = :parameter.language
and     not exists (select null from r5ucodes where  uco_rentity = d.des_rtype and uco_code = des_code and uco_rcode in ( '*','A','B','C' ))
union
select  '-', dd.des_text
from    r5descriptions dd, r5entities ee
where   dd.des_lang = :parameter.language
and     dd.des_rentity = 'UCOD'
and     ee.ent_rentity = 'EVNT'
and     ee.ent_statent = dd.des_rtype
and     dd.des_code = '-'
order by 1 ASC
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
from r5auth a, r5descriptions d, r5entities e
where ( a.aut_user = :parameter.r5user or a.aut_group in (select uog_group from r5userorganization where uog_user = :parameter.r5user and uog_role = :parameter.r5role and uog_org = :parameter.r5organization) and a.aut_user = '*')
and   ( a.aut_status = '*' or a.aut_status = '-' )
and     a.aut_rentity = 'EVNT'
and     a.aut_type = '+'
and     a.aut_statnew <> '-'
and     not exists ( select * from r5auth x where  x.aut_group in (select uog_group from r5userorganization where uog_user = :parameter.r5user and uog_role = :parameter.r5role and uog_org = :parameter.r5organization) and x.aut_user = :parameter.r5user and ( x.aut_status = '*' or x.aut_status = '-' ) and x.aut_rentity = 'EVNT' and x.aut_type = '-' )
and     d.des_rentity = 'UCOD'
and     e.ent_rentity = 'EVNT'
and     e.ent_statent = d.des_rtype
and     d.des_code = a.aut_statnew
and     d.des_lang = :parameter.language
and     not exists (select null from r5ucodes where  uco_rentity = d.des_rtype and uco_code = des_code and uco_rcode in ( '*','A','B','C' ))
union
select  '-', dd.des_text
from    r5descriptions dd, r5entities ee
where   dd.des_lang = :parameter.language
and     dd.des_rentity = 'UCOD'
and     ee.ent_rentity = 'EVNT'
and     ee.ent_statent = dd.des_rtype
and     dd.des_code = '-'
order by 1 ASC

rows.GRD_DESC: GIS Client lookup on Class codes
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY: from r5classes LEFT OUTER JOIN r5descriptions ON ( des_code = cls_code and des_org = cls_org and des_rentity = 'CLAS' and des_rtype = :parameter.rentity and des_lang = :parameter.language ) where cls_rentity = :parameter.rentity and isnull(cls_notused, '-') <> '+'
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG: from r5userorganization, r5classes LEFT OUTER JOIN r5descriptions ON ( des_code = cls_code and des_org = cls_org and des_rentity = 'CLAS' and des_rtype = :parameter.rentity and des_lang = :parameter.language ) where cls_rentity = :parameter.rentity  and cls_org = uog_org and uog_user = :parameter.r5user and uog_role = :parameter.r5role and ( uog_org = :control.org OR uog_org ='*' OR ( uog_common = '+' and  cls_code <> '*'  ) ) and isnull(cls_notused, '-') <> '+'

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from   r5descriptions d inner join r5costcodes c on (c.cst_code = d.des_code)
where  d.des_rentity = 'CSTC' 
and    ISNULL( c.cst_notused, '-' ) = '-' 
and    d.des_lang = :parameter.language
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG: from  r5costcodes c, r5userorganization u, r5descriptions d where  d.des_rentity = 'CSTC' and d.des_lang = :parameter.language and c.cst_code = d.des_code and ISNULL( c.cst_notused, '-' ) = '-' and  c.cst_org = u.uog_org and u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user and u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role and  ( u.uog_common = '+' or u.uog_org = :control.org)

rows.GRD_DESC: GIS Client lookup on Department codes
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from  r5mrcs m inner join r5descriptions d on (m.mrc_code = d.des_code) 
where d.des_rentity = 'MRC' 
and   d.des_lang = :parameter.language
and coalesce(mrc_notused, '-') <> '+'
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
from  r5mrcs m inner join r5descriptions d on (m.mrc_code = d.des_code)
      inner join r5userorganization u on (m.mrc_org = u.uog_org)
where d.des_rentity = 'MRC'
and   d.des_lang = :parameter.language
and   u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
and   u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
and ( u.uog_common = '+' or u.uog_org = :control.org )
and coalesce(mrc_notused, '-') <> '+'

rows.GRD_DESC: GIS Client lookup on Job Priority codes
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5descriptions d 
where d.des_rtype = 'JBPR' and d.des_rentity = 'UCOD' 
and d.des_lang = :parameter.language

rows.GRD_DESC: GIS Client lookup on Location codes
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from  r5descriptions d inner join r5objects o on (d.des_code = o.obj_code) 
where d.des_rentity = 'OBJ' 
and   d.des_rtype ='L' 
and   d.des_lang = :parameter.language 
and   d.des_code <> '*'
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
from  r5descriptions d inner join r5objects o on (d.des_code = o.obj_code and d.des_org = o.obj_org)
      inner join r5userorganization u on (d.des_org = u.uog_org)
where d.des_rentity = 'OBJ'
and   d.des_code <> '*'
and   d.des_rtype ='L'
and   d.des_lang = :parameter.language
and   u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
and   u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
and ( u.uog_common = '+' or u.uog_org = :control.org)

rows.GRD_DESC: GIS Client lookup on Organization codes (no common)
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY: from r5descriptions d, r5functions f, R5organization o, r5permissions p RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5userorganization u ON (  p.prm_group = u.uog_group and  p.prm_function = :parameter.userfunction )where o.org_code=d.des_code and  d.des_code = u.uog_org and u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user and u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role and d.des_rentity = 'ORG' and f.fun_code = :parameter.userfunction and d.des_lang = :parameter.language and CASE WHEN p.prm_function is null THEN f.fun_insert ELSE p.prm_insert END = '+' and ( :parameter.mos = '-' or uog_common = '-' ) and ( p.prm_function is not null or f.fun_public = '!' )

rows.GRD_DESC: GIS Client lookup on Personnel codes
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from   r5personnel p 
where  ISNULL(p.per_notused, '-') = '-'  
  and  per_code <> '*' 
  AND COALESCE(p.per_tradesperson, '-') = '+'
  and (:parameter.per_type is null 
   or  exists ( select pet_person 
                  from r5pertypes 
                 where per_code = pet_person 
                   and pet_type = :parameter.per_type ))
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
from   r5userorganization u inner join r5personnel p on (p.per_org = u.uog_org)
where  ISNULL(p.per_notused, '-') = '-'
and    p.per_code <> '*'
AND COALESCE(p.per_tradesperson, '-') = '+'
and    u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
and    u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
and  ( u.uog_common = '+' or u.uog_org = :control.org )
and  ( :parameter.per_type is null
 or    exists ( select pet_person from r5pertypes where p.per_code = pet_person and pet_type = :parameter.per_type))

rows.GRD_DESC: GIS Client lookup on Problem codes
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY: from  r5descriptions d where  d.des_rentity = 'RECO' and d.des_lang = :parameter.language and d.des_code in ( select rqm_code from   r5requircodes r  where  r.rqm_gen = '+' or exists ( select null from  r5reqclasses r where  r.rcl_reqm = d.des_code and    r.rcl_class = :param.objclass and   r.rcl_class_org= :param.objclassorg ) and  coalesce(rqm_notused, '-') <> '+' and coalesce(rqm_partfailure, '-') <> '+' )

rows.GRD_DESC: GIS Client lookup on Work order type codes
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5descriptions d ,
r5userorganization o,
r5ucodes u
WHERE d.des_rentity = 'UCOD'
AND d.des_rtype = 'JBTP'
AND o.uog_org = :control.organization
AND o.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND o.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND d.des_lang = :parameter.language
AND d.des_code = u.uco_code
AND u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'
AND u.uco_rcode IN ('*','BR','PM','ST')
AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' from r5jobtypeauth j
WHERE j.jta_jobtype = d.des_code
AND j.jta_insert = '+'
AND ( j.jta_group = o.uog_group
OR j.jta_group = '*' ))
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
FROM r5install i
WHERE i.ins_code = 'JTAUTH'
AND UPPER( i.ins_desc ) NOT IN ( 'YES', '+' ) ) )

rows.GRD_DESC: GIS Data Filter Grid for Work Order and related equipment details
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5events e LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ppms ON evt_ppm = ppm_code
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5activities a ON evt_code = act_event
INNER JOIN r5objects o ON evt_object = obj_code
INNER JOIN r5organization ON org_code = evt_org
WHERE  exists ( SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes u WHERE u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'  and u.uco_code=e.evt_jobtype AND u.uco_rcode IN ( '*', 'BR', 'ST', 'PM','MEC', 'CAL' ,'RP') ) 
AND e.evt_rstatus IN ('Q', 'R', 'C') 
AND e.evt_rtype IN ('JOB', 'PPM') 
AND (a.act_act=(select min(b.act_act) 
from r5activities b where b.act_event=a.act_event) or a.act_act is null) 
AND ((:integratedonly = '+' AND obj_gisobjid > 0) OR (:integratedonly IS NULL OR :integratedonly <> '+'))
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5events e LEFT OUTER JOIN r5ppms ON evt_ppm = ppm_code
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5activities a ON evt_code = act_event
INNER JOIN r5objects o ON evt_object = obj_code
INNER JOIN r5organization ON org_code = evt_org
WHERE  exists ( SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes u WHERE u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'  and u.uco_code=e.evt_jobtype AND u.uco_rcode IN ( '*', 'BR', 'ST', 'PM','MEC', 'CAL' ,'RP') )
AND e.evt_rstatus IN ('Q', 'R', 'C')
AND e.evt_rtype IN ('JOB', 'PPM')
AND (a.act_act=(select min(b.act_act) from r5activities b where b.act_event=a.act_event) or a.act_act is null)
AND exists (SELECT 1 FROM r5permissions, r5userorganization WHERE uog_user = :parameter.r5user AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role  AND uog_group = prm_group AND prm_select = '?' AND prm_function = :parameter.userfunction AND UOG_ORG=e.evt_org) AND ((:integratedonly = '+' AND obj_gisobjid > 0) OR (:integratedonly IS NULL OR :integratedonly <> '+'))

rows.GRD_DESC: GIS Data Filter WO Activity Details
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5events e left outer join r5ppms on (evt_ppm = ppm_code)
left outer join r5activities a on (evt_code = act_event) 
INNER JOIN r5objects o ON evt_object = obj_code
WHERE  EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes u WHERE u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'  and u.uco_code=e.evt_jobtype AND u.uco_rcode IN ( '*', 'BR', 'ST', 'PM','MEC', 'CAL' ,'RP') ) 
AND e.evt_rstatus IN ('Q', 'R', 'C') 
AND e.evt_rtype IN ('JOB', 'PPM') 
AND (act_task is null or act_taskrev = (select max(t.tsk_revision) from r5tasks t where t.tsk_code = act_task)) 
AND ((:integratedonly = '+' AND obj_gisobjid > 0) OR (:integratedonly IS NULL OR :integratedonly <> '+'))
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5events e left outer join r5ppms on (evt_ppm = ppm_code)
left outer join r5activities a on (evt_code = act_event)
INNER JOIN r5objects o ON evt_object = obj_code
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes u WHERE u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'  and u.uco_code=e.evt_jobtype AND u.uco_rcode IN ( '*', 'BR', 'ST', 'PM','MEC', 'CAL' ,'RP') )
AND e.evt_rstatus IN ('Q', 'R', 'C')
AND e.evt_rtype IN ('JOB', 'PPM')
AND (act_task is null or act_taskrev = (select max(t.tsk_revision) from r5tasks t where t.tsk_code = act_task))
AND exists (SELECT 1 FROM r5permissions, r5userorganization WHERE uog_user = :parameter.r5user AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role  AND uog_group = prm_group AND prm_select = '?' AND prm_function = :parameter.userfunction AND UOG_ORG=e.evt_org)
AND ((:integratedonly = '+' AND obj_gisobjid > 0) OR (:integratedonly IS NULL OR :integratedonly <> '+'))

rows.GRD_DESC: GIS Data Filter Work Order Costs
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5obhist, r5userorganization u, r5tabpermissions t, r5objects o
WHERE oh_rtype IN ( 'JOB', 'PPM' )
AND   oh_object = obj_code
AND   oh_object_org = obj_org
AND   u.uog_org = obj_org
AND   u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND   u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND   t.trp_group = u.uog_group
AND   t.trp_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND   t.trp_tab = 'CST'
AND   t.trp_select = '?'
AND (CASE WHEN :parameter.equipmentto is null THEN -1 ELSE cast(coalesce(evt_frompoint, :parameter.equipmentfrom) as numeric) END)<=
(CASE WHEN :parameter.equipmentto is null THEN -1 ELSE cast (:parameter.topoint as numeric) END)
AND (CASE WHEN :parameter.equipmentto is null THEN -1 ELSE cast(coalesce(evt_topoint, :parameter.equipmentto) as numeric) END)>=
(CASE WHEN :parameter.equipmentto is null THEN -1 ELSE cast(:parameter.frompoint as numeric) END)
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5obhist, r5userorganization u, r5tabpermissions t, r5objects o
WHERE oh_rtype IN ( 'JOB', 'PPM' )
AND   oh_object = obj_code
AND   oh_object_org = obj_org
AND   o.org_code = oh_event_org
AND   u.uog_org = obj_org
AND   u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND   u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND   t.trp_group = u.uog_group
AND   t.trp_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND   t.trp_tab = 'CST'
AND   t.trp_select = '?'
AND (CASE WHEN :parameter.equipmentto is null THEN -1 ELSE cast(coalesce(evt_frompoint, :parameter.equipmentfrom) as numeric) END)
<=(CASE WHEN :parameter.equipmentto is null THEN -1 ELSE cast(:parameter.topoint as numeric) END)
AND (CASE WHEN :parameter.equipmentto is null THEN -1 ELSE cast(coalesce(evt_topoint, :parameter.equipmentto) as numeric) END)>=
(CASE WHEN :parameter.equipmentto is null THEN -1 ELSE cast(:parameter.frompoint as numeric) END)

AND e.evt_rstatus IN ('Q', 'R', 'C') 
AND e.evt_rtype IN ('JOB', 'PPM') 
AND (a.act_act=(select min(b.act_act) 
from r5activities b where b.act_event=a.act_event) or a.act_act is null)
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5eventslrfdetails, r5objects o, r5events e left outer join r5ppms on (evt_ppm = ppm_code)
left outer join r5activities a on (e.evt_code = a.act_event)
WHERE e.evt_code = eld_code
AND evt_object = obj_code
and exists ( SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes u WHERE u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'  and u.uco_code=e.evt_jobtype AND u.uco_rcode IN ( '*', 'BR', 'ST', 'PM', 'MEC', 'CAL' ,'RP') )
AND e.evt_rstatus IN ('Q', 'R', 'C')
AND e.evt_rtype IN ('JOB', 'PPM')
AND (a.act_act=(select min(b.act_act) from r5activities b where b.act_event=a.act_event) or a.act_act is null)
AND exists (SELECT 1 FROM r5permissions, r5userorganization WHERE uog_user = :parameter.r5user AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role  AND uog_group = prm_group AND prm_select = '?' AND prm_function = :parameter.userfunction AND UOG_ORG=e.evt_org)

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5gisdatamaps INNER JOIN  
	(SELECT CODE = CASE BOT_FLD1 WHEN 'COPY' THEN 'C' 
								  WHEN 'MOVE' THEN 'M' 
								  WHEN 'BOTH' THEN 'B' 
								  WHEN 'GIS' THEN 'G' 
								  WHEN 'DATASTREAM7I' THEN 'D' 
					END, BOT_TEXT GMP_SOURCELABEL 
	FROM r5boilertexts 
	WHERE bot_function = 'OSGGMP' 
		and bot_lang = :parameter.language) S_CODES 
	ON GMP_SOURCE = S_CODES.CODE 
	INNER JOIN  (SELECT CODE = CASE BOT_FLD1 WHEN 'COPY' THEN 'C' 
										        WHEN 'MOVE' THEN 'M' 
										        WHEN 'BOTH' THEN 'B' 
										        WHEN 'GIS' THEN 'G' 
										        WHEN 'DATASTREAM7I' 
									THEN 'D' END, BOT_TEXT GMP_ACTIONLABEL 
				FROM r5boilertexts 
				WHERE bot_function = 'OSGGMP' 
				and bot_lang = :parameter.language) A_CODES ON GMP_ACTION = A_CODES.CODE 
				LEFT OUTER JOIN 
			(SELECT   DISTINCT   p.apr_property, d.des_text GMP_ASSETATTRIBUTELABEL, 1 as FIELD_TYPE 
			FROM r5addproperties p, r5descriptions d 
			WHERE p.apr_rentity = 'OBJ' 
			AND d.des_lang = :parameter.language 
			AND d.des_code = p.apr_property 
			AND d.des_rentity = 'PROM' 
		UNION SELECT CAST(bot_number as varchar) apr_property, bot_text GMP_ASSETATTRIBUTELABEL, 0 as FIELD_TYPE
				 FROM r5boilertexts 
			WHERE bot_function = 'OSGFLD' 
			AND bot_lang = :parameter.language 
			AND bot_number <> -33 
			AND bot_number <> 1 
		UNION 
			SELECT CAST(bot_number as varchar) apr_property, bot_text GMP_ASSETATTRIBUTELABEL, 2 as FIELD_TYPE
			 FROM r5boilertexts 
			WHERE bot_function = 'OSGFLD' 
			AND bot_lang = :parameter.language 
			AND bot_number = -33 
	     UNION
			  SELECT CAST(gfd_fieldid as varchar) apr_property, 
					 bot_text GMP_ASSETATTRIBUTELABEL, 
					 3 as FIELD_TYPE 
			  FROM r5boilertexts, 
				    r5gridfield, 
				    r5gisdatamaps 
			  WHERE bot_function              = gmp_gridlookupname 
			  AND       gmp_type                   = 'WO' 
			  AND       gmp_layername       = :parameter.layername 
			  AND       gmp_assetattribute = gfd_fieldid 
			  AND       bot_lang                     = :parameter.language 
			  AND       bot_function              = gfd_botfunction 
			  AND       bot_number              = gfd_botnumber 
) OSGFLD  ON GMP_ASSETATTRIBUTE = APR_PROPERTY 
							LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CODE = CASE BOT_FLD1 WHEN 'COPY' THEN 'C' 
																		WHEN 'MOVE' THEN 'M' 
																		WHEN 'BOTH' THEN 'B' 
																		WHEN 'GIS' THEN 'G' 
																		WHEN 'DATASTREAM7I' THEN 'D' END, 
													BOT_TEXT GMP_OWNERLABEL 
							FROM r5boilertexts 
							WHERE bot_function = 'OSGGMP' 
							and bot_lang = :parameter.language) O_CODES ON GMP_OWNER = O_CODES.CODE 
							WHERE GMP_LAYERNAME = :parameter.layername
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5gisdatamaps INNER JOIN  
	(SELECT CODE = CASE BOT_FLD1 WHEN 'COPY' THEN 'C' 
								  WHEN 'MOVE' THEN 'M' 
								  WHEN 'BOTH' THEN 'B' 
								  WHEN 'GIS' THEN 'G' 
								  WHEN 'DATASTREAM7I' THEN 'D' 
					END, BOT_TEXT GMP_SOURCELABEL 
	FROM r5boilertexts 
	WHERE bot_function = 'OSGGMP' 
		and bot_lang = :parameter.language) S_CODES 
	ON GMP_SOURCE = S_CODES.CODE 
	INNER JOIN  (SELECT CODE = CASE BOT_FLD1 WHEN 'COPY' THEN 'C' 
										        WHEN 'MOVE' THEN 'M' 
										        WHEN 'BOTH' THEN 'B' 
										        WHEN 'GIS' THEN 'G' 
										        WHEN 'DATASTREAM7I' 
									THEN 'D' END, BOT_TEXT GMP_ACTIONLABEL 
				FROM r5boilertexts 
				WHERE bot_function = 'OSGGMP' 
				and bot_lang = :parameter.language) A_CODES ON GMP_ACTION = A_CODES.CODE 
				LEFT OUTER JOIN 
			(SELECT   DISTINCT   p.apr_property, d.des_text GMP_ASSETATTRIBUTELABEL, 1 as FIELD_TYPE 
			FROM r5addproperties p, r5descriptions d 
			WHERE p.apr_rentity = 'OBJ' 
			AND d.des_lang = :parameter.language 
			AND d.des_code = p.apr_property 
			AND d.des_rentity = 'PROM' 
		UNION SELECT CAST(bot_number as varchar) apr_property, bot_text GMP_ASSETATTRIBUTELABEL, 0 as FIELD_TYPE
				 FROM r5boilertexts 
			WHERE bot_function = 'OSGFLD' 
			AND bot_lang = :parameter.language 
			AND bot_number <> -33 
			AND bot_number <> 1 
		UNION 
			SELECT CAST(bot_number as varchar) apr_property, bot_text GMP_ASSETATTRIBUTELABEL, 2 as FIELD_TYPE
			 FROM r5boilertexts 
			WHERE bot_function = 'OSGFLD' 
			AND bot_lang = :parameter.language 
			AND bot_number = -33 
 		UNION
			  SELECT CAST(gfd_fieldid as varchar) apr_property, 
					 bot_text GMP_ASSETATTRIBUTELABEL, 
					 3 as FIELD_TYPE 
			  FROM r5boilertexts, 
				    r5gridfield, 
				    r5gisdatamaps 
			  WHERE bot_function              = gmp_gridlookupname 
			  AND       gmp_type                   = 'WO' 
			  AND       gmp_layername       = :parameter.layername 
			  AND       gmp_assetattribute = gfd_fieldid 
			  AND       bot_lang                     = :parameter.language 
			  AND      bot_function               = gfd_botfunction 
			  AND      bot_number               = gfd_botnumber 
) OSGFLD  ON GMP_ASSETATTRIBUTE = APR_PROPERTY 
							LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CODE = CASE BOT_FLD1 WHEN 'COPY' THEN 'C' 
																		WHEN 'MOVE' THEN 'M' 
																		WHEN 'BOTH' THEN 'B' 
																		WHEN 'GIS' THEN 'G' 
																		WHEN 'DATASTREAM7I' THEN 'D' END, 
													BOT_TEXT GMP_OWNERLABEL 
							FROM r5boilertexts 
							WHERE bot_function = 'OSGGMP'

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5objects o, r5events e LEFT OUTER JOIN r5activities a ON (e.evt_code = a.act_event)
WHERE e.evt_object = o.obj_code and e.evt_object_org = o.obj_org and 
exists ( SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes u WHERE u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'  and 
										u.uco_code=e.evt_jobtype AND 
										u.uco_rcode IN ( '*', 'BR', 'ST', 'PM','CAL' ,'RP','MEC') ) 
AND e.evt_rstatus IN ('Q', 'R', 'C') 
AND e.evt_rtype IN ('JOB', 'PPM') 
AND (a.act_act=(select min(b.act_act) from r5activities b where b.act_event=a.act_event and b.act_parent is null) or a.act_act is null) 
AND e.evt_object +'#'+ e.evt_object_org in (:param.equipmentno)
AND (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR 
(evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc)))  
AND ( :param.islinear='false' OR 
( NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' from r5events w 
              WHERE e.evt_code = w.evt_code 
                  and w.evt_object = COALESCE(:param.equipmentcode, w.evt_object) 
                  and w.evt_object_org= COALESCE(:param.equipmentorg, w.evt_object_org)	
                  AND ( (NOT (CASE WHEN w.evt_frompoint IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT COALESCE(obj_frompoint, 0) + w.evt_frompoint FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = w.evt_object AND obj_org = w.evt_object_org) ELSE w.evt_frompoint END  BETWEEN :param.frompoint AND :param.topoint OR  CASE WHEN w.evt_topoint IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT COALESCE(obj_frompoint, 0) + w.evt_topoint FROM r5objects WHERE obj_code = w.evt_object AND obj_org = w.evt_object_org) ELSE w.evt_topoint END  BETWEEN :param.frompoint AND :param.topoint) 
                 OR w.evt_frompoint  is  null OR w.evt_topoint is  null )))))

AND (a.act_act=(select min(b.act_act) from r5activities b where b.act_event=a.act_event and b.act_parent is null) or a.act_act is null)
AND e.evt_object +'#'+ e.evt_object_org in (:param.equipmentno)

(evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc)))
AND ( :param.islinear='false' OR
( NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'X' from r5events w
              WHERE e.evt_code = w.evt_code
                  and w.evt_object = COALESCE(:param.equipmentcode, w.evt_object)
                  and w.evt_object_org= COALESCE(:param.equipmentorg, w.evt_object_org)

rows.GRD_DESC: GIS Map Search filter on work order jobs
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
EXISTS (SELECT 1 
          FROM r5events e left outer join r5activities a on (e.evt_code = a.act_event ), r5ucodes u
         WHERE e.evt_object = o.obj_code
           AND e.evt_object_org = o.obj_org
           AND u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP' 
           AND u.uco_code = e.evt_jobtype 
           AND u.uco_rcode IN ('*', 'BR', 'ST', 'PM','MEC', 'CAL')
           AND e.evt_rstatus IN ('Q', 'R', 'C')
           AND e.evt_rtype IN ('JOB', 'PPM') 
           AND (a.act_act = (SELECT MIN(b.act_act) FROM r5activities b WHERE b.act_event = a.act_event) OR a.act_act IS NULL)
          AND '+' = CASE WHEN e.evt_object = :parameter.linearequipment AND e.evt_object_org = :parameter.linearequipmentorg 
          THEN 
	           CASE WHEN e.evt_frompoint IS NOT NULL AND e.evt_topoint IS NOT NULL AND e.evt_frompoint >= :parameter.frompoint AND e.evt_topoint <= :parameter.topoint 
	           THEN 
		         '+' 
	           ELSE 
		         '-' 
	           END
          ELSE
	      '+'
         END      
          <%DATASPY%>)
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
EXISTS (SELECT 1
          FROM r5events e left outer join r5activities a on (e.evt_code = a.act_event ), r5ucodes u, r5userorganization uorg
         WHERE e.evt_object = o.obj_code
           AND e.evt_object_org = o.obj_org
           AND u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'
           AND u.uco_code = e.evt_jobtype
           AND u.uco_rcode IN ('*', 'BR', 'ST', 'PM', 'MEC', 'CAL')
           AND e.evt_rstatus IN ('Q', 'R', 'C')
           AND e.evt_rtype IN ('JOB', 'PPM')
           AND (a.act_act = (select min(b.act_act) from r5activities b WHERE b.act_event = a.act_event) OR a.act_act IS NULL)
           AND uorg.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
           AND uorg.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
           AND uorg.uog_org = e.evt_org
          AND '+' = CASE WHEN e.evt_object = :parameter.linearequipment AND e.evt_object_org = :parameter.linearequipmentorg
          THEN
	           CASE WHEN e.evt_frompoint IS NOT NULL AND e.evt_topoint IS NOT NULL AND e.evt_frompoint >= :parameter.frompoint AND e.evt_topoint <= :parameter.topoint
	           THEN
		         '+'
	           ELSE
		         '-'
	           END
          ELSE
	      '+'
         END
           <%DATASPY%>)

rows.GRD_DESC: Generate Work Orders - Duplicate Maintenance Patterns
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5maintenancepatterns,r5patternequipment,r5events
WHERE mtp_code = peq_mp
AND mtp_org = peq_mp_org
AND mtp_revision = peq_revision
AND peq_mp = evt_mp
AND peq_mp_org = evt_mp_org
AND peq_object = evt_object
AND peq_object_org = evt_object_org
AND peq_status = 'A'
AND evt_due = ( 
  SELECT MAX( evt_due )
  FROM  r5events
  WHERE evt_mp  = peq_mp
  AND evt_mp_org = mtp_org
  AND evt_object = peq_object
  AND evt_object_org = peq_object_org )
AND mtp_allowduplicatewo = '+'
AND :parameter.GenerateThroughDays IS NOT NULL
AND evt_org = :parameter.WOOrg
AND evt_mp LIKE COALESCE( :parameter.MaintenancePattern, '%' )
AND evt_object LIKE COALESCE( :parameter.Equipment, '%' )
AND evt_mrc LIKE COALESCE( :parameter.Department, '%' )

WHERE obj_code = ppo_object
AND obj_org = ppo_object_org
AND ppm_code = ppo_ppm
AND ppm_revision = ppo_revision
AND ppm_revrstatus = 'A'
AND ppo_isstype = 'D'
AND ppm_package  = '-'
AND ppm_notused  = '-'
AND dbo.o7gtdate( ppo_due, ppo_performonweek, ppo_performonday ) <= dbo.f_trunc_date( getdate(), 'DD' ) + cast( :parameter.GenerateThroughDays as integer )
AND ppo_org = :parameter.WOOrg
AND ppo_ppm LIKE COALESCE( :parameter.PMSchedule, '%' )
AND ppo_object LIKE COALESCE( :parameter.Equipment, '%' )
AND COALESCE( ppo_mrc, obj_pmwodept, obj_mrc ) LIKE COALESCE( :parameter.Department, '%' )

rows.GRD_DESC: Grid for View Activity Booked Labor

select <FIELDLIST_1>
from r5bookedhours, r5activities a1, r5orderlines, r5events 
  where (('activitybookedlabor'=:param.switch and boo_event = :param.jobnum and a1.act_act = :param.actnum) or ('employeebookedlabor'=:param.switch and boo_person = :param.employee and boo_date > GetDate()-365 and evt_org=:param.org))
    and evt_code= boo_event
    and boo_event = a1.act_event
    and boo_act = a1.act_act 
    and boo_hours <> 0 
    and (  ( boo_event = orl_event and boo_act = orl_act )
             or ( boo_order = orl_order and boo_ordline = orl_ordline and boo_order_org = orl_order_org ) )
    and orl_rtype IN ('ST', 'SF', 'SH') 
    and (orl_rstatus <> 'C' OR coalesce(orl_recvqty,0) > 0 )
    and a1.act_parent IS NULL
<FILTER_1>
UNION ALL
select <FIELDLIST_2>
from r5bookedhours, r5activities a1, r5orderlines, r5events RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5activities a2 ON (a2.act_event = evt_routeparent)     
where boo_event = evt_code 
    and 'activitybookedlabor'=:param.switch and evt_routeparent=:param.jobnum and a1.act_act=:param.actnum 
    and boo_event = a1.act_event 
    and boo_act = a1.act_act 
    and boo_hours <> 0 
    and (  ( evt_routeparent = orl_event and boo_act = orl_act )
           or ( boo_order = orl_order and boo_ordline = orl_ordline and boo_order_org = orl_order_org ) )
    and orl_rtype IN ('ST', 'SF', 'SH') 
    and a2.act_act = a1.act_act 
    and (orl_rstatus <> 'C' OR coalesce(orl_recvqty,0) > 0 )
    and a1.act_parent IS NULL
<FILTER_2>
UNION ALL
select <FIELDLIST_3>
from r5bookedhours, r5activities, r5events
where (('activitybookedlabor'=:param.switch and evt_code = :param.jobnum and act_act = :param.actnum) or ('employeebookedlabor'=:param.switch and boo_person = :param.employee and boo_date > GetDate()-365 and evt_org=:param.org))

    and act_event = evt_code
    and act_hire = '-'
    and boo_event = act_event   
    and boo_act = act_act
    and boo_hours <> 0 
    and boo_order IS NULL
    and boo_desc  IS NULL
    and act_parent IS NULL
<FILTER_3>
UNION ALL
select <FIELDLIST_4> 
from r5bookedhours, r5activities, r5events  
where boo_event = evt_code 
    and 'activitybookedlabor'=:param.switch and evt_routeparent=:param.jobnum and act_act=:param.actnum

rows.GRD_DESC: Grid on parts tab of work order
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5activities, r5parts, r5organizationoptions, r5events,
(SELECT TRL_EVENT,TRL_ACT,TRL_PART,TRL_PART_ORG,TRL_STORE,TRL_LINE, 
TRL_DIRECT,TRL_MATLIST,TRL_MATLISTREV,trl_manufacturer,trl_manufactpart FROM r5workorderpartsummary 
where trl_event = :param.workordernum UNION 
SELECT coalesce(e.evt_routeparent,l.trl_event),l.trl_act,COALESCE(l.trl_issuedpart, l.trl_part) trl_part,l.trl_part_org,l.trl_store,0 line,
case when trl_rtype = 'RECV' then '+' when trl_rtype = 'RR' then '-' when trl_rtype = 'I' then (case when trl_io = 0 then '+' else '-' end) 
end direct,cast(null as nvarchar) matlist,cast(null as numeric) matlistrev,trl_manufacturer,trl_manufactpart 
FROM r5transactions t,r5translines l,r5events e WHERE l.trl_trans = t.tra_code AND t.tra_torentity = N'EVNT' 
AND t.tra_fromrentity = CASE l.trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN N'COMP' ELSE t.tra_fromrentity END 
AND l.trl_rtype IN (N'I',N'RR',N'RECV') AND e.evt_code = l.trl_event 
AND e.evt_routeparent = :param.workordernum 
UNION SELECT coalesce(e.evt_routeparent,l.trl_event),l.trl_act,COALESCE(l.trl_issuedpart, l.trl_part) trl_part,l.trl_part_org,l.trl_store,0 line,
case when trl_rtype = 'RECV' then '+' when trl_rtype = 'RR' then '-' when trl_rtype = 'I' then (case when trl_io = 0 then '+' else '-' end)
end direct,cast(null as nvarchar) matlist,cast(null as numeric) matlistrev,trl_manufacturer,trl_manufactpart 
FROM r5transactions t,r5translines l,r5events e WHERE l.trl_trans = t.tra_code  AND t.tra_torentity = N'EVNT' 
AND t.tra_fromrentity = CASE l.trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN N'COMP' ELSE t.tra_fromrentity END 
AND l.trl_rtype IN (N'I',N'RR',N'RECV') AND e.evt_code = l.trl_event 
AND (l.trl_event = :param.workordernum AND e.evt_routeparent is null)) x 
where act_event = trl_event and act_act = trl_act and trl_part = par_code and trl_part_org = par_org and act_event = evt_code and evt_org = opa_org and opa_code = 'ACTINFO' and (coalesce(act_parent, act_act) = :param.headeractivity or :param.headeractivity = 0) and (act_seq = :param.headerjob or :param.headerjob = 0) and ((trl_line != 0) or (trl_line = 0 and not exists (select 1 from r5matlparts, r5events, r5mrcs where mlp_direct = trl_direct and mlp_part = trl_part and mlp_part_org = trl_part_org and mlp_matlist = act_matlist and mlp_matlrev=act_matlrev and trl_event = evt_code and evt_mrc = mrc_code and isnull(trl_store,N'!@#$') = isnull(mrc_store,N'!@#$') and (( isnull(mlp_code, isnull(evt_object,N'!@#$')) = isnull(evt_object,N'!@#$')  and isnull(mlp_code_org, isnull(evt_object_org,N'!@#$')) = isnull(evt_object_org,N'!@#$')) or (mlp_obrtype = 'C' and exists (select obj_code from r5objects where  obj_code = evt_object and obj_org = evt_object_org and obj_category = mlp_code))))))

from r5activities, r5parts, r5organizationoptions, r5events,

where trl_event = :param.workordernum UNION 
SELECT coalesce(e.evt_routeparent,l.trl_event),l.trl_act,COALESCE(l.trl_issuedpart, l.trl_part) trl_part,l.trl_part_org,l.trl_store,0 line,
case when trl_rtype = 'RECV' then '+' when trl_rtype = 'RR' then '-' when trl_rtype = 'I' then (case when trl_io = 0 then '+' else '-' end) 
end direct,cast(null as nvarchar) matlist,cast(null as numeric) matlistrev,trl_manufacturer,trl_manufactpart 
FROM r5transactions t,r5translines l,r5events e WHERE l.trl_trans = t.tra_code AND t.tra_torentity = N'EVNT' 
AND t.tra_fromrentity = CASE l.trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN N'COMP' ELSE t.tra_fromrentity END

rows.GRD_DESC: IPAD SYNC r5transactions for MEC Child WO issue/return
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5transactions, r5events e
WHERE tra_rtype='I'
AND tra_tocode=e.evt_code
AND e.evt_jobtype='MEC'
AND EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM  r5events p
   WHERE e.evt_parent = p.evt_code
   AND p.evt_rstatus = 'R'
   AND p.evt_rtype IN ('JOB','PPM')
   AND ( ISNULL(e.evt_updated,e.evt_created) > :parameter.lastupdated
      OR ISNULL(p.evt_updated,p.evt_created) > :parameter.lastupdated)
   AND
   (
      (  ISNULL(:parameter.womrc,'N') <> 'Y'
         AND
         (  EXISTS
            (  SELECT 1
               FROM r5personnel
               WHERE per_user = :parameter.r5user
               AND p.evt_person = per_code
            )
            OR EXISTS
            (  SELECT 1
               FROM r5actschedules, r5personnel
               WHERE acs_event = p.evt_code
               AND per_user = :parameter.r5user
               AND acs_responsible = per_code
            )
         )
      )
      OR
      (  ISNULL(:parameter.womrc,'N') = 'Y'
         AND (p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc1 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc2 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc3 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc4 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc5 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc6 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc7 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc8 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc9 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc10)
      )
   )
   AND EXISTS
   (  SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes
      WHERE uco_rentity = 'JBTP'
      AND uco_code = p.evt_jobtype
      AND uco_rcode IN ('*','BR','ST','PM','CAL','RP')
   )
)

rows.GRD_DESC: Import Invoiced Lines When Credit/Debit Type
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from(select ORL_ORDER PURCHASEORDER,ORL_ORDLINE PURCHASEORDERLINE,ORL_REF SUPPLIERREFERENCE,
case (case ORL_RTYPE when 'PD' then 'PART' when 'PS' then 'PART' else 'TASK' end)
when 'PART' then dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'PART',ORL_PART + '#' + ORL_PART_ORG, '', '' )
else dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'TASK',ORL_TASK, '', '' ) end PURCHASEORDERLINEDESC,
case (case :param.invoicereturn when '-1' then '+' else '-' end) when '+' then case when ORL_RTYPE = 'SF' then 1 else (SELECT SUM(case i.inv_rtype when 'I' then l.ivl_invqty when 'C' then -l.ivl_returnqty when 'D' then -l.ivl_returnqty end) 
FROM r5invoicelines l , r5invoices i WHERE l.ivl_invoice = i.inv_code AND l.ivl_invoice_org = i.inv_org 
AND ivl_order = orl_order AND ivl_ordline = orl_ordline AND ivl_order_org = orl_order_org 
AND (i.inv_code+'#'+i.inv_org = :param.parentinvoice+'#'+:param.parentinvoiceorganization 
OR i.inv_parent+'#'+i.inv_parent_org = :param.parentinvoice+'#'+:param.parentinvoiceorganization)) end else 1 end QUANTITYINVOICED,
case (case :param.invoicereturn when '-1' then '+' else '-' end) when '+' then case when ORL_RTYPE = 'SF' then IMP_INVOICED else IMP_PRICE end else null end PRICE,
ORL_PART PART,ORL_COSTCODE COSTCODE,ORL_EVENT WORKORDER,CASE WHEN act_parent IS NULL THEN act_act ELSE act_parent END ACTIVITY,
CASE WHEN act_parent IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE act_seq END JOBSEQUENCE, 
CASE WHEN act_parent IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(tsk_jobplan, '-') = '+' AND COALESCE(tsk_reusable, '-') = '+') THEN orl_task ELSE '' END) ELSE '' END  JOBPLAN,  
CASE WHEN act_parent IS NOT NULL THEN dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'JBPL', orl_task,'', '') ELSE '' END JOBDESCRIPTION,
ORL_TRADE TRADE,CASE tsk_jobplan WHEN '-' THEN orl_task ELSE NULL END TASK,
ORL_CURR CURRENCY,ORL_EXCH EXCHANGERATE,ORL_ORDER_ORG PURCHASEORDERORGANIZATION,IMP_ORDERED ORDERED,
IMP_RECEIVED RECEIVED,IMP_INVOICED INVOICED,ORL_TAX TAX1,ORL_TAX2 TAX2,ORL_TYPE LINETYPE, INS_DESC INSDESC  
from R5INSTALL, R5IMPORTPOLINESVW  LEFT OUTER JOIN r5activities ON(act_event = orl_event AND act_act = orl_act) LEFT OUTER JOIN r5tasks ON (tsk_code = orl_task AND tsk_revision = orl_taskrev) where :param.invoicetype in ('C','D') 
and IVL_INVOICE=:param.parentinvoice and IVL_INVOICE_ORG=:param.parentinvoiceorganization AND ins_code = 'INVDUPPO' ) a 
WHERE ( INSDESC = 'ON' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 
				       FROM r5invoicelines 
         				       WHERE ivl_invoice = :param.invoicecode
				       AND ivl_invoice_org = :param.invoiceorganization 
				       AND ivl_order = PURCHASEORDER  
                   		       AND ivl_order_org = PURCHASEORDERORGANIZATION 
                  			       AND ivl_ordline = PURCHASEORDERLINE ) )

rows.GRD_DESC: Import PO Lines Pop Up - Invoice
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from(select ORL_ORDER PURCHASEORDER,ORL_ORDLINE PURCHASEORDERLINE,ORL_REF SUPPLIERREFERENCE,

CASE WHEN act_parent IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE act_seq END JOBSEQUENCE,
CASE WHEN act_parent IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(tsk_jobplan, '-') = '+' AND COALESCE(tsk_reusable, '-') = '+') THEN orl_task ELSE '' END) ELSE '' END  JOBPLAN,
CASE WHEN act_parent IS NOT NULL THEN dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'JBPL', orl_task,'', '') ELSE '' END JOBDESCRIPTION,

ORL_TRADE TRADE,
ORL_CURR CURRENCY,ORL_EXCH EXCHANGERATE,
ORL_ORDER_ORG PURCHASEORDERORGANIZATION,IMP_ORDERED ORDERED,IMP_RECEIVED RECEIVED,IMP_INVOICED INVOICED,

from R5INSTALL, R5IMPORTPOLINESVW LEFT OUTER JOIN r5activities ON(act_event = orl_event AND act_act = orl_act) LEFT OUTER JOIN r5tasks ON (tsk_code = orl_task AND tsk_revision = orl_taskrev), r5userorganization where :param.invoicetype='I' and

AND (COALESCE(:param.iswotypes, 'false') = 'false'
     OR (e.evt_jobtype IN (:param.wotypes)))
AND (COALESCE(:param.wolookbackdays, 'false') = 'false'
     OR (e.evt_rstatus = 'C' 
         AND DATEDIFF(day, e.evt_completed, dbo.o7gttime2(e.evt_org)) <= :param.wolookbackdays)
     OR e.evt_rstatus <> 'C')

     OR (e.evt_rstatus IN ('R', 'Q') 
         AND DATEDIFF(day, e.evt_created, dbo.o7gttime2(e.evt_org)) <= :param.woopendays)
     OR e.evt_rstatus NOT IN ('R', 'Q'))

AND (COALESCE(:param.iswostatuses, 'false') = 'false'

FROM r5orders o, r5orderlines l ,  r5companies c
WHERE
o.ord_code = l.orl_order
AND o.ord_supplier = c.com_code
AND o.ord_supplier_org = c.com_org
AND c.com_notused = '-'  AND c.com_purchasesite = '+'
AND o.ord_org = l.orl_order_org
AND o.ord_supplier like isnull( :parameter.suppliercode, '%' )
AND o.ord_code like ( case isnull(:parameter.invoicepurchaseorder,'x' ) when 'x'  then '%'  else :parameter.invoicepurchaseorder + '%' end )
AND o.ord_supplier_org like isnull( :parameter.supplierorg, '%' )
AND
 (
     (
	( dbo.f_greatest_number( case orl_rstatus when 'C' then 0 else orl_ordqty end, isnull( orl_recvqty, 0 ) ) - isnull( l.orl_scrapqty, 0 ) ) / isnull( orl_multiply, 1 )>
		(SELECT isnull(SUM(case inv_rtype when 'C' then (case inv_return when '+' then -ivl_returnqty else 0 end)when 'D' then (case inv_return when '+' then -ivl_returnqty else 0 end) else ivl_invqty end ),0)
		FROM r5invoices v,r5invoicelines i
		WHERE v.inv_code = i.ivl_invoice
		AND v.inv_org = i.ivl_invoice_org
		AND i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
		AND i.ivl_ordline = l.orl_ordline
		AND i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
		AND ISNULL( i.ivl_prepayment, '-' ) = '-'
		AND v.inv_rstatus <> 'C'
   	       )
	       AND ORL_RTYPE <> 'SF'
	)
	OR
	( dbo.f_greatest_number( case orl_rstatus when 'C' then 0 else orl_price end, isnull( orl_recvvalue, 0 ) ) >

dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'MRC',mrc_code+'#'+mrc_org,null,null) item_desc

and uog_org = mrc_org
and uog_user = :parameter.r5user
and uog_role = :parameter.r5role
and (uog_common = '+' or uog_org = :parameter.organization)

dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,bgr_rentity,obj_code+'#'+obj_org,null,null) item_desc
from r5objects,r5budgetgroups,r5userorganization
where
bgr_code = :parameter.budgetgroup
and 1 = (
		case when (bgr_rentity = 'OBJ' and obj_obrtype in ('A','S')) then 1
		when (bgr_rentity = 'LOC' and obj_obrtype = 'L') then 1

and uog_role = :parameter.r5role
and (uog_common = '+' or uog_org = :parameter.organization)

dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'UCOD',uco_code,uco_rentity,null) item_desc
from r5ucodes, r5budgetgroups where bgr_code = :parameter.budgetgroup
and bgr_rentity = uco_rentity
and uco_rentity in('CSTP','JBTP')
union all
select cst_code item_code,cst_org item_org,

and uog_user = :parameter.r5user
and uog_role = :parameter.r5role
and (uog_common = '+' or uog_org = :parameter.organization)
and  isnull(cst_notused,'-') = '-'
union all
select prj_code item_code,prj_org item_org,

rows.GRD_DESC: LOV FOR WO STATUS FOR RELEASED PMS
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
select <FIELDLIST_1>
FROM   r5auth a, r5ucodes u
WHERE ( a.aut_user = :parameter.r5user
OR    ( a.aut_group = (SELECT uog_group FROM r5userorganization WHERE uog_user = :parameter.r5user AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role AND uog_org = :control.org) AND a.aut_user = '*' ) )
AND     a.aut_rentity = 'EVNT'
AND     ( a.aut_status = '*' OR a.aut_status  = :param.fromustatus )
AND   a.aut_status = u.uco_code
AND   u.uco_rentity = 'EVST'
AND  ((u.uco_rcode = 'R' AND  a.aut_statnew IN (SELECT uco_code FROM r5ucodes WHERE uco_rentity = 'EVST' and uco_rcode in  ('R')))
       OR (u.uco_rcode = 'A' AND a.aut_statnew IN (SELECT uco_code FROM r5ucodes WHERE uco_rentity = 'EVST' and uco_rcode in  ('A','R')
               and (uco_system = '+' or uco_system = (case when uco_rcode = 'A' and :param.filteradefault ='+' THEN '+' else '-' end)))))
AND     a.aut_type = '+'
AND NOT EXISTS  ( SELECT * FROM r5auth a
                  WHERE a.aut_user  = :parameter.r5user
                  AND a.aut_group = (SELECT uog_group FROM r5userorganization WHERE uog_user = :parameter.r5user AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role AND uog_org = :control.org)
                  AND a.aut_rentity = 'EVNT'
                  AND ( a.aut_status = '*' OR a.aut_status  = :param.fromustatus )
                  AND a.aut_type = '-' )
<FILTER_1>
union select <FIELDLIST_2>
FROM   r5ucodes
WHERE uco_code = :param.fromustatus
AND   uco_rentity = 'EVST'
AND   (uco_system = '+' or uco_system = coalesce(:param.filteradefault, '-'))
<FILTER_2>
<SORT_BY>

FROM r5parts p
LEFT OUTER JOIN
   (SELECT bis_part,bis_part_org,bis_store,bis_bin,SUM(bis_qty) bis_qty
   FROM r5binstock b
   GROUP BY bis_part,bis_part_org,bis_store,bis_bin ) bis
   ON par_code=bis_part and par_org = bis_part_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5partctplconditions pc ON pc.ptc_template = p.par_conditiontpl AND pc.ptc_template_org = p.par_conditiontpl_org AND pc.ptc_condition = p.par_condition
WHERE
bis_store = :store_code
AND   ( COALESCE(:multiequipwo,'false') = 'false'
     OR (COALESCE(:multiequipwo,'false') = 'true'
       AND (:relatedworkordernum IS NOT NULL
     OR (:relatedworkordernum IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.par_byasset, '-') = '-') )))
AND (:transactiontype = 'ISSUE' OR
     :workordernum IS NULL OR
      (:transactiontype='RETURN' AND
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5translines l
              WHERE trl_rtype='I'
                AND trl_qty <> 0
                AND trl_part=p.par_code
                AND trl_part_org=p.par_org
                AND trl_store = bis_store
                AND trl_event IN ( SELECT evt_code
                        FROM r5events WHERE evt_routeparent = :workordernum AND :relatedworkordernum IS NULL
                    UNION
                        SELECT COALESCE( :relatedworkordernum, :workordernum,'-' ) FROM  dual ))))
AND p.par_notused = '-'
AND COALESCE(pc.ptc_preventissue, '-') <> '+'
AND (:parameter.storesec = 'OFF'
   OR  COALESCE(:parameter.checkstoresecurity, 'false') = 'false'
   OR  (:parameter.checkstoresecurity = 'true'
         AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5storesecurity, r5stores, r5userorganization
                 WHERE ssc_store = bis_store
                 AND   ssc_group = uog_group
                 AND   uog_user = :parameter.r5user
                 AND   uog_role = :parameter.r5role
                 AND   uog_org = str_org
                 AND   str_code = bis_store
                 AND COALESCE( ssc_issuereturn, '-' ) = '+' ) ) )
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5userorganization, r5parts p
LEFT OUTER JOIN
   (SELECT bis_part,bis_part_org,bis_store,bis_bin,SUM(bis_qty) bis_qty
   FROM r5binstock b
   GROUP BY bis_part,bis_part_org,bis_store,bis_bin ) bis
   ON par_code=bis_part and par_org = bis_part_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5partctplconditions pc ON pc.ptc_template = p.par_conditiontpl AND pc.ptc_template_org = p.par_conditiontpl_org AND pc.ptc_condition = p.par_condition
WHERE
bis_store = :store_code
AND   ( COALESCE(:multiequipwo,'false') = 'false'
     OR (COALESCE(:multiequipwo,'false') = 'true'
       AND (:relatedworkordernum IS NOT NULL
     OR (:relatedworkordernum IS NULL AND COALESCE(p.par_byasset, '-') = '-') )))
AND (:transactiontype = 'ISSUE' OR
     :workordernum IS NULL OR
      (:transactiontype='RETURN' AND
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5translines l
              WHERE trl_rtype='I'
                AND trl_qty <> 0
                AND trl_part=p.par_code
                AND trl_part_org=p.par_org
                AND trl_store = bis_store
                AND trl_event IN ( SELECT evt_code
                        FROM r5events WHERE evt_routeparent = :workordernum AND :relatedworkordernum IS NULL
                    UNION
                        SELECT COALESCE(:relatedworkordernum, :workordernum,'-' ) FROM  dual ))))
AND p.par_notused = '-'
AND COALESCE(pc.ptc_preventissue, '-') <> '+'
AND p.par_org = uog_org
AND uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND (uog_common = '+' OR uog_org = :control.org)
AND (:parameter.storesec = 'OFF'
   OR  COALESCE(:parameter.checkstoresecurity, 'false') = 'false'
   OR  (:parameter.checkstoresecurity = 'true'
         AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5storesecurity, r5stores, r5userorganization

where dtc_srcproductid = don_srcproductid 
and dtc_upcode = dxv_upcode 
and don_option = dxv_option 
and org_code   = dxv_destvalue1 
and dtc_upcode =  :param.uploadid 
and don_option  = 'SITEORG'

FROM r5nonconformitytypeaspects, r5nonconformitytypes, r5actchecklists
WHERE nta_nonconformitytype_code = nct_code
AND nta_nonconformitytype_org  = nct_org
AND nta_aspect = ack_aspect
AND ack_code = :parameter.checklistcode
FROM o7splitstring((SELECT ack_possible_directions FROM r5actchecklists WHERE ack_code = :parameter.checklistcode)) as code WHERE 1=1
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_EDB: FROM r5actchecklists, unnest(string_to_array(ack_possible_directions, ',')) as code WHERE ack_code = :parameter.checklistcode

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM  r5actchecklists, r5ucodes, r5descriptions
WHERE  uco_rentity = 'NAOP'
AND uco_code = des_code
AND ack_code = :parameter.checklistcode
AND des_rentity = 'UCOD'
AND des_rtype = 'NAOP'
AND des_lang = :parameter.language
AND CHARINDEX(',' + uco_code + ',' , ',' + ack_possible_na_options + ',' ) > 0

FROM r5descriptions 
WHERE des_lang = :parameter.language 
AND des_rentity = 'UCOD'
AND des_rtype = 'CNOT'

FROM r5casemanagement
WHERE ( :parameter.deptsec = 'OFF' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user = :parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = csm_mrc))
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5casemanagement
WHERE (:parameter.deptsec = 'OFF' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user = :parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = csm_mrc))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization u WHERE u.uog_org = csm_org and u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user and u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role)

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5workspacemoves
WHERE 1=1
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5workspacemoves
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization u WHERE u.uog_org = wkm_org and u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user and u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role)

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5workspaces
WHERE 1=1
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5workspaces
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization u WHERE u.uog_org = wks_org and u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user and u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role)

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM  r5actchecklists, r5ucodes, r5descriptions
WHERE  uco_rentity = 'SEVE'
AND uco_code = des_code
AND ack_code = :parameter.checklistcode
AND des_rentity = 'UCOD'
AND des_rtype = 'SEVE'
AND des_lang = :parameter.language
AND CHARINDEX(',' + uco_code + ',' , ',' + ack_possible_severities + ',' ) > 0

from r5dwlabordailysnap right outer join r5dwdates on (zdt_key = zlb_datekey) left outer join r5dwworkorders on (zlb_wokey = zwo_key) left outer join r5dwpersonnel on (zlb_personnelkey = zpe_key) left outer join r5dwtrades on (zlb_tradekey = ztr_key) left outer join r5dwmrcs on (zlb_mrckey = zmr_key) left outer join r5dwoccupationtypes on (zlb_octypekey = zot_key) left outer join r5dworganizations on (zlb_orgkey = zor_key) where zdt_date between :parameter.startdate and :parameter.enddate @GROUPBYCLAUSE{ group by @ALL }

from R5MP2WOE
where ZGE_UPCODE = :param.uploadid
and ZGE_SITEID = :param.siteid
and ZGE_WONUM = :param.workorder
and ZGE_CLOSEDATE = :param.closedate
FROM txdictionary, txalltexts WHERE  dic_notactive = '-' AND dic_texttype not in ( 'MSPR', 'FRM') AND dic_market  = '*' AND dic_code = txt_code(+)

FROM lt710.txlanginst
WHERE txl_code NOT IN ( 'R4', 'XX', 'YY' )

from r5descriptions
where des_rentity = 'LANG' and des_lang = :parameter.language
and des_code in (select lin_code from r5langinst )
from r5languages where 1=1

FROM   lt710.txlanginst
WHERE  txl_code NOT IN ( 'R4', 'XX', 'YY', :parameter.currentlang )

FROM r5boilertexts t,r5objects o,r5userorganization u,r5tabpermissions tp,r5objlinearref l,
(SELECT lrf_id,obj_length,obj_direction,obj_frompoint,obj_linearrefuom,obj_lengthuom,
 CASE allequipment.leq_structuretype WHEN 'C' THEN -dbo.o7getpointoffset( obj_code,obj_org,lrf_objcode,lrf_objorg,obj_linearrefuom,'-' ) ELSE
 dbo.o7getpointoffset( lrf_objcode, lrf_objorg, obj_code, obj_org, obj_linearrefuom, '-' ) END offset,allequipment.leq_structuretype structuretype
 FROM r5objects, r5objlinearref, dbo.o7getlrfequip( :parameter.object, :parameter.objorganization ) allequipment
 WHERE obj_code = :parameter.object
 AND obj_org  = :parameter.objorganization
 AND lrf_linear_reftype = 'I'
 AND lrf_objcode = allequipment.leq_object
 AND lrf_objorg = allequipment.leq_object_org
 AND ( ( lrf_applytochildren = '+'  AND allequipment.leq_structuretype = 'P' ) OR
       ( lrf_applytorouterow = '+'  AND allequipment.leq_structuretype = 'C' ) OR
       allequipment.leq_structuretype = 'E'  ) ) os
WHERE l.lrf_id = os.lrf_id
AND obj_code = lrf_objcode
AND obj_org = lrf_objorg
AND u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND u.uog_org = :parameter.objorganization
AND tp.trp_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND tp.trp_tab = 'LRF'
AND tp.trp_group = u.uog_group
AND tp.trp_select = '?'
AND t.bot_fld1 = os.obj_linearrefuom
AND t.bot_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND t.bot_lang = :parameter.language
AND t.bot_fld2 = 'DD_DISTANCEUOM'
AND NOT ( ( lrf_objcode <> :parameter.object OR lrf_objorg <> :parameter.objorganization )
       AND ( CAST( CASE WHEN COALESCE( o.obj_direction, os.obj_direction, 'x' ) = COALESCE( os.obj_direction, o.obj_direction, 'x' ) THEN ROUND( ( CAST( lrf_frompoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - CAST( os.offset AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ), 6 ) ELSE CASE structuretype WHEN 'P' THEN ROUND( ( CAST( os.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( os.obj_lengthuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - ( ( CAST( lrf_topoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - CAST( os.offset AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) , 6 ) ELSE ROUND( ( ( CAST( o.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_lengthuom, o.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC ) ) - ( CAST( lrf_topoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) ) - CAST( os.offset AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ), 6 ) END END AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) > CAST( os.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( os.obj_lengthuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) OR
             CAST( CASE WHEN COALESCE( o.obj_direction, os.obj_direction, 'x' ) = COALESCE( os.obj_direction, o.obj_direction, 'x' ) THEN ROUND( ( CAST( lrf_topoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - CAST( os.offset AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ), 6 ) ELSE CASE structuretype WHEN 'P' THEN ROUND( ( CAST( os.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( os.obj_lengthuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - ( ( CAST( lrf_frompoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - CAST( os.offset AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ), 6 ) ELSE ROUND( ( ( CAST( o.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_lengthuom, o.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - ( CAST( lrf_frompoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) ) - os.offset  , 6 ) END END AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) < 0 ) )

 CASE allequipment.leq_structuretype WHEN 'C' THEN -o7getpointoffset( obj_code,obj_org,lrf_objcode,lrf_objorg,obj_linearrefuom,'-' ) ELSE
 o7getpointoffset( lrf_objcode, lrf_objorg, obj_code, obj_org, obj_linearrefuom, '-' ) END AS offset, allequipment.leq_structuretype AS structuretype
 FROM r5objects, r5objlinearref, o7getlrfequip( :parameter.object, :parameter.objorganization ) allequipment
 WHERE obj_code = :parameter.object
 AND obj_org  = :parameter.objorganization
 AND lrf_linear_reftype = 'O'
 AND lrf_objcode = allequipment.leq_object
 AND lrf_objorg = allequipment.leq_object_org
 AND ( ( lrf_applytochildren = '+'  AND allequipment.leq_structuretype = 'P' ) OR
       ( lrf_applytorouterow = '+'  AND allequipment.leq_structuretype = 'C' ) OR
       allequipment.leq_structuretype = 'E'  ) ) off
WHERE l.lrf_id = off.lrf_id
AND obj_code = lrf_objcode
AND obj_org = lrf_objorg
AND u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND u.uog_org = :parameter.objorganization
AND tp.trp_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND tp.trp_tab = 'LRF'
AND tp.trp_group = u.uog_group
AND tp.trp_select = '?'
AND t.bot_fld1 = off.obj_linearrefuom
AND t.bot_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND t.bot_lang = :parameter.language
AND t.bot_fld2 = 'DD_DISTANCEUOM'
AND NOT ( ( lrf_objcode <> :parameter.object OR lrf_objorg <> :parameter.objorganization )
       AND ( CASE WHEN COALESCE( o.obj_direction, off.obj_direction, 'x' ) = COALESCE( off.obj_direction, o.obj_direction, 'x' ) THEN ROUND( ( lrf_frompoint * o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, off.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - off.offset, 6 ) ELSE CASE structuretype WHEN 'P' THEN ROUND( ( off.obj_length * o7pointuomconv( off.obj_lengthuom, off.obj_linearrefuom ) ) -  ( ( lrf_topoint * o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, off.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - off.offset ) , 6 ) ELSE ROUND( ( ( o.obj_length * o7pointuomconv( o.obj_lengthuom, o.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - ( lrf_topoint * o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, off.obj_linearrefuom ) ) ) - off.offset  , 6 ) END END > off.obj_length * o7pointuomconv( off.obj_lengthuom, off.obj_linearrefuom ) OR
             CASE WHEN COALESCE( o.obj_direction, off.obj_direction, 'x' ) = COALESCE( off.obj_direction, o.obj_direction, 'x' ) THEN ROUND( ( lrf_topoint * o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, off.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - off.offset, 6 ) ELSE CASE structuretype WHEN 'P' THEN ROUND( ( off.obj_length * o7pointuomconv( off.obj_lengthuom, off.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - ( ( lrf_frompoint * o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, off.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - off.offset), 6 ) ELSE ROUND( ( ( o.obj_length * o7pointuomconv( o.obj_lengthuom, o.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - ( lrf_frompoint * o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, off.obj_linearrefuom ) ) ) - off.offset  , 6 ) END END < 0 ) )

rows.GRD_DESC: Linear Reference Points LOV for Equipment
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM   r5objlinearref l,
       r5objects o,
    ( SELECT lrf_id,
             obj_length,
             obj_direction,
             obj_frompoint,
             obj_linearrefuom,
             obj_lengthuom,
             dbo.o7getpointoffset( lrf_objcode, lrf_objorg, obj_code, obj_org, obj_linearrefuom, N'+' ) offset
      FROM   r5objects, r5objlinearref
      WHERE  obj_code = :param.obj_code
      AND    obj_org  = :param.obj_org
      AND    lrf_objcode+N'#'+lrf_objorg IN
      ( SELECT parent+N'#'+parentorg
        FROM   r5objlinearref, dbo.O7GETEQUIPCHILDPARENT( obj_code, obj_org )
        WHERE  lrf_objcode    = parent
        AND    lrf_objorg     = parentorg
        AND    lrf_re_objcode = child
        AND    lrf_re_objorg  = childorg
        AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) BETWEEN ISNULL( lrf_dateeffective, getdate() - 1 ) AND ISNULL( lrf_dateexpired, getdate() + 1 )
        UNION
        SELECT obj_code+N'#'+obj_org
        FROM   dual )
      AND    ( lrf_applytochildren = '+'  OR ( lrf_objcode = obj_code AND lrf_objorg = obj_org ) ) ) os
WHERE l.lrf_id = os.lrf_id
AND   obj_code = lrf_objcode
AND   obj_org  = lrf_objorg
AND   ( CASE WHEN :param.pointtype = 'F' THEN lrf_frompoint ELSE lrf_topoint END * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - offset between 0 and os.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( os.obj_lengthuom, os.obj_linearrefuom )
AND   ( 
          ( COALESCE(:param.frompointrange, '-') = '-' AND COALESCE(:param.topointrange, '-') = '-' )
       OR 
          (
            ( :param.pointtype = 'F' AND CAST( COALESCE( os.obj_frompoint, 0 ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) + CAST( dbo.f_greatest_number( 0, CASE WHEN COALESCE( o.obj_direction, os.obj_direction, 'x' ) = COALESCE( os.obj_direction, o.obj_direction, 'x' ) THEN CAST( ROUND( ( lrf_frompoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - os.offset, 6 ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ELSE CAST( ( ( os.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( os.obj_lengthuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - ROUND( ( lrf_topoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - os.offset, 6 ) ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) END ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) BETWEEN :param.frompointrange AND :param.topointrange )
           OR
            ( :param.pointtype = 'T' AND CAST( COALESCE( os.obj_frompoint, 0 ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) + CAST( dbo.f_least_number( CAST( os.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( os.obj_lengthuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ), CASE WHEN COALESCE( o.obj_direction, os.obj_direction, 'x' ) = COALESCE( os.obj_direction, o.obj_direction, 'x' ) THEN CAST( ROUND( ( lrf_topoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - os.offset, 6 ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ELSE CAST( ( ( os.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( os.obj_lengthuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - ROUND( ( lrf_frompoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - os.offset, 6 ) ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) END ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) BETWEEN :param.frompointrange AND :param.topointrange )
          )
      )
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_EDB:
FROM   r5objlinearref l,
       r5objects o,
    ( SELECT lrf_id,
             obj_length,
             obj_direction,
             obj_frompoint,
             obj_linearrefuom,
             obj_lengthuom,
             o7getpointoffset( lrf_objcode, lrf_objorg, obj_code, obj_org, obj_linearrefuom, '+' ) AS offset
      FROM   r5objects, r5objlinearref
      WHERE  obj_code =  :param.obj_code
      AND    obj_org  = :param.obj_org
      AND    ( lrf_objcode, lrf_objorg ) IN
         ( WITH RECURSIVE t ( stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, lrf_dateeffective, lrf_dateexpired ) AS (
             SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_child, stc_child_org, lrf_dateeffective, lrf_dateexpired
             FROM   r5objlinearref, r5structures
             WHERE  lrf_objcode    = stc_parent
             AND    lrf_objorg     = stc_parent_org
             AND    lrf_re_objcode = stc_child
             AND    lrf_re_objorg  = stc_child_org
             AND    TRUNC( sysdate ) BETWEEN NVL( lrf_dateeffective, sysdate - 1 ) AND NVL( lrf_dateexpired, sysdate + 1 )
             AND    stc_child      =  :param.obj_code
             AND    stc_child_org  = :param.obj_org
             UNION
             SELECT s.stc_parent, s.stc_parent_org, s.stc_child, s.stc_child_org, o.lrf_dateeffective, o.lrf_dateexpired
             FROM   r5objlinearref o, r5structures s 
                    JOIN t on t.stc_parent = s.stc_child AND t.stc_parent_org = s.stc_child_org 
                              AND TRUNC( sysdate ) BETWEEN NVL( t.lrf_dateeffective, sysdate - 1 ) AND NVL( t.lrf_dateexpired, sysdate + 1 ) 
             WHERE  lrf_objcode    = s.stc_parent
             AND    lrf_objorg     = s.stc_parent_org
             AND    lrf_re_objcode = s.stc_child
             AND    lrf_re_objorg  = s.stc_child_org )
             SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org
             FROM   t
           UNION
           SELECT obj_code, obj_org
           FROM   dual )
      AND    ( lrf_applytochildren = '+'  OR ( lrf_objcode = obj_code AND lrf_objorg = obj_org ) ) ) AS off
WHERE l.lrf_id = off.lrf_id
AND   obj_code = lrf_objcode
AND   obj_org  = lrf_objorg
AND   ( CASE WHEN :param.pointtype = 'F' THEN lrf_frompoint ELSE lrf_topoint END * o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, off.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - off.offset between 0 and off.obj_length * o7pointuomconv( off.obj_lengthuom, off.obj_linearrefuom )
AND   ( 
          ( COALESCE(:param.frompointrange, '-') = '-' AND COALESCE(:param.topointrange, '-') = '-' )
       OR 
          (
            ( :param.pointtype = 'F' AND COALESCE( off.obj_frompoint, 0 ) + ROUND( O7GREATEST( 0, CASE WHEN COALESCE( o.obj_direction, off.obj_direction, 'x' ) = COALESCE( off.obj_direction, o.obj_direction, 'x' ) THEN ( ( lrf_frompoint * o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, off.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - off.offset ) ELSE ( ( off.obj_length * o7pointuomconv( off.obj_lengthuom, off.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - ( ( lrf_topoint * o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, off.obj_linearrefuom ) ) - off.offset ) ) END ), 6 ) BETWEEN :param.frompointrange AND :param.topointrange )

FROM r5boilertexts t,r5objects o,r5userorganization u,r5tabpermissions tp,r5objlinearref l,
(SELECT lrf_id,obj_length,obj_direction,obj_frompoint,obj_linearrefuom,obj_lengthuom,
 CASE allequipment.leq_structuretype WHEN 'C' THEN -dbo.o7getpointoffset( obj_code,obj_org,lrf_objcode,lrf_objorg,obj_linearrefuom,'-' ) ELSE
 dbo.o7getpointoffset( lrf_objcode, lrf_objorg, obj_code, obj_org, obj_linearrefuom, '-' ) END offset,allequipment.leq_structuretype structuretype
 FROM r5objects, r5objlinearref, dbo.o7getlrfequip( :parameter.object, :parameter.objorganization ) allequipment
 WHERE obj_code = :parameter.object
 AND obj_org  = :parameter.objorganization
 AND lrf_linear_reftype = 'O'
 AND lrf_objcode = allequipment.leq_object
 AND lrf_objorg = allequipment.leq_object_org
 AND ( ( lrf_applytochildren = '+'  AND allequipment.leq_structuretype = 'P' ) OR
       ( lrf_applytorouterow = '+'  AND allequipment.leq_structuretype = 'C' ) OR
       allequipment.leq_structuretype = 'E'  ) ) os
WHERE l.lrf_id = os.lrf_id
AND obj_code = lrf_objcode
AND obj_org = lrf_objorg
AND u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND u.uog_org = :parameter.objorganization
AND tp.trp_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND tp.trp_tab = 'LRF'
AND tp.trp_group = u.uog_group
AND tp.trp_select = '?'
AND t.bot_fld1 = os.obj_linearrefuom
AND t.bot_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND t.bot_lang = :parameter.language
AND t.bot_fld2 = 'DD_DISTANCEUOM'
AND NOT ( ( lrf_objcode <> :parameter.object OR lrf_objorg <> :parameter.objorganization )
       AND ( CAST( CASE WHEN COALESCE( o.obj_direction, os.obj_direction, 'x' ) = COALESCE( os.obj_direction, o.obj_direction, 'x' ) THEN ROUND( ( CAST( lrf_frompoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - CAST( os.offset AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ), 6 ) ELSE CASE structuretype WHEN 'P' THEN ROUND( ( CAST( os.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( os.obj_lengthuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - ( ( CAST( lrf_topoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - CAST( os.offset AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) , 6 ) ELSE ROUND( ( ( CAST( o.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_lengthuom, o.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC ) ) - ( CAST( lrf_topoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) ) - CAST( os.offset AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ), 6 ) END END AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) > CAST( os.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( os.obj_lengthuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) OR
             CAST( CASE WHEN COALESCE( o.obj_direction, os.obj_direction, 'x' ) = COALESCE( os.obj_direction, o.obj_direction, 'x' ) THEN ROUND( ( CAST( lrf_topoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - CAST( os.offset AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ), 6 ) ELSE CASE structuretype WHEN 'P' THEN ROUND( ( CAST( os.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( os.obj_lengthuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - ( ( CAST( lrf_frompoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - CAST( os.offset AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ), 6 ) ELSE ROUND( ( ( CAST( o.obj_length * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_lengthuom, o.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) - ( CAST( lrf_frompoint * dbo.o7pointuomconv( o.obj_linearrefuom, os.obj_linearrefuom ) AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) ) ) - os.offset  , 6 ) END END AS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) ) < 0 ) )

rows.GRD_DESC: List of Activities for Labor Requisition
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5activities a
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events re ON (a.act_relatedwo = re.evt_code)
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5activities pa ON (a.act_event = pa.act_event AND a.act_parent = pa.act_act)
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5tasks t ON (COALESCE(a.act_task, pa.act_task) = t.tsk_code AND COALESCE(a.act_taskrev, pa.act_taskrev) = t.tsk_revision), r5events e
WHERE a.act_event = :param.jobnum
  AND a.act_event = e.evt_code
  AND a.act_hire = '+'
  AND a.act_defermaintenance = '-'
  AND a.act_order IS  NULL
  AND ((COALESCE(a.act_seq, pa.act_seq) IS NULL AND COALESCE(:param.userfunctiontab, 'ACT') <> 'PLA') OR (:param.userfunctiontab = 'PLA'))
  AND a.act_trade IS NOT NULL
  AND a.act_ordtype IN (SELECT uco_code
                          FROM r5ucodes
                          WHERE uco_rentity = 'PLTP'
                            AND uco_rcode IN ('SF', 'ST'))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'x'
                    FROM r5requislines r
                    WHERE r.rql_event = a.act_event
                      AND r.rql_act = a.act_act
                      AND r.rql_rtype LIKE 'S%'
                      AND r.rql_rstatus NOT IN ( 'C',  'J' ))

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM   r5organizationoptions,r5parts
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5partmfgs ON ( mfp_part = par_code AND mfp_part_org = par_org AND mfp_primary = '+' ),
       r5matlparts,
       r5matlists,
       ( SELECT t2.tsk_matlist matlist, tpj_seq seq , tpj_task task,ppa_act activity,ppa_trade trade,ppa_note note,
				CASE WHEN COALESCE(t2.tsk_reusable, '-') = '+' THEN tpj_jobplan  ELSE '' END jobplan,
         dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'JBPL', t2.tsk_code,null, null) jobdescription
         FROM   r5tasks t2, r5taskplanjobs, r5tasks t1, r5ppmacts
         WHERE  t1.tsk_code       = ppa_task
         AND    t1.tsk_revrstatus = 'A'
         AND    tpj_task          = t1.tsk_code
         AND    tpj_taskrev       = t1.tsk_revision
         AND    t2.tsk_code       = tpj_jobplan
         AND    t2.tsk_revrstatus = 'A'
         AND    ppa_ppm           = :param.pmcode
         AND    ppa_revision      = :param.pmrevision
         AND    t2.tsk_matlist IS NOT NULL
         AND    ppa_matlist IS NULL
         UNION ALL
         SELECT ppa_matlist matlist, NULL seq, NULL task,ppa_act activity,ppa_trade trade,ppa_note note,null jobplan, null jobdescription
         FROM   r5ppmacts
         WHERE  ppa_ppm      = :param.pmcode
         AND    ppa_revision = :param.pmrevision
         AND    ppa_matlist IS NOT NULL
         UNION ALL
         SELECT tsk_matlist matlist, NULL seq,  tsk_code task,ppa_act activity,ppa_trade trade,ppa_note note,null jobplan, null jobdescription
         FROM   r5tasks, r5ppmacts
         WHERE  tsk_code          = ppa_task
         AND    tsk_revrstatus    = 'A'
         AND    tsk_planninglevel = 'TP'
         AND    ppa_ppm           = :param.pmcode
         AND    ppa_revision      = :param.pmrevision
         AND    tsk_matlist IS NOT NULL ) mtl
WHERE    mtl_code       = mtl.matlist
AND      mtl_revrstatus = 'A'
AND      mlp_matlist    = mtl_code
AND      mlp_matlrev    = mtl_revision
AND      par_code       = mlp_part

AND		 opa_org = :param.pmorg
 AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
          FROM r5tabpermissions t, r5userorganization u
         WHERE u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
           AND u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
           AND t.trp_tab = 'MLP'
           AND u.uog_group = t.trp_group

from r5promptvalues, r5locale, 
     (select
	 		CASE
				WHEN usr_locale IS NOT NULL THEN usr_locale
				WHEN org_locale IS NOT NULL THEN org_locale
				WHEN ins_desc  IS NOT NULL THEN ins_desc 
				ELSE 'NAMERICA'
			END  
	 as locale 
 	 from 
	 (select usr_locale, org_locale, ins_desc
	  from   (r5users U LEFT OUTER JOIN r5organization O ON org_code = :parameter.r5organization)
		LEFT OUTER JOIN r5install ON ins_code = 'LOCALE'
	  where usr_code = :parameter.r5user)dummy) currentlocale 
where 
 pmv_prompt=:param.property and
 pmv_aspect=:param.aspectcode and
 loc_code = locale

rows.GRD_DESC: Lookup for Projects Tab Released Multiselect LOV
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM    r5projects p
WHERE   p.prj_rstatus = 'O'
AND     EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5apmscenarioequipment , r5events
          WHERE   evt_rstatus    =     'R'  
          AND     evt_object     =     aeq_equipment 
          AND     evt_object_org =     aeq_equipment_org 
          AND     p.prj_code     =     evt_project
          AND     evt_org        =     aeq_apmscenario_org
          AND     aeq_apmscenario= :parameter.scenariocode
          AND     aeq_apmscenario_org= :parameter.organization )
AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT apj_project FROM r5apmscenarioprojects 
         WHERE    p.prj_code = apj_project 
         AND      apj_apmscenario = :parameter.scenariocode 
         AND      apj_apmscenario_org=:parameter.organization ) )
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM    r5projects p,r5userorganization
WHERE   p.prj_rstatus = 'O'
AND     EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5apmscenarioequipment , r5events
          WHERE   evt_rstatus    =     'R'
          AND     evt_object     =     aeq_equipment
          AND     evt_object_org =    aeq_equipment_org
          AND     p.prj_code     =     evt_project
          AND     evt_org        =    aeq_apmscenario_org
          AND     aeq_apmscenario= :parameter.scenariocode
          AND     aeq_apmscenario_org= :parameter.organization )
AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT apj_project FROM r5apmscenarioprojects
      WHERE p.prj_code = apj_project
      AND   apj_apmscenario = :parameter.scenariocode
                AND apj_apmscenario_org=:parameter.organization ) )
AND    uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND    uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND    p.prj_org = uog_org
AND   (uog_common = '+' or uog_org =:parameter.organization)

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5descriptions d, r5ucodes u, r5standworks s 
WHERE  d.des_rentity = 'STWO'  
AND    d.des_lang = :parameter.language  
AND    d.des_code = s.stw_code 
AND   coalesce(s.stw_notused,'-')='-'
AND s.stw_type in ('SWO','PSWO')
AND    (( s.stw_obclass IS NULL AND s.stw_object IS NULL )
		OR        
	 (( :param.equipclass IS NOT NULL AND :param.category IS NULL ) AND (( s.stw_obclass = :param.equipclass AND s.stw_obclass_org = :param.equipclassorg ) AND s.stw_object IS NULL ))  
		OR        
	 (( :param.equipclass IS NOT NULL AND :param.category IS NOT NULL ) AND ( s.stw_obclass = :param.equipclass AND s.stw_obclass_org = :param.equipclassorg AND coalesce(s.stw_object, :param.category) =:param.category )))  
AND    s.stw_jobtype = u.uco_code  
AND    u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'  
AND    ((:param.pagemode = 'display' AND u.uco_rcode IN ('*','ST','BR', 'CAL','RP'))  OR (:param.pagemode = 'view' AND ((:param.rjobtype IN ('*','BR') AND u.uco_rcode IN ('BR', '*')) OR  (:param.rjobtype NOT IN ('*','BR') AND u.uco_rcode = :param.rjobtype))))  
and ( exists ( select 'x' from r5jobtypeauth j     
	       where j.jta_jobtype = s.stw_jobtype     
	       and ((:param.pagemode = 'display' AND j.jta_insert = '+')     OR   ((:param.pagemode = 'view' AND j.jta_update = '+')))     
	       and ( j.jta_group = :param.group or j.jta_group= '*' ))  
	      or  
      exists ( select 'x'    from r5install I    
      	       where i.ins_code = 'JTAUTH'    
      	       and upper( i.ins_desc ) not in ( 'YES', '+' ) ) )

WHERE  d.des_rentity = 'STWO'
AND    d.des_lang    = :parameter.language
AND    d.des_code    = s.stw_code
AND   coalesce(s.stw_notused,'-') = '-'
AND s.stw_type in ('SWO','PSWO')
AND    ( ( s.stw_obclass IS NULL AND s.stw_object IS NULL )
		OR
	 ( ( :param.equipclass IS NOT NULL AND :param.category IS NULL ) AND ( ( s.stw_obclass = :param.equipclass AND s.stw_obclass_org = :param.equipclassorg ) AND s.stw_object IS NULL ) )
	 	OR
	 ( ( :param.equipclass IS NOT NULL AND :param.category IS NOT NULL ) AND ( s.stw_obclass = :param.equipclass AND s.stw_obclass_org = :param.equipclassorg AND coalesce(s.stw_object, :param.category) =:param.category ) ) )
AND    s.stw_org     = u1.uog_org
AND    u1.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND    u1.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND (  u1.uog_common  = '+' OR u1.uog_org = :control.org )
AND    s.stw_jobtype = u.uco_code
AND    u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'
AND    ((:param.pagemode = 'display' AND u.uco_rcode IN ('*','ST','BR', 'CAL','RP'))
		OR
	(:param.pagemode = 'view' AND ((:param.rjobtype IN ('*','BR') AND u.uco_rcode IN ('BR', '*')) OR  (:param.rjobtype NOT IN ('*','BR') AND u.uco_rcode = :param.rjobtype))))
and ( exists ( select 'x' from r5jobtypeauth j
	       where j.jta_jobtype = s.stw_jobtype
	       and ((:param.pagemode = 'display' and j.jta_insert = '+') OR ((:param.pagemode = 'view' AND j.jta_update = '+')))

FROM r5groups g 
INNER JOIN r5permissions pm ON g.ugr_code = pm.prm_group
INNER JOIN r5extmenus m ON m.emn_group = pm.prm_group AND m.emn_function = pm.prm_function 
INNER JOIN r5extmenulang ml ON ml.eml_extmenu = m.emn_parent AND ml.eml_lang = :parameter.language
LEFT JOIN r5extmenus p ON p.emn_code = m.emn_parent 
LEFT JOIN r5extmenulang pl ON pl.eml_extmenu = p.emn_parent AND pl.eml_lang = :parameter.language
LEFT JOIN r5extmenus t ON t.emn_code = p.emn_parent 
LEFT JOIN r5extmenulang tl ON tl.eml_extmenu = t.emn_parent AND tl.eml_lang = :parameter.language
LEFT JOIN r5extmenus x ON x.emn_code = t.emn_parent 
LEFT JOIN r5extmenulang xl ON xl.eml_extmenu = x.emn_parent AND xl.eml_lang = :parameter.language
INNER JOIN
      (SELECT trp_group     usergroup,
              trp_function  functionname,
              trp_tab       tab,
              ftb_seq       seq,
             (SELECT TOP 1 bot_text FROM r5boilertexts WHERE bot_fld1 = t.trp_tab AND bot_lang = :parameter.language AND bot_function = t.trp_function AND bot_dest='TB') tabname,
              trp_sysrequired tabalwaysdisplayed,
              trp_visible tabavailable,
             (SELECT dds_ddspyname FROM r5dddataspy WHERE dds_ddspyid = trp_securityddspyid) securityfilter,
              CASE trp_select WHEN '?' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END selectpermission,
              CASE trp_insert WHEN '+' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END insertpermission,
              CASE trp_update WHEN '*' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END updatepermission,
              CASE trp_delete WHEN 'X' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END deletepermission
       FROM   r5tabpermissions t,
              r5functiontabs ft
       WHERE  ft.ftb_function = t.trp_function
       AND    ft.ftb_tab      = t.trp_tab
       UNION ALL
       SELECT prm_group, prm_function, NULL, 0, NULL,
              '+','+',
             (SELECT dds_ddspyname FROM r5dddataspy WHERE dds_ddspyid = prm_securityddspyid),
              CASE prm_select WHEN '?' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END selectpermission,
              CASE prm_insert WHEN '+' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END insertpermission,
              CASE prm_update WHEN '*' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END updatepermission,
              CASE prm_delete WHEN 'X' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END deletepermission
       FROM   r5permissions ) tb ON tb.usergroup = pm.prm_group AND tb.functionname = pm.prm_function
WHERE m.emn_type = 'S'
AND COALESCE( m.emn_hide, '-' ) = '-' 
AND COALESCE( p.emn_hide, '-' ) = '-' 
AND COALESCE( t.emn_hide, '-' ) = '-' 
AND COALESCE( x.emn_hide, '-' ) = '-' 
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'x'
                FROM   r5install 
                WHERE  ins_code  = 'EDITION'
                AND    ins_desc <> m.emn_meflag)

FROM r5groups g

INNER JOIN r5extmenus m ON m.emn_group = pm.prm_group AND m.emn_function = pm.prm_function

LEFT JOIN r5extmenus p ON p.emn_code = m.emn_parent 
LEFT JOIN r5extmenulang pl ON pl.eml_extmenu = p.emn_parent AND pl.eml_lang = :parameter.language
LEFT JOIN r5extmenus t ON t.emn_code = p.emn_parent 
LEFT JOIN r5extmenulang tl ON tl.eml_extmenu = t.emn_parent AND tl.eml_lang = :parameter.language
LEFT JOIN r5extmenus x ON x.emn_code = t.emn_parent 
LEFT JOIN r5extmenulang xl ON xl.eml_extmenu = x.emn_parent AND xl.eml_lang = :parameter.language
INNER JOIN
      (SELECT trp_group     usergroup,
              trp_function  functionname,
              trp_tab       tab,
              ftb_seq       seq,
             (SELECT DISTINCT bot_text FROM r5boilertexts WHERE bot_fld1 = t.trp_tab AND bot_lang = :parameter.language AND bot_function = t.trp_function AND bot_dest='TB') tabname,
              trp_sysrequired tabalwaysdisplayed,
              trp_visible tabavailable,
             (SELECT dds_ddspyname FROM r5dddataspy WHERE dds_ddspyid = trp_securityddspyid) securityfilter,
              DECODE(trp_select,'?','+','-') selectpermission,
              DECODE(trp_insert,'+','+','-') insertpermission,
              DECODE(trp_update,'*','+','-') updatepermission,
              DECODE(trp_delete,'X','+','-') deletepermission
       FROM   r5tabpermissions t,
              r5functiontabs ft
       WHERE  ft.ftb_function = t.trp_function
       AND    ft.ftb_tab      = t.trp_tab
       UNION ALL
       SELECT prm_group, prm_function, NULL, 0, NULL,
              '+','+',
             (SELECT dds_ddspyname FROM r5dddataspy WHERE dds_ddspyid = prm_securityddspyid),
              DECODE(prm_select,'?','+','-') selectpermission,
              DECODE(prm_insert,'+','+','-') insertpermission,
              DECODE(prm_update,'*','+','-') updatepermission,
              DECODE(prm_delete,'X','+','-') deletepermission
       FROM   r5permissions ) tb ON tb.usergroup = pm.prm_group AND tb.functionname = pm.prm_function
WHERE m.emn_type = 'S'
AND ( m.emn_hide IS NULL OR m.emn_hide = '-' )
