rows.GRD_DESC: MS Project lookup for Work Orders with at least one Activity
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5events e right outer join r5descriptions d on (d.des_rentity = 'EVNT'
							AND       d.des_lang =:parameter.language
							AND       d.des_code = e.evt_code)
WHERE ((COALESCE(:param.hideawaitingrelease,'false') = 'false' AND evt_rstatus = 'A') OR (evt_rstatus = 'R'))
AND       e.evt_rtype IN ( 'JOB', 'PPM' )
AND       COALESCE(e.evt_mpproj,'-') = '-'
AND       NOT EXISTS (SELECT u.uco_code FROM r5ucodes u WHERE u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP' and u.uco_rcode IN ('ST', 'MEC') and u.uco_code = e.evt_jobtype)
AND (exists (select 'x'
                 from   r5install I
                 where  i.ins_code = 'JTAUTH'
                 and    upper( i.ins_desc ) not in ( 'YES', '+' ) )
       or exists (select 'x'
               from   r5jobtypeauth j
               where  j.jta_jobtype = e.evt_jobtype
               and    j.jta_status  = e.evt_status
               and    j.jta_update = '+'
               and    (j.jta_group= '*' or j.jta_group in (select uog_group
                                                           from   r5userorganization
                                                           where  uog_user = :parameter.r5user
                                                           and    uog_role = :parameter.r5role )))
       or (exists (select 'x'
               from   r5jobtypeauth j
               where  j.jta_jobtype = e.evt_jobtype
               and    j.jta_status  = 'ALLSTATS'
               and    j.jta_update = '+'
               and    (j.jta_group= '*' or j.jta_group in (select uog_group
                                                           from   r5userorganization
                                                           where  uog_user = :parameter.r5user
                                                           and    uog_role = :parameter.r5role )))
        and not exists (select 'x'
                        from   r5jobtypeauth j
                        where  j.jta_jobtype = e.evt_jobtype
                        and    j.jta_status  = e.evt_status
                        and    (j.jta_group= '*' or j.jta_group in (select uog_group
                                                           from   r5userorganization
                                                           where  uog_user = :parameter.r5user
                                                           and    uog_role = :parameter.r5role )))))
AND       EXISTS (SELECT null from r5activities a WHERE a.act_event = e.evt_code AND ((COALESCE(:param.showhiredlabor, '') = 'true') OR (COALESCE(a.act_hire, '-') = '-')) AND COALESCE(a.act_completed, '-') = '-' AND COALESCE(a.act_defermaintenance, '-') = '-' )
AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR
(evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5events e right outer join r5descriptions d on (d.des_rentity = 'EVNT'
							AND       d.des_lang =:parameter.language
							AND       d.des_code = e.evt_code)
WHERE e.evt_org  = :control.org
AND       ((COALESCE(:param.hideawaitingrelease,'false') = 'false' AND evt_rstatus = 'A') OR (evt_rstatus = 'R'))
AND       e.evt_rtype IN ( 'JOB', 'PPM' )
AND       COALESCE(e.evt_mpproj,'-') = '-'
AND       NOT EXISTS (SELECT u.uco_code FROM r5ucodes u WHERE u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP' and u.uco_rcode IN ('ST', 'MEC') and u.uco_code = e.evt_jobtype)
AND (exists (select 'x'
                 from   r5install I
                 where  i.ins_code = 'JTAUTH'
                 and    upper( i.ins_desc ) not in ( 'YES', '+' ) )
       or exists (select 'x'
               from   r5jobtypeauth j
               where  j.jta_jobtype = e.evt_jobtype
               and    j.jta_status  = e.evt_status
               and    j.jta_update = '+'
               and    (j.jta_group= '*' or j.jta_group in (select uog_group
                                                           from   r5userorganization
                                                           where  uog_user = :parameter.r5user
                                                           and    uog_role = :parameter.r5role )))
       or (exists (select 'x'
               from   r5jobtypeauth j
               where  j.jta_jobtype = e.evt_jobtype
               and    j.jta_status  = 'ALLSTATS'
               and    j.jta_update = '+'
               and    (j.jta_group= '*' or j.jta_group in (select uog_group
                                                           from   r5userorganization
                                                           where  uog_user = :parameter.r5user
                                                           and    uog_role = :parameter.r5role )))
        and not exists (select 'x'
                        from   r5jobtypeauth j
                        where  j.jta_jobtype = e.evt_jobtype
                        and    j.jta_status  = e.evt_status
                        and    (j.jta_group= '*' or j.jta_group in (select uog_group
                                                           from   r5userorganization
                                                           where  uog_user = :parameter.r5user
                                                           and    uog_role = :parameter.r5role )))))
AND       EXISTS (SELECT null from r5activities a WHERE a.act_event = e.evt_code AND ((COALESCE(:param.showhiredlabor, '') = 'true') OR (COALESCE(a.act_hire, '-') = '-')) AND COALESCE(a.act_completed, '-') = '-' AND COALESCE(a.act_defermaintenance, '-') = '-' )
AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR
(evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))

 AND obj_rstatus <>'D' 
AND CASE WHEN obj_notused IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE obj_notused END <> '+' 
AND obj_obrtype <> 'C'  
AND (oud_meter is not null AND oud_uom is not null) 
 AND ( obj_code=:parameter.equipment OR :parameter.equipment is null ) 
AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR 
(EXISTS( SELECT  1  FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = (CASE WHEN :param.loantodept = 'true' THEN COALESCE(obj_loaneddept, obj_mrc) ELSE obj_mrc END)  AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5boilertexts ,
	(
		select b.rea_object, b.rea_object_org, b.rea_calcuom, max(c.rea_reading) rea_reading, b.rea_meter 
		  from (
					select	rea_object, 
							rea_object_org, 
							rea_calcuom, 
							max(rea_date) "LAST_READING_DATE" ,
							rea_meter
					  from r5readings 
					group by rea_object, rea_object_org, rea_calcuom, rea_meter
				) b, 
				r5readings c 
		  where b.rea_object=c.rea_object and 
				b.rea_object_org=c.rea_object_org and 
				b.rea_calcuom=c.rea_calcuom and 
				b."LAST_READING_DATE"=c.rea_date and
				b.rea_meter=c.rea_meter
group by b.rea_object, b.rea_object_org, b.rea_calcuom, b.rea_meter
	) d right outer join r5objusagedefs a on (	d.rea_object = a.oud_object and 
												d.rea_object_org = a.oud_object_org and 
												d.rea_calcuom = a.oud_uom and
												d.rea_meter = a.oud_meter
											)
	left outer join r5meters on ( oud_meter = met_code ) 
where  
	a.oud_object= :parameter.object and 
	bot_function = 'OSEQMR' and 
	bot_lang = :parameter.language and 
	bot_fld1 = CASE oud_parent + oud_child WHEN '++' THEN 'PARENTANDCHILD' WHEN '+-' THEN 'PARENT' WHEN '-+' THEN 'CHILD' ELSE 'STANDALONE' END
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
from r5boilertexts ,

		select b.rea_object, b.rea_object_org, b.rea_calcuom, max(c.rea_reading) rea_reading, b.rea_meter
		  from (
					select	rea_object,
							rea_object_org,
							rea_calcuom,
							max(rea_date) "LAST_READING_DATE" ,
							rea_meter
					  from r5readings
					group by rea_object, rea_object_org, rea_calcuom, rea_meter
				) b,
				r5readings c
		  where b.rea_object=c.rea_object and
				b.rea_object_org=c.rea_object_org and
				b.rea_calcuom=c.rea_calcuom and
				b."LAST_READING_DATE"=c.rea_date and
				b.rea_meter=c.rea_meter
group by b.rea_object,  b.rea_object_org, b.rea_calcuom, b.rea_meter
	) d right outer join r5objusagedefs a on (	d.rea_object = a.oud_object and
												d.rea_object_org = a.oud_object_org and
												d.rea_calcuom = a.oud_uom and

WHERE tou_event=e.evt_code
AND e.evt_jobtype='MEC'
AND EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM  r5events p
   WHERE e.evt_parent = p.evt_code
   AND p.evt_rstatus = 'R'
   AND p.evt_rtype IN ('JOB','PPM')
   AND
   (
      (  COALESCE(:parameter.womrc,'N') <> 'Y'
         AND
         (  EXISTS
            (  SELECT 1
               FROM r5personnel
               WHERE per_user = :parameter.r5user
               AND p.evt_person = per_code
            )
            OR EXISTS
            (  SELECT 1
               FROM r5actschedules, r5personnel
               WHERE acs_event = p.evt_code
               AND per_user = :parameter.r5user
               AND acs_responsible = per_code
            )
         )
      )
      OR
      (  COALESCE(:parameter.womrc,'N') = 'Y'
         AND (p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc1 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc2 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc3 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc4 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc5 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc6 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc7 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc8 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc9 OR p.evt_mrc LIKE :parameter.wmrc10)

)

rows.GRD_DESC: Monitored Data Results Tab for Work Order
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM  r5eventpoints e
LEFT  OUTER JOIN r5objects o
ON    (o.obj_code = e.epo_object AND 
       o.obj_org  = e.epo_object_org AND
       o.obj_obrtype IN ('A', 'P', 'S'))
LEFT  OUTER JOIN r5points p
ON    (((e.epo_object = p.poi_object AND e.epo_object_org = p.poi_object_org) 
      OR  (p.poi_object = o.obj_category AND p.poi_object_org = '*' 
      AND  NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM r5points p1
      WHERE  e.epo_object = p1.poi_object
      AND    e.epo_object_org = p1.poi_object_org
      AND    e.epo_point = p1.poi_point
      AND    e.epo_pointtype = p1.poi_pointtype))) 
      AND  e.epo_point = p.poi_point    
      AND  e.epo_pointtype = p.poi_pointtype )
WHERE  e.epo_event = :param.workordernum

rows.GRD_DESC: Multi Select Parts LOV in Parts for Packages
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM   r5parts, r5events, r5transtock
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5orderlines ON ( orl_order = tst_order AND orl_order_org = tst_order_org AND orl_ordline = tst_ordline )
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects ON ( obj_code = tst_object AND obj_org = tst_object_org )
WHERE  tst_torentity = 'EVNT'
AND    tst_tocode    = evt_code
AND    par_code      = tst_part
AND    par_org       = tst_part_org 
AND    evt_org       = :parameter.org
AND    tst_qty - ( SELECT COALESCE( SUM( pkl_qty ), 0 ) 
                   FROM   r5package, r5packagelines
                   WHERE  pkg_code = pkl_package
                   AND    pkg_rstatus IN ( 'A', 'U' )
                   AND    pkg_code <> :param.packagecode
                   AND    pkl_helditem = tst_pkey ) > 0
AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5packagelines WHERE pkl_package = :param.packagecode  AND pkl_helditem = tst_pkey )

FROM   r5parts, r5events, r5userorganization, r5transtock
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5orderlines ON ( orl_order = tst_order AND orl_order_org = tst_order_org AND orl_ordline = tst_ordline )
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects ON ( obj_code = tst_object AND obj_org = tst_object_org )
WHERE  tst_torentity = 'EVNT'
AND    tst_tocode    = evt_code
AND    par_code      = tst_part
AND    par_org       = tst_part_org
AND    evt_org       = :parameter.org
AND uog_org = evt_org
AND uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND    tst_qty - ( SELECT COALESCE( SUM( pkl_qty ), 0 )
                   FROM   r5package, r5packagelines
                   WHERE  pkg_code = pkl_package
                   AND    pkg_rstatus IN ( 'A', 'U' )
                   AND    pkg_code <> :param.packagecode
                   AND    pkl_helditem = tst_pkey ) > 0
AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5packagelines WHERE pkl_package = :param.packagecode AND pkl_helditem = tst_pkey )

FROM  r5objects, r5organization, r5nonconformitysetup, r5nonconformities n, r5nonconformities n2
WHERE obj_code      = n.ncf_object 
AND   obj_org       = n.ncf_object_org 
AND   org_code      = n.ncf_org
AND   n.ncf_org     = n2.ncf_org
AND   n2.ncf_org    = ncp_org 
AND   n2.ncf_code   = :parameter.nonconformity
AND   n.ncf_code   <> n2.ncf_code
AND   n.ncf_rstatus = 'O'  
AND   n.ncf_mergedinto IS NULL 
AND   ( :parameter.deptsec = 'OFF' OR 
        EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user = :parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = n.ncf_mrc AND COALESCE( dse_readonly, '-' ) = '-' ) )
AND   ( 
		(     COALESCE( ncp_mergerestrictions, 'U' ) = 'SE' 
          AND n.ncf_object     = n2.ncf_object 
          AND n.ncf_object_org = n2.ncf_object_org ) 
        OR 
        (     COALESCE( ncp_mergerestrictions, 'U' ) = 'ST' 
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_ncttype, n2.ncf_ncttype, 'x' )         = COALESCE(n2.ncf_ncttype, n.ncf_ncttype, 'x' ) 
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_ncttype_org, n2.ncf_ncttype_org, 'x' ) = COALESCE(n2.ncf_ncttype_org, n.ncf_ncttype_org, 'x' ) )
        OR 
        (     COALESCE( ncp_mergerestrictions, 'U' ) = 'SP' 
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_syslevel, n2.ncf_syslevel, '!@#$%^&*' )   = COALESCE( n2.ncf_syslevel, n.ncf_syslevel, '!@#$%^&*' ) 
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_asmlevel, n2.ncf_asmlevel, '!@#$%^&*' )   = COALESCE( n2.ncf_asmlevel, n.ncf_asmlevel, '!@#$%^&*' )
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_complevel, n2.ncf_complevel, '!@#$%^&*' ) = COALESCE( n2.ncf_complevel, n.ncf_complevel, '!@#$%^&*' )
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_part, n2.ncf_part, 'x' )                  = COALESCE( n2.ncf_part, n.ncf_part, 'x' )
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_part_org, n2.ncf_part_org, 'x' )          = COALESCE( n2.ncf_part_org, n.ncf_part_org, 'x' )
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_matltype, n2.ncf_matltype, 'x' )          = COALESCE( n2.ncf_matltype, n.ncf_matltype, 'x' ) )
        OR 
        (     COALESCE( ncp_mergerestrictions, 'U' ) = 'R' 
          AND n.ncf_object     = n2.ncf_object 
          AND n.ncf_object_org = n2.ncf_object_org
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_ncttype, n2.ncf_ncttype, 'x' )            = COALESCE( n2.ncf_ncttype, n.ncf_ncttype, 'x' ) 
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_ncttype_org, n2.ncf_ncttype_org, 'x' )    = COALESCE( n2.ncf_ncttype_org, n.ncf_ncttype_org, 'x' )

          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_complevel, n2.ncf_complevel, '!@#$%^&*' ) = COALESCE( n2.ncf_complevel, n.ncf_complevel, '!@#$%^&*' )

        EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user = :parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = n.ncf_mrc AND COALESCE( dse_readonly, '-' ) = '-' ) )
AND   ( 
		(     COALESCE( ncp_mergerestrictions, 'U' ) = 'SE' 
          AND n.ncf_object     = n2.ncf_object 
          AND n.ncf_object_org = n2.ncf_object_org ) 
        OR 
        (     COALESCE( ncp_mergerestrictions, 'U' ) = 'ST' 
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_ncttype, n2.ncf_ncttype, 'x' )         = COALESCE(n2.ncf_ncttype, n.ncf_ncttype, 'x' ) 
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_ncttype_org, n2.ncf_ncttype_org, 'x' ) = COALESCE(n2.ncf_ncttype_org, n.ncf_ncttype_org, 'x' ) )
        OR 
        (     COALESCE( ncp_mergerestrictions, 'U' ) = 'SP' 
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_syslevel, n2.ncf_syslevel, '!@#$%^&*' )   = COALESCE( n2.ncf_syslevel, n.ncf_syslevel, '!@#$%^&*' ) 
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_asmlevel, n2.ncf_asmlevel, '!@#$%^&*' )   = COALESCE( n2.ncf_asmlevel, n.ncf_asmlevel, '!@#$%^&*' )
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_complevel, n2.ncf_complevel, '!@#$%^&*' ) = COALESCE( n2.ncf_complevel, n.ncf_complevel, '!@#$%^&*' )
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_part, n2.ncf_part, 'x' )                  = COALESCE( n2.ncf_part, n.ncf_part, 'x' )
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_part_org, n2.ncf_part_org, 'x' )          = COALESCE( n2.ncf_part_org, n.ncf_part_org, 'x' )
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_matltype, n2.ncf_matltype, 'x' )          = COALESCE( n2.ncf_matltype, n.ncf_matltype, 'x' ) )
        OR 
        (     COALESCE( ncp_mergerestrictions, 'U' ) = 'R' 
          AND n.ncf_object     = n2.ncf_object 
          AND n.ncf_object_org = n2.ncf_object_org
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_ncttype, n2.ncf_ncttype, 'x' )            = COALESCE( n2.ncf_ncttype, n.ncf_ncttype, 'x' ) 
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_ncttype_org, n2.ncf_ncttype_org, 'x' )    = COALESCE( n2.ncf_ncttype_org, n.ncf_ncttype_org, 'x' ) 
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_syslevel, n2.ncf_syslevel, '!@#$%^&*' )   = COALESCE( n2.ncf_syslevel, n.ncf_syslevel, '!@#$%^&*' ) 
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_asmlevel, n2.ncf_asmlevel, '!@#$%^&*' )   = COALESCE( n2.ncf_asmlevel, n.ncf_asmlevel, '!@#$%^&*' )
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_complevel, n2.ncf_complevel, '!@#$%^&*' ) = COALESCE( n2.ncf_complevel, n.ncf_complevel, '!@#$%^&*' )
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_part, n2.ncf_part, 'x' )                  = COALESCE( n2.ncf_part, n.ncf_part, 'x' )
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_part_org, n2.ncf_part_org, 'x' )          = COALESCE( n2.ncf_part_org, n.ncf_part_org, 'x' )
          AND COALESCE( n.ncf_matltype, n2.ncf_matltype, 'x' )          = COALESCE( n2.ncf_matltype, n.ncf_matltype, 'x' ) )
        OR

rows.GRD_DESC: Operator Checklist Tab For Field Filter Setup
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from  r5fldfilteroprchecklist,r5tasks,r5tabpermissions, r5userorganization
where  ffo_function = :parameter.screencode
and tsk_code = ffo_task
and uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role
and uog_group = trp_group
and trp_select = '?'
and trp_function= :parameter.userfunction
and trp_tab = 'FFO'
and uog_org = tsk_org

FROM r5tasks t
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5fldfilteroprchecklist ON 
  ffo_task = t.tsk_code
  AND ffo_function = :parameter.userfunction
  AND ffo_obj_class IN (:param.equipclass, '*')
  AND ffo_obj_class_org IN (:param.equipclassorg, '*')
WHERE t.tsk_revrstatus = 'A'
  AND  COALESCE(t.tsk_notused, '-') <> '+'
  AND  COALESCE(t.tsk_isolationmethod, '-') = '-' 
  AND  COALESCE(t.tsk_casemanagementchecklist, '-') = '-' 
  AND  COALESCE(t.tsk_nonconformitychecklist, '-') = '-' 
  AND  COALESCE(t.tsk_jobplan, '-') = '-'
  AND tsk_performby2resp IS NULL
  AND (
      t.tsk_performbyresp IS NULL OR
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userresponsibilities WHERE urs_responsibility = t.tsk_performbyresp and urs_user = :parameter.r5user)
  )
  AND t.tsk_code = CASE WHEN :param.equipmentcode IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM r5fldfilteroprchecklist WHERE ffo_obj_class IN (:param.equipclass, '*') AND ffo_obj_class_org IN (:param.equipclassorg, '*') AND ffo_function = :parameter.userfunction
  ) THEN ffo_task ELSE t.tsk_code END
   AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM r5taskchecklists WHERE tch_task = t.tsk_code AND tch_taskrev = t.tsk_revision  AND COALESCE(tch_notused, '-') = '-' AND COALESCE(t.tsk_activechecklist, '-') = '+'
      UNION 
      SELECT 1 FROM r5tasks, r5taskchecklists, r5taskplanjobs WHERE tpj_task = t.tsk_code AND tsk_code = tpj_jobplan AND tsk_revision = tpj_taskrev AND tch_task = tpj_jobplan AND tch_taskrev = tpj_taskrev AND COALESCE(tch_notused, '-') = '-' AND COALESCE(tsk_jobplan, '-') = '+' AND COALESCE(tsk_activechecklist, '-') = '+'
   )
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5userorganization u, r5tasks t
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5fldfilteroprchecklist ON
	ffo_task = t.tsk_code
	AND ffo_function = :parameter.userfunction
	AND ffo_obj_class IN (:param.equipclass, '*')
	AND ffo_obj_class_org IN (:param.equipclassorg, '*')
WHERE t.tsk_revrstatus = 'A'
	AND t.tsk_org = u.uog_org
	AND u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
	AND u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
	AND (u.uog_common = '+' OR u.uog_org = :control.org)
	AND	COALESCE(t.tsk_notused, '-') <> '+'
	AND	COALESCE(t.tsk_isolationmethod, '-') = '-'
    AND COALESCE(t.tsk_casemanagementchecklist, '-') = '-'
    AND COALESCE(t.tsk_nonconformitychecklist, '-') = '-'
	AND	COALESCE(t.tsk_jobplan, '-') = '-'
	AND tsk_performby2resp IS NULL
         AND (
 		t.tsk_performbyresp IS NULL OR
		EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userresponsibilities WHERE urs_responsibility = t.tsk_performbyresp and urs_user = :parameter.r5user)
	)
	AND t.tsk_code =  CASE WHEN :param.equipmentcode IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
		SELECT 1 FROM  r5fldfilteroprchecklist WHERE ffo_obj_class IN (:param.equipclass, '*') AND ffo_obj_class_org IN (:param.equipclassorg, '*') AND  ffo_function = :parameter.userfunction
	AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM r5tasks, r5userorganization WHERE uog_user = :parameter.r5user AND tsk_org = uog_org AND tsk_code = ffo_task )
	) THEN ffo_task ELSE t.tsk_code END
   AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM r5taskchecklists where tch_task = t.tsk_code AND tch_taskrev = t.tsk_revision  AND COALESCE(tch_notused, '-') = '-' AND COALESCE(t.tsk_activechecklist, '-') = '+'
      UNION
            SELECT 1 FROM r5tasks, r5taskchecklists, r5taskplanjobs WHERE tpj_task = t.tsk_code AND tsk_code = tpj_jobplan AND tsk_revision = tpj_taskrev AND tch_task = tpj_jobplan AND tch_taskrev = tpj_taskrev AND COALESCE(tch_notused, '-') = '-' AND COALESCE(tsk_jobplan, '-') = '+' AND COALESCE(tsk_activechecklist, '-') = '+'
   )

FROM R5PARTS,R5STOCK 
	 LEFT OUTER JOIN 
	 	  R5ONREQUI ON STO_PART = ORE_PART AND STO_PART_ORG = ORE_PART_ORG AND STO_STORE = ORE_STORE
	 LEFT OUTER JOIN
	 	  R5ONORDER ON STO_PART = ONO_PART AND STO_PART_ORG = ONO_PART_ORG AND STO_STORE = ONO_STORE
	 LEFT OUTER JOIN
	        (SELECT SUM(TST_QTY) INTRANSITQTY, TST_TOCODE FROM R5TRANSTOCK WHERE TST_PART = :partcode AND TST_PART_ORG = :partorg AND TST_ORDER IS NULL GROUP BY TST_TOCODE) transtock ON STO_STORE = transtock.TST_TOCODE
      LEFT OUTER JOIN 
       (SELECT SUM( RQL_QTY - COALESCE( RQL_RECVQTY, 0 ) - COALESCE( RQL_SCRAPQTY, 0 )) STSTQTY, REQ_FROMCODE FROM R5REQUISLINES , R5REQUISITIONS  WHERE REQ_CODE = RQL_REQ AND RQL_RSTATUS IN ( 'U', 'R', 'A' ) AND RQL_ACTIVE = '+' AND REQ_RTYPE  = 'STST' AND RQL_PART = :partcode  AND RQL_PART_ORG = :partorg AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 'x' FROM   R5TRANSACTIONS  WHERE  TRA_RTYPE = 'I' AND TRA_FROMRENTITY='STOR' AND TRA_TORENTITY='STOR' AND TRA_REQ = RQL_REQ) GROUP BY REQ_FROMCODE) storetostore ON STO_STORE = storetostore.REQ_FROMCODE
      LEFT OUTER JOIN
       (SELECT SUM(PIP_QTY - COALESCE(PIP_ISSUEQTY,0)) ONPICKLISTQTY, PIC_STORE FROM R5PICKLISTPARTS, R5PICKLISTS WHERE PIC_RSTATUS = 'A' AND PIC_CODE = PIP_PICKLIST AND PIP_PART = :partcode AND PIP_PART_ORG = :partorg AND PIP_QTY > COALESCE(PIP_ISSUEQTY,0) GROUP BY PIC_STORE) picklist ON STO_STORE = picklist.PIC_STORE
      LEFT OUTER JOIN
       (SELECT SUM(RES_QTY) RESQTY, SUM( RES_ALLQTY) ALLQTY, RES_STORE FROM   R5RESERVATIONS WHERE  RES_PART = :partcode AND RES_PART_ORG = :partorg GROUP BY RES_STORE) reservations ON STO_STORE = reservations.RES_STORE,
      R5STORES
WHERE   (STO_PART = :partcode OR ( COALESCE(par_trackbycondition ,'-') = '+' AND par_parentpart = :partcode ))    
AND STO_PART_ORG = :partorg 
AND STO_STORE = STR_CODE
AND STO_PART = par_code 
AND STO_PART_ORG = par_org

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5functions f, r5objects, r5tabpermissions p
 right outer join r5userorganization u
    on (p.trp_group = u.uog_group AND
       p.trp_function = :parameter.userfunction AND
       p.trp_tab = :parameter.tabname), r5ppms
  LEFT OUTER JOIN (select oud_uom
                     from r5objusagedefs
                    where oud_object = :parameter.equipment
                      and oud_object_org = :parameter.equipmentorg
                      AND COALESCE(oud_updownmeter, '-') <> '+') a
    ON (a.oud_uom = ppm_metuom)
  LEFT OUTER JOIN (select oud_uom
                     from r5objusagedefs
                    where oud_object = :parameter.equipment
                      and oud_object_org = :parameter.equipmentorg
                      AND COALESCE(oud_updownmeter, '-') <> '+') b
    ON (b.oud_uom = ppm_metuom2)
 where ppm_notused = '-'
   AND ppm_plan IS NULL
   AND ppm_revrstatus = 'A'
   AND u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
   AND u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
   AND ppm_org = u.uog_org
   AND (u.uog_common = '+' or u.uog_org = :control.organization)
   AND f.fun_code = :parameter.userfunction
   AND case
         when p.trp_function is null then
          f.fun_insert
         else
          p.trp_insert
       end = '+'
   AND (p.trp_function is not null or f.fun_public = '!')
   and obj_code = :parameter.equipment
   and obj_org = :parameter.equipmentorg

                      and oud_object_org = :parameter.equipmentorg
                      AND COALESCE(oud_updownmeter, '-') <> '+') a

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from R5MP2POHEADER b , R5MP2PURREQ
where ZDP_UPCODE   	 = :param.upcode
and   ZDP_SEQNUM	 = :param.seqnum
and   ZDP_CLOSEDATE  = :param.closedate
and   ZCY_UPCODE   	 = ZDP_UPCODE
and   ZCY_PURCHASINGCENTERID = ZDP_PURCHASINGCENTERID
and   ZCY_PONUM      = ZDP_PONUM
and   ZCY_RELEASENUM = ZDP_RELEASENUM
and   ZCY_CLOSEDATE  = ZDP_CLOSEDATE

FROM r5orderlines o LEFT OUTER JOIN r5activities  ON (act_event = o.orl_event  AND act_act = o.orl_act)  LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events  e  ON  (evt_code = act_event)   
WHERE o.orl_order = :purchaseorder
AND o.orl_order_org = :purchaseorderorg
AND
(
	(
		:parameter.invoicetype IN ('C','D') 
		AND EXISTS 
			(SELECT 1 FROM r5invoicelines i
				WHERE i.ivl_invoice = :parameter.parentinvoice
					AND i.ivl_invoice_org = :parameter.parentinvoiceorganization
					AND i.ivl_order = o.orl_order
					AND i.ivl_order_org = o.orl_order_org
					AND i.ivl_ordline = o.orl_ordline
					AND NOT( orl_allowprepayment = '+' AND :parameter.isinvoicereturn = '-1' AND orl_invqty <1 ) 
					AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5invoicelines j
								WHERE j.ivl_invoice = :parameter.invoicecode AND j.ivl_invoice_org = :parameter.invoiceorganization AND j.ivl_ordline = i.ivl_ordline))
	)
	OR
	(
		:parameter.invoicetype NOT IN ('C','D')
		AND EXISTS 
			(SELECT 1 from r5importpolinesvw v 
				WHERE v.orl_order = o.orl_order 
					AND v.orl_order_org = o.orl_order_org  
					AND v.orl_supplier = o.orl_supplier 
					AND v.orl_supplier_org = o.orl_supplier_org 
					AND v.orl_ordline = o.orl_ordline)
	)
)
FROM r5orders o  WHERE o.ord_supplier = isnull( :parameter.suppliercode, o.ord_supplier )  AND       o.ord_store LIKE isnull( :parameter.storecode, o.ord_store )  AND       o.ord_rstatus = 'U'

rows.GRD_DESC: Parent Closing Code and Child Closing Code Lookup
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM ( SELECT rqm_code rqm_code, 'RECO' rqm_type
       FROM r5requircodes
       WHERE COALESCE( rqm_notused, '-' ) <> '+'
       UNION
       SELECT cau_code rqm_code, 'CAUS' rqm_type
       FROM r5causes
       WHERE COALESCE( cau_notused, '-' ) <> '+'
       UNION
       SELECT fal_code rqm_code, 'FAIL' rqm_type
       FROM r5failures
       WHERE COALESCE( fal_notused, '-' ) <> '+'
       UNION
       SELECT acc_code rqm_code, 'ACCO' rqm_type
       FROM r5actioncodes
       WHERE COALESCE( acc_notused, '-' ) <> '+' ) r
WHERE (( COALESCE( :parameter.isclosingcodeparent, 'false' ) = 'true'
        AND rqm_type <> 'ACCO' )
OR    ( COALESCE( :parameter.parenttype, '#' ) = 'RECO'
        AND rqm_type IN ( 'CAUS', 'FAIL', 'ACCO' ))
OR    ( COALESCE( :parameter.parenttype, '#' ) = 'FAIL'
        AND rqm_type IN ( 'CAUS', 'ACCO' ))
OR    ( COALESCE( :parameter.parenttype, '#' ) = 'CAUS'
        AND rqm_type = 'ACCO' )
OR    ( COALESCE( :parameter.showallclosingcodes, 'false' ) = 'true' ))

rows.GRD_DESC: Part Conditions LOV on Parts for Work Order Screen
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM   r5descriptions, r5partctplconditions, r5parts
WHERE  par_conditiontpl = ptc_template
AND    par_conditiontpl_org  = ptc_template_org
AND    par_condition = ptc_condition
AND    COALESCE(par_notused, '-') <> '+'
AND    par_code <> '*'
AND    (par_parentpart = :parameter.partcode OR par_parentpart = :parameter.parentpart)
AND    par_org  = :parameter.partorganization
AND    des_code = ptc_template + '#'  + ptc_condition
AND    des_org = ptc_template_org
AND    des_lang =  :parameter.language
AND    des_rentity = 'CPCT'
AND    COALESCE(ptc_preventissue,'-') <> '+'
AND    ptc_condition <> '*'
AND    (COALESCE(:parameter.filterbystock, 'false')= 'false' OR (COALESCE(:parameter.filterbystock, 'false') = 'true' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5stock WHERE sto_part = par_code AND sto_part_org = par_org AND (sto_store = :parameter.store OR :parameter.store IS NULL))))
AND   (:parameter.storesec = 'OFF'
      OR COALESCE(:parameter.checkstoresecurity, 'false') = 'false'
      OR ( :parameter.checkstoresecurity = 'true' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5storesecurity, r5stores, r5userorganization, r5stock
                 WHERE ssc_store = sto_store
                 AND   ssc_group = uog_group
                 AND   uog_user = :parameter.r5user
                 AND   uog_role = :parameter.r5role
                 AND   uog_org = str_org
                 AND   str_code = sto_store
                 AND   par_code = sto_part
                 AND   par_org = sto_part_org
                 AND COALESCE( ssc_issuereturn, '-' ) = '+' )))

FROM
(
      SELECT par_code, par_org,par_condition,  str_code,org_curr,sto_qty,
      CASE WHEN i.ins_desc = 'P' THEN
                                            (
                                                SELECT ppr_baseprice  FROM r5partprices
                                                WHERE ppr_part =par_code
                                                AND ppr_part_org =par_org AND ppr_org = str_org
                                            )
                                      ELSE (
                                                      SELECT sto_baseprice FROM r5stock WHERE sto_part =par_code
                                                      AND sto_part_org =par_org AND sto_store = str_code
                                            )
                                     END as stockprice,
      sto_repairqty,
      CASE WHEN  i.ins_desc = 'P' THEN
                                            (
                                                      SELECT ppr_corevalue FROM r5partprices
                                                      WHERE ppr_part =par_code
                                                      AND ppr_part_org =par_org AND ppr_org = str_org
                                            )
                                     ELSE (
                                                      SELECT sto_corevalue FROM r5stock
                                                      WHERE sto_part =par_code AND sto_part_org =par_org
                                                      AND sto_store = str_code
                                            )
                                     END  as corevalue

    (SELECT epa_pk,epa_partlocation,epa_syslevel,epa_asmlevel,epa_complevel,epa_part,epa_qty,epa_part_org, epa_uom,epa_comment,epa_entity,epa_code,epa_rentity,csr_code,par_condition,par_longdescription
     FROM r5entityparts o
     LEFT OUTER JOIN r5codestructure ON o.epa_syslevel = csr_strlevel1
                                     AND coalesce(o.epa_asmlevel, '-') = coalesce(csr_strlevel2, '-')
                                     AND coalesce(o.epa_complevel, '-') = coalesce(csr_strlevel3, '-')
                                     AND csr_rentity = 'ACT'
     LEFT OUTER JOIN r5parts ON epa_part = par_code 
                             AND epa_part_org = par_org
     WHERE epa_rentity = :param.entity
     AND epa_code = :param.valuecode
     UNION SELECT epa_pk,epa_partlocation,epa_syslevel,epa_asmlevel,epa_complevel,epa_part, epa_qty,epa_part_org,epa_uom,epa_comment,epa_entity,epa_code,epa_rentity,null,null,null
     FROM r5entityparts o
     WHERE :param.entity = 'OBJ'
     AND epa_rentity = 'OBJ'
     AND epa_code = (SELECT obj_category
                     FROM r5objects WITH (index(r5prik_obj))
                     WHERE obj_code = substring(:param.valuecode,1,CASE WHEN charindex('#', :param.valuecode) > 0 THEN charindex('#', :param.valuecode)-1 ELSE len(:param.valuecode) END)
                     AND obj_org = substring(:param.valuecode,charindex('#', :param.valuecode)+1,len(:param.valuecode)))
                     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                     FROM r5entityparts a
                                     WHERE a.epa_part = o.epa_part
                                     AND a.epa_part_org = o.epa_part_org
                                     AND a.epa_code = :param.valuecode
                                     AND a.epa_rentity = 'OBJ'))
o WHERE 1=1

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5parts p LEFT OUTER JOIN r5stock s
ON p.par_code = s.sto_part AND p.par_org = s.sto_part_org 
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5partctplconditions pc
ON p.par_conditiontpl = pc.ptc_template and p.par_conditiontpl_org = pc.ptc_template_org and p.par_condition = pc.ptc_condition
WHERE p.par_code <> '*' 
AND (p.par_parentpart IS NULL OR (p.par_parentpart IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(pc.ptc_preventissue, '-') <> '+'))
AND COALESCE(par_notused, '-') <> '+'  
AND ((s.sto_store = :parameter.store AND s.sto_part = p.par_code AND s.sto_part_org = p.par_org )
  OR ( '+' = CASE WHEN p.par_conditiontpl IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE CASE WHEN 
  EXISTS 
    (SELECT 1 FROM r5stock s2, r5parts p2, r5partctplconditions pc2
      WHERE s2.sto_part = p2.par_code 
      AND s2.sto_part_org = p2.par_org 
      AND s2.sto_store = :parameter.store 
      AND p2.par_parentpart = p.par_code 
      AND p2.par_org = p.par_org
      AND p2.par_conditiontpl = pc2.ptc_template
      AND p2.par_conditiontpl_org = pc2.ptc_template_org
      AND p2.par_condition = pc2.ptc_condition
      AND COALESCE(pc2.ptc_preventissue, '-') <> '+'
      ) THEN '+' ELSE '-' END END 
      ))

FROM r5userorganization u, r5parts p LEFT OUTER JOIN r5stock s

LEFT OUTER JOIN r5partctplconditions pc

rows.GRD_DESC: Part lookup on Internal Repair Receipts
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5repairbins r, r5joblines j
LEFT JOIN r5parts  ON (par_code = j.jbl_part AND par_org = j.jbl_part_org) 
 WHERE (j.jbl_active = '+' OR isnull(j.jbl_completedqty,0) <> isnull(j.jbl_recvqty, 0) + isnull(j.jbl_scrapqty,0 )) 
 AND       j.jbl_completedqty > isnull(j.jbl_recvqty, 0) + isnull(j.jbl_scrapqty,0 ) 
 AND       j.jbl_event = :param.workordercode 
 AND       r.rpb_event = j.jbl_event 
 AND       r.rpb_part  = j.jbl_part 
 AND       r.rpb_part_org = j.jbl_part_org
 AND       r.rpb_qty > 0 
 AND   (r.rpb_object IS NULL OR     r.rpb_object + '#' + r.rpb_object_org NOT IN             
 		(SELECT l.trl_object + '#' + l.trl_object_org 
 		FROM r5translines l, r5transactions t  
 		WHERE l.trl_rtype = 'RECV'  
 		AND   l.trl_event = :param.workordercode   
 		AND   l.trl_part = j.jbl_part    
 		AND   l.trl_part_org = j.jbl_part_org  
 		AND   t.tra_code = l.trl_trans   
 		AND   t.tra_fromrentity = 'EVNT' 
 		AND   t.tra_fromcode = l.trl_event   
 		AND   t.tra_rstatus IN ('R', 'U')))

 AND       j.jbl_completedqty > isnull(j.jbl_recvqty, 0) + isnull(j.jbl_scrapqty,0 ) 
 AND       j.jbl_event = :param.workordercode 
 AND       r.rpb_event = j.jbl_event 
 AND       r.rpb_part  = j.jbl_part 
 AND       r.rpb_part_org = j.jbl_part_org
 AND       r.rpb_qty > 0 
 AND   (r.rpb_object IS NULL OR     r.rpb_object + '#' + r.rpb_object_org NOT IN             
 		(SELECT l.trl_object + '#' + l.trl_object_org 
 		FROM r5translines l, r5transactions t  
 		WHERE l.trl_rtype = 'RECV'  
 		AND   l.trl_event = :param.workordercode   
 		AND   l.trl_part = j.jbl_part    
 		AND   l.trl_part_org = j.jbl_part_org

left outer join r5descriptions d on (d.des_rentity = 'PART' and d.des_lang = :parameter.language and d.des_code = p.par_code  )

AND ( :parameter.manupart = 'NO' OR( :parameter.manupart = 'YES' AND COALESCE(m.mfp_manufacturer,'!@#$%^&*') = COALESCE(:parameter.manufacturer,COALESCE(m.mfp_manufacturer,'!@#$%^&*') ) AND COALESCE(m.mfp_manufactpart,'!@#$%^&*')  = COALESCE(:parameter.manufacturerpart,COALESCE(m.mfp_manufactpart,'!@#$%^&*') ) ) )
AND (coalesce(:param.trackbycondition, 'false') = 'false' OR NOT (p.par_parentpart IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(p.par_trackbycondition, '-') = '+') )
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
from  r5parts p
left outer join r5partmfgs m on (m.mfp_part=p.par_code and m.mfp_part_org=p.par_org and m.mfp_notused = '-')
left outer join r5descriptions d on (d.des_rentity = 'PART' and d.des_lang = :parameter.language and p.par_code = d.des_code and p.par_org = d.des_org )
where exists (select 'X'
          from r5userorganization u, r5organization o
         where u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
           and u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role

           and ((coalesce(:parameter.bypassorg, 'true') = 'false' AND
               (u.uog_common = '+' or u.uog_org = o.org_code)) OR
               ((coalesce(:parameter.bypassorg, 'true') = 'true' AND
               (((o.org_common = '+') OR
               (o.org_common = '-' AND
               (u.uog_common = '+' OR u.uog_org = o.org_code)))))))) and
coalesce(p.par_notused, '-') <> '+'
and p.par_code <> '*'
AND COALESCE( m.mfp_notused, '-' ) = '-'
AND (coalesce(:param.kit, 'false') = 'false' or coalesce(p.par_kit, '-') <> '+')
AND ( (ISNULL(:param.reqlinertype, 'PS') <> 'RE' ) OR ( ISNULL(:param.reqlinertype,'PS') = 'RE' AND ISNULL(p.par_repairable, '-') = '+'))
AND ( :parameter.manupart = 'NO' OR( :parameter.manupart = 'YES' AND COALESCE(m.mfp_manufacturer,'!@#$%^&*') = COALESCE(:parameter.manufacturer,COALESCE(m.mfp_manufacturer,'!@#$%^&*') ) AND COALESCE(m.mfp_manufactpart,'!@#$%^&*')  = COALESCE(:parameter.manufacturerpart,COALESCE(m.mfp_manufactpart,'!@#$%^&*') ) ) )
AND (coalesce(:param.trackbycondition, 'false') = 'false' OR NOT (p.par_parentpart IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(p.par_trackbycondition, '-') = '+') )

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5descriptions d, r5userorganization u, r5parts p
    LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects
      ON par_code = obj_part
     AND par_org = obj_part_org
     AND 'I' = obj_obrtype
     AND obj_configcode IS NULL
   WHERE d.des_rentity = 'PART'

     AND d.des_code = p.par_code

             AND np.ntp_part_org = p.par_org)
     AND u.uog_org = p.par_org
     AND u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
     AND u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
     AND ((uog_common = '+'  OR uog_org = :param.organization) OR
         (SELECT u1.uog_common
             FROM r5userorganization u1
            WHERE u1.uog_org = :param.organization AND u1.uog_user = :parameter.r5user AND u1.uog_role = :parameter.r5role) = '+')

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5events,
       r5organization,
       r5activities,
       r5organizationoptions,
       r5matlparts,
       r5parts
  left outer join r5catalogue
    on cat_part = par_code
   and cat_part_org = par_org
   and cat_supplier = par_prefsup
   and cat_supplier_org = par_prefsup_org
 where act_event = :parameter.event
   and mlp_matlist = act_matlist
   and mlp_matlrev = act_matlrev
   and mlp_direct = '+'
   and par_code = mlp_part
   and par_org = mlp_part_org
   and evt_code = act_event
   and org_code = evt_org
   and evt_org = opa_org
   and opa_code = 'ACTINFO'
   and (mlp_code is null or
       (evt_object = mlp_code and evt_object_org = mlp_code_org and
       evt_obrtype = mlp_obrtype) or
       (mlp_code = (select o.obj_category
                       from r5objects o
                      where o.obj_code = evt_object
                        and o.obj_org = evt_object_org
                        and o.obj_obrtype = evt_obrtype) and
       mlp_obrtype = 'C'))
   and not exists (select null
          from r5requislines
         where rql_part = mlp_part
           and rql_part_org = mlp_part_org
           and rql_event = act_event
           and rql_act = act_act
           and rql_rstatus in ('A', 'U'))
   and not exists
 (select null
          from r5orderlines
         where orl_part = mlp_part
           and orl_part_org = mlp_part_org
           and orl_event = act_event
           and orl_act = act_act
           and orl_rstatus in ('A', 'C', 'R', 'U'))

from r5events,

       r5activities,

FROM   r5parts LEFT OUTER JOIN r5stock ON ( sto_store = :param.fromstore  AND sto_part = par_code AND sto_part_org = par_org ), r5events, r5transtock
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects ON ( obj_code = tst_object AND obj_org = tst_object_org ) 
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5orderlines ON ( tst_order = orl_order AND tst_ordline = orl_ordline ) 
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5requislines ON (tst_req = rql_req AND tst_reqline = rql_reqline)

AND    tst_tocode    = evt_code 
AND    tst_store       = :param.fromstore

AND    par_org       = tst_part_org 
AND    evt_org       = :control.org
AND    tst_qty - ( SELECT COALESCE( SUM( pkl_qty ), 0 ) 
                   FROM   r5package, r5packagelines
                   WHERE  pkg_code = pkl_package
                   AND    pkg_rstatus IN ( 'A', 'U' )
                   AND    pkl_helditem = tst_pkey ) > 0
AND ((:param.addedpks IS NOT NULL AND CHARINDEX(','+tst_pkey+',', ','+:param.addedpks+',') = 0 ) 
OR
:param.addedpks IS NULL)

rows.GRD_DESC: Parts on Stock to Held Items Transfer
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5parts 
INNER JOIN r5descriptions
      ON des_code = par_code AND des_org = par_org AND des_rentity = 'PART' AND des_lang = :parameter.language 
INNER JOIN r5binstock
     ON par_code = bis_part AND par_org = bis_part_org 
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects 
     ON obj_part = par_code AND obj_part_org = par_org AND obj_store = bis_store AND obj_bin = bis_bin AND obj_lot = bis_lot  
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5stock ON ( sto_store = :param.fromstore  AND sto_part = par_code AND sto_part_org = par_org ) 
WHERE COALESCE(par_notused, '-') <> '+' 
AND bis_store = :param.fromstore 
AND (SELECT bis_qty - COALESCE( SUM(res_allqty), 0 )  FROM r5reservations WHERE res_part = bis_part AND res_part_org = bis_part_org AND res_store = bis_store AND (res_event <> :param.workorder OR res_act <> :param.activity)) > 0
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5parts
INNER JOIN r5descriptions
      ON des_code = par_code AND des_org = par_org AND des_rentity = 'PART' AND des_lang = :parameter.language
INNER JOIN r5userorganization
      ON par_org = uog_org
      AND uog_user = :parameter.r5user
      AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role
      AND (uog_common = '+' or uog_org = :control.org)
INNER JOIN r5binstock
     ON par_code = bis_part AND par_org = bis_part_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects
     ON obj_part = par_code AND obj_part_org = par_org AND obj_store = bis_store AND obj_bin = bis_bin AND obj_lot = bis_lot
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5stock ON ( sto_store = :param.fromstore  AND sto_part = par_code AND sto_part_org = par_org )
WHERE COALESCE(par_notused, '-') <> '+'
AND bis_store = :param.fromstore
AND (SELECT bis_qty - COALESCE( SUM(res_allqty), 0 )  FROM r5reservations WHERE res_part = bis_part AND res_part_org = bis_part_org AND res_store = bis_store AND (res_event <> :param.workorder OR res_act <> :param.activity)) > 0

rows.GRD_DESC: Processed Lines on a PO Receipt
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM   ( SELECT *
         FROM   r5docklines
                LEFT OUTER JOIN r5parts ON( par_code = dkl_part AND par_org = dkl_part_org )
         WHERE  dkl_linerstatus = 'A'
         AND    dkl_dckcode = :param.poreceiptcode ) d
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5orderlines o
                         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events e ON ( e.evt_code = o.orl_event ) ON
              ( o.orl_order = d.dkl_order AND o.orl_ordline = d.dkl_ordline AND o.orl_order_org = d.dkl_order_org )
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5parts p ON
              ( p.par_parentpart = d.par_parentpart AND p.par_condition = d.dkl_repaircondition )
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5activities a on ( o.orl_event = a.act_event and o.orl_act = a.act_act ),
       r5dockreceipts     r,
       r5userorganization u,
       r5tabpermissions   t,
       r5organization
WHERE  r.dck_code = d.dkl_dckcode
AND    u.uog_org = r.dck_org
AND    org_code = o.orl_order_org
AND    u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND    u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND    t.trp_group = u.uog_group
AND    t.trp_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND    t.trp_tab = 'PLN'
AND    t.trp_select = '?'
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM   ( SELECT *  FROM   r5docklines
                LEFT OUTER JOIN r5parts ON( par_code = dkl_part AND par_org = dkl_part_org )
         WHERE  dkl_linerstatus = 'A'
         AND    dkl_dckcode = :param.poreceiptcode ) d
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5orderlines o
                         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events e ON ( e.evt_code = o.orl_event ) ON
              ( o.orl_order = d.dkl_order AND o.orl_ordline = d.dkl_ordline AND o.orl_order_org = d.dkl_order_org )
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5parts p ON
              ( p.par_parentpart = d.par_parentpart AND p.par_condition = d.dkl_repaircondition )
         LEFT OUTER JOIN r5activities a on ( o.orl_event = a.act_event and o.orl_act = a.act_act ),
       r5dockreceipts     r,
       r5userorganization u,
       r5tabpermissions   t,
       r5organization
WHERE  r.dck_code = d.dkl_dckcode
AND    u.uog_org = r.dck_org
AND    org_code = o.orl_order_org
AND    u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND    u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND    t.trp_group = u.uog_group
AND    t.trp_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND    t.trp_tab = 'PLN'
AND    t.trp_select = '?'

rows.GRD_DESC: Profile Look up with DEPTSEC, to bypass set param
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5descriptions d, r5objects o where d.des_rentity = 'OBJ' and d.des_rtype ='I' and d.des_lang = :parameter.language and d.des_code <> '*' and d.des_code = o.obj_code and 
coalesce(o.obj_notused, '-') <> '+'  AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF'  OR 
(obj_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = obj_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5descriptions d, r5userorganization u, r5objects o
WHERE d.des_rentity = 'OBJ'
AND d.des_code <> '*'
AND d.des_rtype ='I'
AND d.des_code = o.obj_code
AND d.des_org = o.obj_org
AND d.des_lang = :parameter.language
AND d.des_org = u.uog_org
AND u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND COALESCE( o.obj_notused, '-' ) <> '+'
AND ( COALESCE( u.uog_common, '-' ) = '+'
      OR o.obj_org = :control.org )
AND ( :param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true'
      OR ( :parameter.deptsec = 'OFF'
           OR ( obj_mrc IN ( SELECT dse_mrc
                             FROM r5departmentsecurity
                             WHERE dse_user = :parameter.r5user
                             AND dse_mrc = obj_mrc
                             AND COALESCE( dse_readonly, '-' ) = '-' ) ) ) )

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5orders,
(
	SELECT ord_code pcf_order, ord_org pcf_order_org,
		SUM( CASE WHEN SUBSTRING( orl_rtype, 1, 1 ) IN ('P','R') THEN 1  ELSE 0 END) pcf_partlines,
		SUM( CASE WHEN SUBSTRING( orl_rtype, 1, 1 ) = 'S' THEN 1  ELSE 0 END) pcf_servicelines,
		count(*) pcf_polines,
		ROUND(CAST(SUM( 
		dbo.f_greatest_number( 
		CASE	WHEN SUBSTRING( orl_rtype, 1, 1 ) IN ('P','R')
			THEN COALESCE(orl_price, 0) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1) *
				( COALESCE(CASE orl_rstatus WHEN 'C' THEN orl_recvqty ELSE orl_ordqty END , 0 ) / COALESCE( orl_multiply, 1 ) )  *
				( 1 - 0.01 * COALESCE( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) + (CASE orl_rstatus WHEN 'C' THEN ( ( COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) + COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0)) * ( COALESCE( orl_recvqty, 0 ) / COALESCE( orl_ordqty, 0 ) ) ) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) ELSE (COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) + COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0)) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) END)
			ELSE 0	
			END , 0 ) ) as numeric(24,6)),2) pcf_totalpartvalue,
		ROUND(CAST(
		SUM( 
		dbo.f_greatest_number( 
		CASE SUBSTRING( orl_rtype, 1, 1 ) 
			WHEN 'S'
			THEN COALESCE(CASE orl_rtype WHEN 'SF' THEN CASE orl_rstatus WHEN 'C' THEN orl_recvvalue ELSE orl_price END ELSE orl_price END, 0) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) *

				( 1 - 0.01 * COALESCE( orl_discperc, 0 ) ) + (CASE orl_rstatus WHEN 'C' THEN ( ( COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) + COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0)) * ( COALESCE( orl_recvqty, 0 ) / COALESCE( orl_ordqty, 0 ) ) ) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) ELSE (COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) + COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0)) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) END)
			ELSE 0 
			END , 0 ) ) as numeric(24,6)),2) pcf_totalservicevalue,
		ROUND(SUM(
		CASE orl_rstatus WHEN 'C'
		THEN
			COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0) * ( COALESCE( orl_recvqty, 0 ) / COALESCE( orl_ordqty, 0 ) ) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) 
		ELSE 
			COALESCE(orl_tottaxamount, 0) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) 
		END
		) ,2) pcf_totaltaxamount,
		ROUND(SUM(
		CASE orl_rstatus WHEN 'C'
		THEN
			COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) * ( COALESCE( orl_recvqty, 0 ) / COALESCE( orl_ordqty, 0 ) ) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) 
		ELSE 
			COALESCE(orl_totextra, 0) / COALESCE( orl_exch, 1 ) 
		END
		) ,2) pcf_totalextracharges
	FROM r5orders,r5orderlines
	WHERE ord_code = orl_order
	AND ord_org = orl_order_org
        AND orl_rstatus <> 'J'
	AND orl_project IN (SELECT PRJ_CODE FROM dbo.f_grid_jsproj_ord_hierarchy( :param.projectcode ) UNION SELECT :param.projectcode)
	GROUP BY ord_code, ord_org
) r5pocalcfieldvalues

from r5pumps p left outer join r5descriptions d

and d.des_rentity = 'PUMP' 
and d.des_lang = :parameter.language)
where p.pum_depot = :param.depotcode
and p.pum_depot_org = :param.organization
and p.pum_notused = '-'

FROM r5pumps p LEFT OUTER JOIN r5descriptions d on  (d.des_code = p.pum_depot+'#'+p.pum_depot_org+'#'+p.pum_code AND d.des_rentity = 'PUMP' AND d.des_lang = :parameter.language), r5userorganization
WHERE uog_org = pum_depot_org
AND uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND p.pum_notused = '-'

from r5fuels f, r5organization, r5pumps p left outer join r5descriptions d
on  (d.des_code = p.pum_depot+'#'+p.pum_depot_org+'#'+p.pum_code 
 and d.des_rentity = 'PUMP' 
 and d.des_lang = :parameter.language )
where org_code = pum_depot_org 
and p.pum_notused = '-'
and p.pum_depot + '#' + p.pum_depot_org = case when (:param.depot is not null and :param.depotorg is not null) then :param.depot + '#' + :param.depotorg else coalesce(:param.defaultdepot + '#' + :param.defaultdepotorg,(select mrc_depot + '#' + mrc_depot_org from r5mrcs,r5objects
 where mrc_code=obj_mrc
 and obj_code=:param.objectcode
 and obj_org=:param.objectorg)) end
and f.fue_code = COALESCE(:param.fuel, :param.primaryfuel)
and case when f.fue_blended = '+' then 0 else 1 end +
    case when f.fue_blendfuel1 is null then 0 else 1 end +
    case when f.fue_blendfuel2 is null then 0 else 1 end +
    case when f.fue_blendfuel3 is null then 0 else 1 end +
    case when f.fue_blendfuel4 is null then 0 else 1 end +
    case when f.fue_blendfuel5 is null then 0 else 1 end =
  ( select count( distinct t.tan_fuel )
    from r5tanks t, r5tankpumps tp
    where tp.tpu_depot = t.tan_depot
    and tp.tpu_depot_org = t.tan_depot_org
    and tp.tpu_tank = t.tan_code
    and tp.tpu_active = '+'
    and tp.tpu_pump = p.pum_code 
    and t.tan_fuel in( f.fue_code, f.fue_blendfuel1, f.fue_blendfuel2, 
                       f.fue_blendfuel3, f.fue_blendfuel4, f.fue_blendfuel5 )
    and tp.tpu_depot + '#' + tp.tpu_depot_org = case when (:param.depot is not null and :param.depotorg is not null) then :param.depot + '#' + :param.depotorg else coalesce(:param.defaultdepot + '#' + :param.defaultdepotorg,
	(select mrc_depot + '#' + mrc_depot_org from r5mrcs,r5objects
 where mrc_code=obj_mrc
 and obj_code=:param.objectcode
 and obj_org=:param.objectorg)) end)

from r5orderlines o
left outer join r5events e on orl_event = evt_code
where orl_order = :param.ordercode
and orl_order_org = :control.org
and (orl_rstatus = 'A' or 
coalesce(orl_recvqty,0) + coalesce(orl_recvvalue,0) + coalesce(orl_scrapqty,0)>0)
and orl_rtype like 'S%'
and  (orl_event is null OR :param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR 
(:param.deptsec ='OFF' OR 
EXISTS ( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc  AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-')))

FROM ( 
		select ord_code ,ord_org ,
			dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( :parameter.language,'PORD',ord_code, null,null )  PURCHASEORDERDESC
		from r5orders  where (
			:parameter.invoicetype IN ( 'I' , 'M' ) 
			and ord_supplier = :parameter.suppliercode 
			and ord_supplier_org = :parameter.supplierorganization 
			and ord_rstatus = 'A' 
			and exists(select 1 from R5IMPORTPOLINESVW 
                        where ORL_ORDER = ord_code and ORL_ORDER_ORG = ord_org and
                        ORL_SUPPLIER = ord_supplier and ORL_SUPPLIER_ORG = ord_supplier_org)
			)  or  (
			:parameter.invoicetype in ('C','D') 
			and (ord_code+'#'+ord_org) in ( 
				select distinct ivl_order+'#'+ivl_order_org from r5invoicelines 
					where ivl_invoice = :parameter.parentinvoice 
					and ivl_invoice_org = :parameter.parentinvoiceorg
									)
								)
 ) o WHERE 1=1

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY: from r5orderlines where orl_order = :ordercode and orl_order_org = :orderorg and orl_active = '+' and exists (select null from r5parts where par_code = orl_part and par_org = orl_part_org and par_byasset = '+')

rows.GRD_DESC: Purchase Order-Line lookup for Assets for PO
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5orderlines
where orl_active = '+' and
exists (select null
		from r5parts
		where par_code = orl_part and
		par_org = orl_part_org and
		par_byasset = '+')
and exists
	(select null
	from r5orders
	where ord_code = orl_order and
	ord_org = orl_order_org and
	((ord_rstatus = 'U' and isnull( :param.assetass,'P' ) = 'P' ) or
	(ord_rstatus IN ('U', 'R', 'A') and
	isnull( :param.assetass,'P' ) = 'R' )))
	and orl_order_org in
	(select u.uog_org from r5permissions p right outer join r5userorganization u on (p.prm_group = u.uog_group and
p.prm_function = :parameter.userfunction ), r5functions f
		where u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user and
		u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role and
		f.fun_code = :parameter.userfunction and
		(case when p.prm_function is null then f.fun_select else p.prm_select end = '?' or
		 case when p.prm_function is null then f.fun_insert else p.prm_insert end = '+') and
		( p.prm_function is not null or f.fun_public = '!' ))

rows.GRD_DESC: Recurring Request LOV for Call Center
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5contactrecords
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5contactinfo on ctr_contactinfoid = cti_code
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5casemanagement on ctr_case = csm_code
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5serviceproblemcodes on ctr_serviceproblem = spb_code and ctr_serviceproblem_org = spb_org

LEFT OUTER JOIN r5equipmentusabilities ON ctr_eqpusability=eub_eqpusability AND ctr_eqpusabilityorg=eub_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects ON ctr_object = obj_code AND ctr_object_org = obj_org AND COALESCE(ctr_multiequip, '-') = '-'

AND ctr_object_org = :parameter.objectorg

AND ctr_serviceproblem_org = :parameter.servicecodeorg
AND NOT (ctr_code = COALESCE( :parameter.servicerequest, 'x' ) AND ctr_org = COALESCE( :control.org, 'x' ) )
AND ctr_created >= GETDATE() - CAST(:parameter.lookbackdays AS NUMERIC)

rows.GRD_DESC: Report LOV for Report Output Formats
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM (
      SELECT 
		CASE bot_number
			WHEN 90 THEN 'HTML'
			WHEN 91 THEN 'PDF'
			WHEN 92 THEN 'xlsxData'
			WHEN 93 THEN 'spreadsheetML'
			WHEN 94 THEN 'XLWA'
			WHEN 95 THEN 'CSV' END CODE,
		BOT_TEXT AS TEXT
      FROM    r5boilertexts
      WHERE   bot_function = 'REPORT'
      AND     bot_lang     = :parameter.language
      AND     bot_number IN (90,91,92,93,94,95)
      ) t
WHERE 1 = 1

FROM 
 	(SELECT rqm_code cc_code, dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'RECO', rqm_code,NULL, NULL) cc_desc FROM r5requircodes
 	 UNION
 	 SELECT cau_code cc_code, dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'CAUS', cau_code,NULL, NULL) cc_desc FROM r5causes
 	 UNION
 	 SELECT fal_code cc_code, dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'FAIL', fal_code,NULL, NULL) cc_desc FROM r5failures
 	 UNION
 	 SELECT acc_code cc_code, dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'ACCO', acc_code,NULL, NULL) cc_desc FROM r5actioncodes ) c
WHERE 1=1

FROM (
      SELECT 
		CASE bot_number
			WHEN 26 THEN 'PM'
			WHEN 27 THEN 'MP'
			WHEN 33 THEN 'A' END CODE,
		BOT_TEXT AS TEXT
      FROM    r5boilertexts
      WHERE   bot_function = 'WZLMWO'
      AND     bot_lang     = :parameter.language
      AND     bot_number IN (26,27,33)
      ) t
WHERE 1 = 1

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5requisitions
WHERE req_rstatus='A'
AND       req_rtype = 'RECV'
AND       req_torentity = 'STOR'
AND       req_tocode = :parameter.storecode
AND       EXISTS (
  SELECT null FROM r5requislines rl
  WHERE rl.rql_req = req_code
  AND       rl.rql_rstatus='A'
  AND       ISNULL(rl.rql_active, '-') = '+'
  AND       ISNULL(rl.rql_recvqty, 0) = 0
  AND       rl.rql_quotflag = '0'
  AND       rl.rql_rtype LIKE 'S%'
  AND      NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 'x' FROM   r5orderlines o
     WHERE  o.orl_req     = rl.rql_req
     AND        o.orl_reqline = rl.rql_reqline)
)

rows.GRD_DESC: Retrieve WO Services Popup on Services  for RFQ
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5events,r5descriptions,r5activities LEFT OUTER JOIN r5tasks ON(tsk_code = act_task AND tsk_revision = act_taskrev),r5organization
   WHERE des_lang=:parameter.language and des_org=evt_org and des_code=evt_code and des_rentity='EVNT'
   AND evt_code = act_event
   AND org_code = evt_org  
AND act_trade IS NOT null  
   AND (:param.project is null OR (evt_project = :param.project AND ( :param.projbudget is null or evt_projbud = :param.projbudget)))
   AND ((:param.workorder is null or evt_code = :param.workorder) and (:param.workorderactivity is null or ( evt_code = :param.workorderactivity and act_act =  :param.activity )))
   AND ( evt_rstatus = 'R' 
   OR          ( evt_rstatus = 'C' 
   AND        (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() + COALESCE(org_timezone/24, 0),'DD') <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(evt_completed +  CAST(COALESCE((select ins_desc from r5install where ins_code='REQDAYS'),'0') AS NUMERIC),'DD' ) ) 
   AND        (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(evt_completed,'DD') > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE((SELECT COALESCE( MAX( clp_closed ),CAST( '01-01-1900' AS DATETIME )) FROM r5closedperiods),'DD') ) ) )
   AND 	evt_rtype IN ( 'JOB', 'PPM' )
   AND  COALESCE( act_defermaintenance, '-' ) = '-'      
   AND 	(COALESCE(act_hire,'-') = '+' OR COALESCE(act_ordered,'-') = '+')
   AND       ((evt_project IS NOT NULL
   	     AND NOT EXISTS (select 1 from r5projects where prj_code = evt_project AND prj_rstatus = 'B') 
   	       ) OR      evt_project IS NULL) 
   AND NOT EXISTS (select 1 from r5ucodes where uco_rentity = 'JBTP' and uco_rcode = 'MEC' and evt_jobtype = uco_code) 
   AND (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR 
   (evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-')))
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM R5RFQLINES where rli_rfq = :param.rfqcode AND  rli_org=:param.organization AND rli_rtype IN ('SF','ST','SH') AND  rli_event=act_event  AND   rli_act = act_act)

         AND des_lang=:parameter.language and des_org=evt_org and des_code=evt_code and des_rentity='EVNT'

       AND act_trade IS NOT null
         AND (:param.project is null OR (evt_project = :param.project AND ( :param.projbudget is null or evt_projbud = :param.projbudget)))
         AND ((:param.workorder is null or evt_code = :param.workorder)
         AND (:param.workorderactivity is null or ( evt_code = :param.workorderactivity and act_act = :param.activity )))
         AND ( evt_rstatus = 'R'
         OR          ( evt_rstatus = 'C'
         AND        (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() + COALESCE(org_timezone/24, 0),'DD') <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(evt_completed +  CAST(COALESCE((select ins_desc from r5install where ins_code='REQDAYS'),'0') AS NUMERIC) ,'DD') )
         AND        (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(evt_completed,'DD') > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE((SELECT COALESCE( MAX( clp_closed ), CAST( '01-01-1900' AS DATETIME )) FROM r5closedperiods),'DD') ) ) )
         AND 	evt_rtype IN ( 'JOB', 'PPM' )
         AND   COALESCE( act_defermaintenance, '-' ) = '-'
         AND  (COALESCE(act_hire,'-') = '+' OR COALESCE(act_ordered,'-') = '+')
         AND       ((evt_project IS NOT NULL
         	     AND NOT EXISTS (select 1 from r5projects where prj_code = evt_project AND prj_rstatus = 'B')
         	       ) OR      evt_project IS NULL)
         AND NOT EXISTS (select 1 from r5ucodes where uco_rentity = 'JBTP' and uco_rcode = 'MEC' and evt_jobtype = uco_code)
         AND uog_user = :parameter.r5user
         AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role

         AND (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR
         (evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-')))
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM R5RFQLINES where rli_rfq = :param.rfqcode AND  rli_org=:param.organization AND rli_rtype IN ('SF','ST','SH') AND  rli_event=act_event  AND   rli_act = act_act)

rows.GRD_DESC: Retrieve Web Service Prompt Field Length
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5defaultpagelayout 
where PLD_PAGENAME= case when :param.tabcode is null OR :param.tabcode='HDR' then :param.funccode else :param.funccode+'_'+:param.tabcode end
and pld_elementtype='F' AND PLD_PRESENTINJSP <>'N'

FROM   r5partctplconditions c2, r5partctplconditions c1, r5parts,r5descriptions
WHERE  par_code = :parameter.partcode 
AND    par_org  = :parameter.partorganization
AND    c1.ptc_template = par_conditiontpl
AND    c1.ptc_template_org = par_conditiontpl_org
AND    c1.ptc_condition = :parameter.conditioncode
AND   CHARINDEX(','+c2.ptc_condition+',',','+case :parameter.returnforrepair when '0' then c1.ptc_rtntostorecondlist else c1.ptc_rtntorepaircondlist end+',') > 0  
AND    c2.ptc_template = c1.ptc_template
AND    c2.ptc_template_org = c1.ptc_template_org
AND    des_code = c2.ptc_template + '#' + c2.ptc_condition
AND    des_org = c2.ptc_template_org
AND    des_lang = :parameter.language
AND    des_rentity = 'CPCT'

FROM r5trackreturnprompts a, r5trackingprompts b, r5trackingprompts c

from r5personnel p, r5activities a
where a.act_event = 'SR'+:param.event
   and a.act_act = :param.act
   and p.per_notused = '-'
   AND COALESCE(p.per_tradesperson, '-') = '+'
    and (:parameter.per_type is null or exists ( select pet_person from r5pertypes where p.per_code = pet_person and  pet_type = :parameter.per_type)) AND (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR

    and u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
    and u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
    and ( u.uog_common = '+' or u.uog_org = :control.org )

SELECT  <FIELDLIST_1>
FROM r5tasks,r5entitysalesprices, r5organization
WHERE tsk_code = CASE WHEN COALESCE(:param.headerjobplan, '!@#$') = 'ESP_SHOWALLRECORDS' OR COALESCE(:param.headerjobplan, '!@#$') = '!@#$' THEN :param.task ELSE '!@#$' END
AND tsk_revision = :param.revision
AND esp_code = :param.task+'#'+:param.taskorg
AND esp_rentity = 'TASK'
AND esp_org = org_code
AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
          	FROM r5tabpermissions t, r5users u
         		WHERE u.usr_code = :parameter.r5user
           		AND t.trp_tab = 'ESP'
         	  		AND u.usr_group = t.trp_group
          		 AND t.trp_select = '?'
          	 	AND t.trp_function = :parameter.userfunction)
<FILTER_1>
UNION 
SELECT  <FIELDLIST_2>
FROM r5entitysalesprices,r5organization,r5tasks jp,r5taskplanjobs,r5descriptions ,r5tasks tp 
WHERE tpj_task = :param.task
AND tpj_taskrev = :param.revision
AND tp.tsk_code = tpj_task
AND tp.tsk_revision = tpj_taskrev
AND tpj_jobplan = LEFT(esp_code, CHARINDEX('#',  esp_code) -1)
AND tpj_jobplan = jp.tsk_code 
AND jp.tsk_revision = (SELECT max(t.tsk_revision) FROM r5tasks t  WHERE t.tsk_code =  tpj_jobplan 
AND 'A' = CASE WHEN (t.tsk_reusable = '+' OR tp.tsk_revrstatus = 'A')  THEN t.tsk_revrstatus 
				   WHEN tp.tsk_revrstatus IN ('U', 'RA') THEN 'A' ELSE NULL END) 
AND esp_org = org_code
AND esp_rentity in ('TASK', 'JBPL') 
AND des_code = tpj_jobplan
AND des_rentity = 'JBPL'  
AND des_lang = :parameter.language  
AND EXISTS
       (SELECT 1
          	FROM r5tabpermissions t, r5users u
         		WHERE u.usr_code = :parameter.r5user
           		AND t.trp_tab = 'ESP'
         	  		AND u.usr_group = t.trp_group
          		 AND t.trp_select = '?'
          	 	AND t.trp_function = :parameter.userfunction)
AND CONVERT(VARCHAR, tpj_seq)+'#'+tpj_jobplan = CASE WHEN 'ESP_SHOWALLRECORDS' = :param.headerjobplan THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR, tpj_seq)+'#'+tpj_jobplan 
	ELSE :param.headerjobplan END
<FILTER_2>
<SORT_BY>

and   opa_code = 'ACTINFO' AND (coalesce(a.act_parent, a.act_act) = :param.headeractivity OR :param.headeractivity = 0)
 AND (a.act_seq = :param.headerjob OR :param.headerjob = 0) and   d2.des_rentity = 'TOOL'   and   d2.des_lang = :parameter.language   and   d2.des_code = tool.too_code   and   d2.des_rtype = '*'   and   u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user and u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role   and   ( u.uog_common = '+' or u.uog_org = t.evt_org )   and   u.uog_org = t.evt_org

FROM R5DESCRIPTIONS, R5UCODES ,(SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(FUN_APPLICATION,FUN_CODE) FUN_CODE ,FUN_APPLICATION ,fun_code fun_code1 FROM R5FUNCTIONS  
WHERE (FUN_CODE IN ('OSOBJA','OSHPVH','OSOVAM','OSOBJP','OSOVPM','OSHPRM','OSHPFY','OSOBJS','OSOVSM','WSJOBS','WSJOVH','WSJOVM','OSESCH','CSCASE','CSCMTK','WSCOPO')
OR fun_application IN ('OSOBJA','OSHPVH','OSOVAM','OSOBJP','OSOVPM','OSHPRM','OSHPFY','OSOBJS','OSOVSM','WSJOBS','WSJOVH','WSJOVM','OSESCH','CSCASE','CSCMTK','WSCOPO'))) functions
WHERE ((UCO_RENTITY='OBTP' 
AND FUN_CODE IN ('OSOBJA','OSHPVH','OSOVAM','OSOBJP','OSOVPM','OSHPRM','OSHPFY','OSOBJS','OSOVSM') 
AND UCO_RCODE = (CASE WHEN FUN_CODE IN ('OSOBJA','OSHPVH','OSOVAM') THEN 'A'
WHEN FUN_CODE in ('OSOBJP','OSOVPM','OSHPRM','OSHPFY') THEN 'P'
WHEN FUN_CODE in ('OSOBJS','OSOVSM') THEN 'S' END)

OR (UCO_RENTITY = 'JBTP' AND FUN_CODE IN ('WSJOBS','WSJOVH','WSJOVM','WSCOPO') AND UCO_RCODE IN ('*','BR','ST','RP','CAL'))

and uco_code not in (select fft_type from r5fieldfiltertype where fft_rtype=uco_rcode and fft_function= :parameter.screencode)

                    FROM   r5objectservicecodes o2,
                           ( SELECT parent stc_parent, parentorg stc_parent_org, lev + 1 lev

rows.GRD_DESC: Standard Multi-equipment lookup for distributing costs
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
SELECT <FIELDLIST_1>
FROM r5boilertexts  b
WHERE ISNULL(:param.parttype,'x') NOT LIKE 'asset%'
AND bot_function = 'LVMECO'
AND bot_fld1 = 'ALLEQUIPMENT'
AND bot_lang = :parameter.language 
AND COALESCE(:param.forreservation, 'false') = 'false' 
<FILTER_1>
UNION
SELECT <FIELDLIST_2>
FROM r5boilertexts b
WHERE bot_function = 'LVMECO'
AND bot_fld1 = 'WOHEADEREQUIPMENT'
AND bot_lang = :parameter.language
<FILTER_2>
UNION
SELECT <FIELDLIST_3>
FROM r5organization o, r5events e LEFT OUTER JOIN r5descriptions d ON (d.des_code = e.evt_code AND d.des_rentity = 'EVNT'  AND d.des_lang =:parameter.language)
JOIN r5objects ON obj_code = e.evt_object AND obj_org = e.evt_object_org
WHERE (( :param.tab = 'PAR'
AND	(e.evt_rstatus = 'R' 
OR (e.evt_rstatus = 'C'  AND COALESCE(:param.forreservation, 'false') = 'false' 
AND	(dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() + ISNULL(o.org_timezone/24, 0), N'DD') <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(e.evt_completed +  ISNULL(CASE :param.trantype WHEN N'ISSUE' THEN :param.issue_days WHEN N'RETURN' THEN :param.return_days ELSE 0  END, 0 ), N'DD'  )))))
OR (:param.tab = 'PEV'   
AND	e.evt_rstatus IN ('R', 'C'))
 OR ((:param.tab = 'KSF'  OR  :param.tab = 'WOR' )
          AND e.evt_rstatus = 'R'  )
OR ( :param.tab = 'BOO'  
AND ( e.evt_rstatus = 'R'  OR ( e.evt_rstatus = 'C'  AND (GetDate() + ISNULL(o.org_timezone/24, 0) <=  e.evt_completed +  cast(ISNULL(:param.comdays, 0) as numeric(38))))))  
OR ( :param.tab = 'ACO' AND ( e.evt_rstatus = 'R' OR ( e.evt_rstatus = 'C' AND (GetDate() + ISNULL(o.org_timezone/24, 0) <= e.evt_completed +  cast(ISNULL(:param.comdays, 0) as numeric(38)))))) 
OR ( :param.tab = 'TOU'  AND ( e.evt_rstatus = 'R'  OR ( e.evt_rstatus = 'C'  AND (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() + ISNULL(o.org_timezone/24, 0), N'DD') <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(e.evt_completed +  cast(ISNULL(:param.tooldays, 0) as numeric(38)),  N'DD')))))  OR ((:param.function = 'SSREQU'  OR :param.function = 'PSRFQT') 	AND ( :param.tab = 'HDR' OR  :param.tab = 'RQL'  OR :param.tab = 'RLI' OR :param.tab = 'RLS') AND ( e.evt_rstatus = 'R'  OR ( e.evt_rstatus = 'C'  
AND (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() + isnull(o.org_timezone/24, 0),'DD') <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(e.evt_completed +  cast(isnull((select ins_desc from r5install where ins_code='REQDAYS'),'0') as numeric(38)),'DD' )) AND (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(e.evt_completed, 'DD') > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE((SELECT isnull( MAX( c.clp_closed ),cast( '01-01-1900' as datetime)) FROM r5closedperiods c), 'DD'))
 ) 
)
)
)
AND  e.evt_routeparent = :param.workordercode
AND  o.org_code = e.evt_org
<FILTER_3>
<SORT_BY>

OR (:param.tab = 'PEV'   AND e.evt_rstatus IN ('R', 'C'))
OR  ((:param.tab = 'KSF'   OR :param.tab = 'WOR')  AND e.evt_rstatus = 'R'  )

OR ((:param.function = 'SSREQU'  OR :param.function = 'PSRFQT' ) AND ( :param.tab = 'HDR' OR  :param.tab = 'RQL'  OR :param.tab = 'RLI'  OR :param.tab = 'RLS' ) AND (e.evt_rstatus = 'R'  OR (e.evt_rstatus = 'C'  AND (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(GetDate() + isnull(o.org_timezone/24, 0),'DD') <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(e.evt_completed +  cast(isnull((select ins_desc from r5install where ins_code='REQDAYS'),'0') as numeric(38)),'DD' )) AND (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(e.evt_completed, 'DD') > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE((SELECT isnull( MAX( c.clp_closed ),cast( '01-01-1900' as datetime)) FROM r5closedperiods c), 'DD'))

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5companies c 
WHERE c.com_notused = '-' 
AND   c.com_code <> '*' 
AND   ( (:param.tabname = 'RQL' AND c.com_purchasesite = '+') OR (:param.tabname = 'RLS' AND c.com_people = '+' ) ) 
AND   ((:param.dspyid = 'ALL' or :param.dspyid is null ) 
       OR
       (:param.dspyid = 'CATLOGSUPP' AND 
            ( c.com_code )
            IN ( SELECT distinct c1.com_code 
                  FROM r5companies c1 LEFT OUTER JOIN r5catalogue ct 
		ON  c1.com_code = ct.cat_supplier 
                  WHERE 
                  ( ISNULL(ct.cat_part, 'a') LIKE ISNULL(:param.part, '%') OR :param.newpart = 'true' OR :param.partclass = 'N' ) 
                  AND ( ISNULL(ct.cat_part_org, 'a') LIKE ISNULL( :param.partorg, '%') OR :param.newpart = 'true' OR :param.partclass = 'N') )
               )
       OR
       (:param.dspyid = 'TASKCATLOGSUPP' AND 
            ( c.com_code )
            IN ( SELECT distinct c1.com_code 
                  FROM r5companies c1 LEFT OUTER JOIN r5servicecatalogue st  ON 
		c1.com_code = st.sca_supplier 
                  WHERE c1.com_people = '+'
                  AND ( ISNULL(st.sca_task, 'a') LIKE ISNULL(:param.task, '%')) 
               )
       )
      )

            ( c.com_code+'#'+c.com_org )

                  FROM r5companies c1 LEFT OUTER JOIN r5catalogue ct

               )
       OR
       (:param.dspyid = 'TASKCATLOGSUPP' AND
            ( c.com_code+'#'+c.com_org )
            IN ( SELECT distinct (c1.com_code+'#'+c1.com_org)

des_lang = :parameter.language AND 
des_code  = par_code AND des_org = par_org AND 
par_repairable = '+' AND 
cat_repref IS NOT NULL AND 
cat_supplier LIKE ISNULL( :parameter.supplier,'%') AND 
( par_code + '#' +  par_org ) IN ( SELECT bis_part + '#' +  bis_part_org 
							FROM   r5binstock 
							WHERE  bis_store = :parameter.store AND bis_part= par_code AND bis_part_org = par_org )

AND des_lang = :parameter.language

AND des_org = cat_part_org)

AND COALESCE(p.par_notused, '-') = '-'
AND ( (ISNULL(:param.reqlinertype, 'PS') <> 'RE' ) OR ( ISNULL(:param.reqlinertype,'PS') = 'RE' AND ISNULL(p.par_repairable, '-') = '+'))

	AND osp_object_org = obj_org

	AND osp_supplier_org = c.com_org
	AND (osp_object = :parameter.object AND osp_object_org = :parameter.objectorg)

                WHERE  o.oud_object     = j.obj_code
                AND    o.oud_object_org = j.obj_org
                AND    o.oud_uom   = :param.meteruom
                AND    o.oud_parent = '+' 
                AND    j.obj_rstatus <> 'D'
                AND    o.oud_object = s.stc_parent
                AND    o.oud_object_org = s.stc_parent_org 
                AND  ( :parameter.deptsec = 'OFF' OR( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user 
                       AND dse_mrc = ( CASE WHEN :param.loantodept = 'true' THEN COALESCE( j.obj_loaneddept, j.obj_mrc ) ELSE j.obj_mrc END )  
                       AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-' ) = '-' ) ) ) ) 
AND    EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
                FROM   r5objusagedefs o
                WHERE  o.oud_object     = :param.startobj
                AND    o.oud_object_org = :param.startobjorg
                AND    o.oud_child      = '+' )
<FILTER_1> 
UNION
SELECT <FIELDLIST_2>
FROM   r5objusagedefs o,
       r5objects j
WHERE  o.oud_object     = j.obj_code
AND    o.oud_object_org = j.obj_org
AND    j.obj_rstatus    <> 'D'
AND    o.oud_uom        = :param.meteruom 
AND    o.oud_object     = :param.startobj
AND    o.oud_object_org = :param.startobjorg
<FILTER_2> <SORT_BY>

LEFT OUTER JOIN r5dddataspy ON (trp_securityddspyid = dds_ddspyid)

AND act_event = :param.event
AND ((act_act = :param.activity AND COALESCE(:param.job, '#') = '#')

rows.GRD_DESC: Vendor book hours on work order
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
select <FIELDLIST_1> 
from r5bookedhours, r5activities a1, r5orderlines, r5organization, r5organizationoptions, r5events e
where boo_event = :param.workordernum
    and evt_code = :param.workordernum 
    and boo_event = a1.act_event 
    and boo_act = a1.act_act
    and evt_org = org_code 
    and boo_misc = '-'
    and boo_hours <> 0 
    and (  ( boo_event = orl_event and boo_act = orl_act  and ( boo_order is null and coalesce (orl_order, '#') = coalesce (a1.act_order, '#') 
                                                                                  and coalesce (orl_order_org, '#') =  coalesce (a1.act_order_org, '#')))
             or ( boo_order = orl_order and boo_ordline = orl_ordline and boo_order_org = orl_order_org ) )
    and orl_rtype IN ('ST', 'SF', 'SH')
    and (orl_rstatus NOT IN ( 'C', 'J') OR coalesce(orl_recvqty,0) > 0 )
and  opa_code = 'ACTINFO'
and  opa_org = e.evt_org
and (coalesce(a1.act_topparent, coalesce(a1.act_parent, a1.act_act)) = :param.headeractivity OR coalesce(:param.headeractivity, '0') = '0')
and (a1.act_seq = :param.headerjob OR coalesce(:param.headerjob, '0') = '0')
<FILTER_1>
UNION ALL
select <FIELDLIST_2>
from r5bookedhours, r5activities a1, r5orderlines, r5organization, r5organizationoptions, r5events e RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5activities a2 ON (a2.act_event = e.evt_routeparent)
where boo_event = evt_code
    and evt_routeparent = :param.workordernum
    and boo_event = a1.act_event
    and boo_act = a1.act_act
    and evt_org = org_code
    and boo_misc = '-'
    and boo_hours <> 0
    and (  ( :param.workordernum = orl_event and boo_act = orl_act  and boo_order is null )
           or ( boo_order = orl_order and boo_ordline = orl_ordline and boo_order_org = orl_order_org ) )
    and orl_rtype IN ('ST', 'SF', 'SH') 
    and ( a2.act_act = a1.act_act and a2.act_event <> a1.act_event )  
    and (orl_rstatus NOT IN ('C', 'J') OR coalesce(orl_recvqty,0) > 0 ) 
and  opa_code = 'ACTINFO'
and  opa_org = e.evt_org 
and (coalesce(a1.act_topparent, coalesce(a1.act_parent, a1.act_act)) = :param.headeractivity OR coalesce(:param.headeractivity, '0') = '0')
and (a1.act_seq = :param.headerjob OR coalesce(:param.headerjob, '0') = '0') 
<FILTER_2> 
UNION ALL 
select <FIELDLIST_3> 
from r5bookedhours, r5activities a1, r5orderlines, r5organization, r5organizationoptions, r5events e RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5activities a2 ON (a2.act_event = e.evt_routeparent)    
where boo_event = :param.workordernum
    and evt_code = :param.workordernum 
    and boo_event = a1.act_event 
    and boo_act = a1.act_act 
    and evt_org = org_code 
    and boo_misc = '-'
    and boo_hours <> 0 
    and ( evt_routeparent = orl_event and boo_act = orl_act) 
    and orl_rtype IN ('ST', 'SF', 'SH') 
    and a2.act_act = a1.act_act 
    and (orl_rstatus NOT IN ('C', 'J') OR coalesce(orl_recvqty,0) > 0 ) 
and  opa_code = 'ACTINFO'
and  opa_org = e.evt_org

and act_act = sct_act
and act_event=sct_event
and lsw_event=sct_event
and lsw_act=sct_act
and evt_code = sct_event
and COALESCE(sct_deleted, '-') = '-'
and act_parent IS NULL
and act_trade IS NOT NULL

rows.GRD_DESC: View Work Orders for Equipment Operational Status
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM   r5objects o,
       r5eventobjects eo,
       r5events e
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs u1 
                   ON ( u1.oud_object = e.evt_object AND u1.oud_object_org = e.evt_object_org AND u1.oud_uom = e.evt_metuom )
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs u2 
                   ON ( u2.oud_object = e.evt_object AND u2.oud_object_org = e.evt_object_org AND u2.oud_uom = e.evt_metuom2 )
WHERE  o.obj_code        = eo.eob_object
AND    o.obj_org         = eo.eob_object_org
AND    e.evt_code        = eo.eob_event
AND    e.evt_rstatus     = 'R'
AND    eo.eob_object     = :parameter.object
AND    eo.eob_object_org = :parameter.objorganization
AND    e.evt_rtype IN ( 'JOB', 'PPM' )
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM   r5objects o,
       r5eventobjects eo,
       r5events e
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs u1
                   ON ( u1.oud_object = e.evt_object AND u1.oud_object_org = e.evt_object_org AND u1.oud_uom = e.evt_metuom )
       LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objusagedefs u2
                   ON ( u2.oud_object = e.evt_object AND u2.oud_object_org = e.evt_object_org AND u2.oud_uom = e.evt_metuom2 )
