rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from      r5documents d,  
                                (select b.rea_object, b.rea_object_org, b.rea_calcuom, c.rea_reading
                                                from (select rea_object, rea_object_org, rea_calcuom, max(rea_date) "LAST_READING_DATE"
                                                                                from r5readings group by rea_object, rea_object_org, rea_calcuom) b,
                                                r5readings c where b.rea_object=c.rea_object
                                                                                                                and b.rea_object_org=c.rea_object_org
                                                                                                                and b.rea_calcuom=c.rea_calcuom and b."LAST_READING_DATE"=c.rea_date) r 
                                RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5warcoverages w on (                           r.rea_object=:parameter_objcode and 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                r.rea_object_org=:parameter.objorg and 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                r.rea_calcuom=w.wcv_uom )
                                LEFT OUTER JOIN R5OBJUSAGEDEFS o on (           w.wcv_uom = o.oud_uom and 
                                                                                                                                                                                                o.oud_object = :parameter_objcode and 
                                                                                                                                                                                                o.oud_object_org = :parameter.objorg )
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects ON (wcv_object = obj_code AND wcv_object_org = obj_org)

where   COALESCE(d.doc_notused,'-') = '-'   and
                  w.wcv_object=:parameter_objcode and 
                                w.wcv_object_org =:parameter.objorg and 
                                d.doc_code =w.wcv_warranty and  
                                ((w.wcv_obrtype in ('A', 'P', 'S') and :parameter.sysfunction <>'OSECON') OR (w.wcv_obrtype = 'I' and :parameter.sysfunction = 'OSECON'))

from r5dwwarclaimsaccumsnap  right outer join r5dwfileddates on (zvh_filedkey = zcs_datefiledkey) left outer join r5dwwarrantyclaims on (zcs_claimkey = zwc_key) left outer join r5dwobjects on (zcs_objectkey = zob_key) left outer join r5dwsuppliers on (zcs_supplierkey = zsu_key) left outer join r5dworganizations on (zcs_orgkey = zor_key) left outer join r5dwmrcs on (zcs_mrckey = zmr_key) where zvh_fileddate between :parameter.startdate and :parameter.enddate  @GROUPBYCLAUSE{ group by zvh_fileddate }

FROM r5descriptions d, r5documents c  
WHERE d.des_rentity='DOCU' 
AND d.des_lang=:parameter.language 
AND d.des_code = c.doc_code 
AND c.doc_warranty='+' 
AND COALESCE(c.doc_notused,'-') = '-' 
AND ( EXISTS(select 'XX' FROM r5install WHERE ins_code ='COVDURUP' AND COALESCE(ins_desc,'X')='+')  
OR ( COALESCE(doc_duration, 0) >0 AND EXISTS(select 'XX' FROM r5install WHERE ins_code ='COVDURUP' AND COALESCE(ins_desc,'X')='-')))

FROM r5descriptions d , r5userorganization u, r5documents c, r5tabpermissions
WHERE d.des_rentity='DOCU'
AND d.des_lang=:parameter.language
AND d.des_code = c.doc_code
AND c.doc_warranty='+'
AND COALESCE(c.doc_notused,'-') = '-'
AND u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND d.des_org = c.doc_org
AND c.doc_org= u.uog_org
AND u.uog_group = trp_group
AND trp_tab  = 'WTY'
AND trp_insert = '+'
AND trp_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND (u.uog_common = '+' OR  c.doc_org = (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5organization o WHERE  o.org_code = :control.org AND o.org_common = '-' ) THEN :control.org ELSE c.doc_org END))
AND ( EXISTS(select 'XX' FROM r5install WHERE ins_code ='COVDURUP' AND COALESCE(ins_desc,'X')='+')
      OR (COALESCE(doc_duration, 0) >0 AND EXISTS(select 'XX' FROM r5install WHERE ins_code ='COVDURUP' AND COALESCE(ins_desc,'X')='-')))

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5properties, R5ADDPROPERTIES 
WHERE PRO_CODE=APR_PROPERTY
AND APR_RENTITY= 
(SELECT FUN_RENTITY FROM R5FUNCTIONS WHERE FUN_CODE=:param.funccode) 
and not exists (select 'x' from r5wspromptfields where wsf_wspmtcode=:param.wspromptcode
and wsf_processgroup=:param.groupnum and wsf_Field=PRO_CODE)
and coalesce(:param.tabcode,'HDR')='HDR'

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:

FROM
 (
 	 SELECT dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'UCOD', dae_entity ,'ENTP', '') entitydesc, dae_code, dae_rentity,
	 (CASE WHEN charindex( '#', dae_code )<1 
		THEN dae_code else SUBSTRING(dae_code,1,charindex( '#', dae_code )-1) 
	 END) keyfield1,
	(CASE WHEN charindex( '#', dae_code ) > 0 THEN
		 CASE WHEN charindex('#', SUBSTRING(dae_code, charindex( '#', dae_code ) + 1, LEN(dae_code))) > 0
		     THEN
			 	SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(dae_code, charindex( '#', dae_code ) +1, LEN(dae_code)), 1, charindex('#', SUBSTRING(dae_code, charindex( '#', dae_code ) + 1, LEN(dae_code)))-1)
		     ELSE
			 	SUBSTRING(dae_code, charindex( '#', dae_code ) + 1, LEN(dae_code)) 
		     END		
	END) keyfield2,
	(CASE WHEN charindex('#', SUBSTRING(dae_code, charindex( '#', dae_code ) + 1, LEN(dae_code))) > 0 
		THEN SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING(dae_code, charindex( '#', dae_code ) + 1, LEN(dae_code)), charindex('#', SUBSTRING(dae_code, charindex( '#', dae_code ) + 1, LEN(dae_code))) +1, len(dae_code))
	END) keyfield3,
	(CASE WHEN dae_rentity IN ( 'MATL', 'PPM', 'ROUT', 'TASK') THEN
			dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,dae_rentity, (CASE WHEN charindex( '#', dae_code )< 1 THEN dae_code else SUBSTRING(dae_code,1,charindex( '#', dae_code )-1) END) ,'','')
		  WHEN dae_rentity IN ( 'MPAT', 'PREQ') THEN
dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language, dae_rentity, REVERSE(SUBSTRING(REVERSE(dae_code), charindex( '#', REVERSE(dae_code)) + 1, len(dae_code))) ,'','')
		  WHEN dae_rentity ='STOC' THEN
		    dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,'PART', REVERSE(SUBSTRING(REVERSE(dae_code), charindex( '#', REVERSE(dae_code)) + 1, len(dae_code))) ,'','')
	      ELSE
	      	dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc(:parameter.language,dae_rentity, dae_code ,'','')
	 END) codedescription
	FROM r5docentities
	WHERE dae_document = :param.documentcode
) t
WHERE 1 = 1

rows.GRD_DESC: Where Used Grid for Equipment Configuration
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from   r5objects, r5equipconfigstructures s
where  obj_code = ecs_parent
and    obj_org = ecs_parent_org
and    s.ecs_sqlidentity in (
  select s.ecs_sqlidentity
  from   r5objects o1, r5equipconfigstructures s
  where  o1.obj_code		= ecs_child
  and    o1.obj_org			= ecs_child_org
  and    ecs_child			= :parameter.objectcode
  and    ecs_child_org		= :parameter.organization
  and    o1.obj_configrstatus 	<> 'U'
  union
  select s.ecs_sqlidentity
  from   r5objects o2, r5equipconfigstructures s, r5objects o1
  where  ecs_child			= o2.obj_code
  and    ecs_child_org		= o2.obj_org 
  and    ecs_useapprovedrev	= '+'
  and    o1.obj_configcode	= o2.obj_configcode
  and    o1.obj_org			= o2.obj_org
  and    o1.obj_code			= :parameter.objectcode
  and    o1.obj_org			= :parameter.organization
  and    o1.obj_configrstatus = 'U' )

from (
select esf_code, esf_pk pk, esf_precaution precaution, esf_precaution_org precautionorg, pca_revision precautionrevision, esf_rentity entity,
(CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('#', esf_code)<1 then esf_code else SUBSTRING(esf_code,1,CHARINDEX('#',esf_code)-1) end) code,
(CASE WHEN esf_rentity ='PPM' then SUBSTRING(esf_code,CHARINDEX('#', esf_code)+1,len(esf_code)) else null end) revision,
esf_timing timing, esf_sequence sequence, esf_applytochildren applytochildren, esf_deletepending deletepending,
esf_healthhazard healthhazard, esf_flammability flammability, esf_instability instability,esf_specialhazards specialhazards,
esf_updatedby updatedby, esf_updated dateupdated, esf_reviewed reviewed,esf_reviewedby reviewedby,
esf_reviewedname reviewedname, esf_reviewedtype reviewedtype, esf_reviewtrigger reviewtrigger
from r5hazards, r5entitysafety, r5precautions
where haz_code = esf_hazard
and haz_org = esf_hazard_org
and haz_rstatus IN ( 'A', 'U' )
and haz_revision = :param.revision
and haz_code = :param.hazardcode
and haz_org = :param.organization
and pca_code = esf_precaution
and pca_org = esf_precaution_org
and pca_rstatus = 'A'
union
select ksf_code, ksf_pk pk, ksf_precaution precaution, ksf_precaution_org precautionorg, ksf_precautionrev precautionrevision, ksf_rentity entity, ksf_code code,
null revision,
ksf_timing timing, ksf_sequence sequence, COALESCE(null, '-')  applytochildren, ksf_deletepending deletepending,
ksf_healthhazard healthhazard, ksf_flammability flammability, ksf_instability instability,ksf_specialhazards specialhazards,
ksf_updatedby updatedby, ksf_updated dateupdated, ksf_reviewed reviewed,ksf_reviewedby reviewedby,
ksf_reviewedname reviewedname, ksf_reviewedtype reviewedtype, null reviewtrigger
from r5hazards, r5worksafety, r5precautions
where haz_code = ksf_hazard
and haz_org = ksf_hazard_org
and haz_revision = ksf_hazardrev
and haz_revision = :param.revision
and haz_code = :param.hazardcode
and haz_org = :param.organization
and pca_code = ksf_precaution
and pca_org = ksf_precaution_org
and pca_rstatus = 'A'
) t, r5descriptions d1, r5descriptions d2, r5userorganization, r5tabpermissions
WHERE uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND uog_org = d2.des_org
AND trp_group = uog_group
AND trp_function = 'WSHZRD'
AND trp_tab = 'WUG'
AND trp_select = '?'
AND d1.des_rentity = 'RCOD'
AND d1.des_rtype = 'ENTP'
AND d1.des_code = t.entity
AND d1.des_lang =  :parameter.language
AND d2.des_rentity = t.entity
AND d2.des_code = t.code
AND d2.des_lang =   :parameter.language
AND ( (t.entity IN ('OBJ','PART','LOC') AND CHARINDEX('#',t.esf_code) > 0  AND SUBSTRING( t.esf_code, CHARINDEX('#', t.esf_code) + 1,  len(t.esf_code)) = d2.des_org )
OR
      ( t.entity NOT IN ('OBJ','PART','LOC') OR CHARINDEX('#',t.esf_code) = 0 ))

FROM r5functions, r5boilertexts a LEFT OUTER JOIN r5boilertexts b 
ON a.bot_function=b.bot_function AND a.bot_lang=b.bot_lang 
AND b.bot_fld1 = ( CASE WHEN CHARINDEX ('_', a.bot_fld1) = 4 THEN SUBSTRING (a.bot_fld1, 1, 3) ELSE NULL END )

(

FROM
    (SELECT epa_part epapart, epa_part_org epapartorg, (CASE WHEN charindex('#',epa_code)<1 THEN CASE when epa_rentity='WKSP' THEN (SELECT wks_code FROM r5workspaces WHERE wks_pk = epa_code) ELSE epa_code END ELSE substring(epa_code,1,charindex('#',epa_code)-1) END) epacode, (CASE WHEN epa_rentity ='EVNT' THEN (SELECT evt_org FROM r5events WHERE evt_code = epa_code) WHEN epa_rentity='WKSP' THEN (SELECT wks_org FROM r5workspaces WHERE wks_pk = epa_code) ELSE substring(epa_code,charindex('#',epa_code)+1,len(epa_code)) END) epaorg, NULL epartype, NULL epatype, epa_qty epaquantity, epa_rentity eparentity, epa_comment epacomment, epa_code epaactualcode, epa_pk, epa_partlocation, epa_asmlevel, epa_syslevel, epa_complevel, '-' fromcategory
FROM r5entityparts, r5parts

AND epa_part_org = par_org

AND epa_part = :partcode
AND epa_part_org = :partorg
AND epa_part = par_code
AND epa_part_org = par_org
AND epa_code = obj_category

  FROM r5entityparts a
  WHERE a.epa_part = e.epa_part
  AND a.epa_part_org = e.epa_part_org
  AND a.epa_code = obj_code+'#'+obj_org
  AND a.epa_rentity='OBJ')
UNION
SELECT e.epa_part, e.epa_part_org, o.obj_code epacode, o.obj_org epaorg, (CASE WHEN o.obj_obrtype ='I' OR o.obj_obrtype ='C' THEN NULL ELSE o.obj_obrtype END) epartype, (CASE WHEN o.obj_obrtype ='I' OR o.obj_obrtype ='C' THEN NULL ELSE o.obj_obtype END) epatype, e.epa_qty epaquantity, (CASE WHEN o.obj_obrtype = 'I' AND o.obj_configcode IS NOT NULL THEN 'EQCF' WHEN o.obj_obrtype ='I' THEN 'OBJI' WHEN o.obj_obrtype ='C' THEN 'CATG' ELSE 'OBJ' END) eparentity, e.epa_comment epacomment, epa_code epaactualcode, epa_pk, epa_partlocation, epa_asmlevel, epa_syslevel, epa_complevel, CASE WHEN obj_code <> epa_code AND charindex('#',epa_code)<1 THEN '+' ELSE '-' END fromcategory
FROM r5objects o, r5entityparts e, r5parts
WHERE epa_rentity = 'OBJ'
AND epa_part = :partcode
AND epa_part_org = :partorg
AND epa_part = par_code
AND epa_part_org = par_org
AND obj_code = SUBSTRING( epa_code, 1, CASE WHEN charindex( '#', epa_code ) = 0 THEN 1000 ELSE CHARINDEX( '#', epa_code ) - 1 END )
AND obj_org = CASE WHEN CHARINDEX( '#', epa_code ) = 0 THEN obj_org ELSE SUBSTRING( epa_code, CHARINDEX( '#', epa_code ) + 1, 1000 ) END ) t
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5parts ON t.epapart = par_code AND t.epapartorg = par_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects ON t.epacode = obj_code AND t.epaorg = obj_org
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5codestructure ON epa_syslevel = csr_strlevel1 AND coalesce(epa_asmlevel, '-') = coalesce(csr_strlevel2, '-') AND coalesce(epa_complevel, '-') = coalesce(csr_strlevel3, '-') AND csr_rentity = 'ACT',

rows.GRD_DESC: Work Order Activity lookup with deptsec, to bypass set param
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5events e, r5activities a
WHERE e.evt_rstatus = 'R' 
AND       a.act_event = e.evt_code
AND       a.act_hire = '+'
AND       COALESCE( act_defermaintenance, '-' ) = '-' 
AND       (a.act_event = :parameter.event OR :parameter.event IS NULL)
AND       (a.act_act = :parameter.act OR :parameter.act IS NULL)
AND       ( a.act_order IS NULL AND a.act_req IS NULL )
AND       ISNULL( ( CASE a.act_supplier WHEN '*' THEN ( CASE a.act_supplier_org WHEN '*' THEN NULL ELSE a.act_supplier END ) ELSE a.act_supplier END ), :parameter.suppliercode ) = :parameter.suppliercode
AND       ISNULL( ( CASE a.act_supplier_org WHEN '*' THEN ( CASE a.act_supplier WHEN '*' THEN NULL ELSE a.act_supplier_org END ) ELSE a.act_supplier_org END ), :parameter.supplierorganization ) = :parameter.supplierorganization
AND       e.evt_rtype IN ( 'JOB', 'PPM' ) 
AND      NOT EXISTS ( select 1 from r5ucodes where uco_rcode ='MEC' and uco_rentity ='JBTP' and e.evt_jobtype = uco_code  ) 
AND       ((e.evt_project IS NOT NULL
AND       'x' IN ( SELECT 'x' FROM  r5projauthuser
                            WHERE  pau_project = e.evt_project
                            AND    pau_user    = :parameter.r5user
                          UNION  
                          SELECT 'x' FROM   dual
                            WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' FROM r5projauthuser WHERE  pau_project = e.evt_project )))
OR      e.evt_project IS NULL) AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR 
(evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))
AND   a.act_act > 0

AND       (a.act_event = :parameter.event OR :parameter.event IS NULL)
AND       (a.act_act = :parameter.act OR :parameter.act IS NULL)
AND       ( a.act_order IS NULL AND a.act_req IS NULL )
AND       ISNULL( ( CASE a.act_supplier WHEN '*' THEN ( CASE a.act_supplier_org WHEN '*' THEN NULL ELSE a.act_supplier END ) ELSE a.act_supplier END ), :parameter.suppliercode ) = :parameter.suppliercode
AND       ISNULL( ( CASE a.act_supplier_org WHEN '*' THEN ( CASE a.act_supplier WHEN '*' THEN NULL ELSE a.act_supplier_org END ) ELSE a.act_supplier_org END ), :parameter.supplierorganization ) = :parameter.supplierorganization
AND       e.evt_org  = :control.org

AND       'x' IN ( SELECT 'x' FROM  r5projauthuser

rows.GRD_DESC: Work Order Lookup for BCHWO Closing Details with deptsec, to bypass set param
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5events e 
WHERE e.evt_rtype IN ('JOB', 'PPM') 
AND exists 
    ( SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes u  
      WHERE u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP' 
      and u.uco_code = e.evt_jobtype 
      AND u.uco_rcode IN ( '*', 'BR','CAL','MEC','PM','RP','ST') 
    ) 
AND e.evt_rstatus in ('R','C','Q') AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR 
(evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5events e
WHERE e.evt_rtype IN ('JOB', 'PPM')
AND exists
    ( SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes u
      WHERE u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'
      and u.uco_code = e.evt_jobtype
      AND u.uco_rcode IN ( '*', 'BR','CAL','MEC','PM','RP','ST')
    )
AND e.evt_rstatus in ('R','C','Q')
AND exists
    ( SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization
      WHERE uog_user = :parameter.r5user
      AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role
      AND uog_org =e.evt_org
    ) AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR
(evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))

from r5descriptions d, r5ucodes u, r5events e  where d.des_rentity = 'EVNT' and d.des_lang = :parameter.language  and d.des_code = e.evt_code  and e.evt_rstatus = 'R'  and u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP' and u.uco_rcode ='RP' and u.uco_code = e.evt_jobtype      and e.evt_org = :control.org      and e.evt_code in ( select jbl_event  from r5joblines  where (jbl_active = '+' OR ISNULL(jbl_completedqty,0) <
> ISNULL( jbl_recvqty, 0 ) + ISNULL( jbl_scrapqty, 0 ) + ISNULL(dbo.o7getrrqty(jbl_event, jbl_part, jbl_part_org),0)) and jbl_completedqty > 0  and jbl_qty > ISNULL( jbl_recvqty, 0 ) + ISNULL( jbl_scrapqty, 0 ) + ISNULL(dbo.o7getrrqty(jbl_event, jbl_part, jbl_part_org) ,0)) AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR  (evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))

rows.GRD_DESC: Work Order Lookup of all status with deptsec
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5descriptions d, r5objects o, r5events e where d.des_rentity = 'EVNT' and d.des_lang =:parameter.language and  e.evt_rtype IN ( 'JOB', 'PPM' )  and d.des_code = e.evt_code and evt_object=isnull(:parameter.object,evt_object) and o.obj_code =e.evt_object and o.obj_org = e.evt_object_org AND (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR 
(evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-') AND o.obj_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = o.obj_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-')))
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
from r5events e, r5objects o, r5userorganization u, r5descriptions d where d.des_rentity = 'EVNT' and d.des_lang = :parameter.language and e.evt_object=isnull(:parameter.object,e.evt_object) and  e.evt_rtype IN ( 'JOB', 'PPM' )  and e.evt_code = d.des_code and e.evt_org = d.des_org and e.evt_org = u.uog_org and u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user and u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role and u.uog_org = :control.org and o.obj_code =e.evt_object and o.obj_org = e.evt_object_org AND (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR
(evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-') AND o.obj_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = o.obj_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-')))

rows.GRD_DESC: Work Order Lookup on Supplier Return
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5events e 
WHERE  e.evt_code IN ( SELECT o.orl_event FROM r5orderlines o                                                WHERE o.orl_order = :purchaseordercode 
AND o.orl_order_org = :purchaseorderorganization
AND o.orl_rtype = 'PD' ) 
AND ((EVT_TYPE='JOB' AND EVT_JOBTYPE='IS') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5install i  WHERE  i.ins_code = 'WOCLPOUT' AND  ( i.ins_desc = 'YES'  OR ( i.ins_desc <> 'YES' and e.evt_rstatus <> 'C'))))
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5events e,  r5userorganization u
WHERE e.evt_code IN
              ( SELECT o.orl_event FROM r5orderlines o
                 WHERE o.orl_order = :purchaseordercode
                       AND o.orl_order_org = :purchaseorderorganization
                       AND o.orl_rtype = 'PD' )
    AND e.evt_org = u.uog_org
    AND u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
    AND u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
    AND u.uog_org = :control.org
    AND ((EVT_TYPE='JOB' AND EVT_JOBTYPE='IS') OR EXISTS
                 (SELECT 1 FROM r5install i
                  WHERE  i.ins_code = 'WOCLPOUT'
                         AND  ( i.ins_desc = 'YES'  OR ( i.ins_desc <> 'YES' and e.evt_rstatus <> 'C'))))

rows.GRD_DESC: Work Order Lookup on Supplier Return with deptsec, to bypass set param
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5events e LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events e2 ON (e.evt_parent = e2.evt_code ), r5orderlines o LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events e3 ON e3.evt_code =o.orl_relatedwo, r5boilertexts b1, r5boilertexts b2
WHERE o.orl_order =:purchaseordercode
AND    o.orl_order_org =  :purchaseorderorganization
AND    e.evt_code = o.orl_event
AND    b1.bot_function =  'LVMECO'
AND    b1.bot_fld1 = 'WOHEADEREQUIPMENT'
AND    b1.bot_lang =:parameter.language
AND    b2.bot_function =  'LVMECO'
AND    b2.bot_fld1 = 'ALLEQUIPMENT'
AND    b2.bot_lang =:parameter.language
AND    o.orl_rtype = 'PD'
AND   ((e.evt_rtype='JOB' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes where uco_rentity ='JBTP' AND uco_rcode='IS' and uco_code= e.evt_jobtype)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5install i  WHERE  i.ins_code = 'WOCLPOUT' AND  ( i.ins_desc = 'YES'  OR ( i.ins_desc <> 'YES' and e.evt_rstatus <> 'C')))) AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR 
(e.evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = e.evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5events e LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events e2 ON (e.evt_parent = e2.evt_code ), r5orderlines o LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events e3 ON e3.evt_code =o.orl_relatedwo, r5boilertexts b1, r5boilertexts b2, r5userorganization u
WHERE o.orl_order =:purchaseordercode
AND    o.orl_order_org =  :purchaseorderorganization
AND    e.evt_code = o.orl_event
AND    b1.bot_function =  'LVMECO'
AND    b1.bot_fld1 = 'WOHEADEREQUIPMENT'
AND    b1.bot_lang =:parameter.language
AND    b2.bot_function =  'LVMECO'
AND    b2.bot_fld1 = 'ALLEQUIPMENT'
AND    b2.bot_lang =:parameter.language
AND    o.orl_rtype = 'PD'
AND    e.evt_org = u.uog_org
AND    u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND    u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND    u.uog_org = :control.org
AND   ((e.evt_rtype='JOB' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes where uco_rentity ='JBTP' AND uco_rcode='IS' and uco_code= e.evt_jobtype)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5install i  WHERE  i.ins_code = 'WOCLPOUT' AND  ( i.ins_desc = 'YES'  OR ( i.ins_desc <> 'YES' and e.evt_rstatus <> 'C')))) AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR
(e.evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = e.evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))

rows.GRD_DESC: Work Order Lookup with Resource check and deptsec, to bypass set param
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5events e
WHERE e.evt_rstatus NOT IN ('A', 'B', 'C')
AND  evt_productionrequest IS  NULL
AND  evt_prodorder IS NULL
AND  e.evt_jobtype not in (select ipw_wotype from r5intgplanwotypes)
AND  NOT EXISTS (select 'X' from r5productionrequests where prq_rstatus in ('U','A') and prq_event = e.evt_code)
AND  COALESCE(evt_multiequip, '-') = '-' 
AND  NOT EXISTS (SELECT u.uco_code FROM r5ucodes u WHERE u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'   AND u.uco_rcode = 'MEC' AND u.uco_code = e.evt_jobtype)
AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR 
(evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM  r5events e, r5userorganization uo
WHERE e.evt_org = :param.organization
AND  e.evt_rstatus NOT IN ('A', 'B', 'C')
AND  evt_productionrequest IS NULL
AND  evt_prodorder IS NULL
AND  e.evt_jobtype not in (select ipw_wotype from r5intgplanwotypes)
AND  NOT EXISTS (select 'X' from r5productionrequests where prq_rstatus in ('U','A') and prq_event = e.evt_code)
AND  COALESCE(evt_multiequip, '-') = '-'
AND  NOT EXISTS (SELECT u.uco_code FROM r5ucodes u WHERE u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP' AND u.uco_rcode = 'MEC' AND u.uco_code = e.evt_jobtype)
AND  uo.uog_org = e.evt_org
AND  uo.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND  uo.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND  (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR
(evt_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user =:parameter.r5user AND dse_mrc = evt_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, '-') = '-'))))

rows.GRD_DESC: Work Order Organization lookup on Equipment tab of PM Plan
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY: FROM r5descriptions d, r5userorganization u, r5tabpermissions t WHERE d.des_code = u.uog_org AND u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user and u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role AND d.des_rentity = 'ORG' AND d.des_lang = :parameter.language AND ( :parameter.mos = '-' or uog_common = '-' ) AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization u2 WHERE u2.uog_org = :parameter.ppmorg AND u2.uog_common = '+') OR ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization u2 WHERE u2.uog_org = :parameter.ppmorg AND u2.uog_common = '-')  AND d.des_code = :parameter.ppmorg ) ) AND u.uog_group = t.trp_group AND  t.trp_function = :parameter.userfunction AND t.trp_tab = 'EQP' and t.trp_insert = '+'

rows.GRD_DESC: Work Order Organization lookup on Equipment tab of PM Schedules
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5descriptions d, r5userorganization u, r5tabpermissions t
WHERE d.des_code = u.uog_org
AND       u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND       u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND       d.des_rentity = 'ORG'
AND       d.des_lang = :parameter.language
AND      ( :parameter.mos = '-' or uog_common = '-' )
AND      ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization u2 WHERE u2.uog_org = :parameter.ppmorg AND u2.uog_common = '+')
      OR  ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5userorganization u2 WHERE u2.uog_org = :parameter.ppmorg AND u2.uog_common = '-')  AND d.des_code = :parameter.ppmorg ) )
AND        u.uog_group = t.trp_group
AND        t.trp_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND        t.trp_tab = 'PPO'
and         t.trp_insert = '+'

rows.GRD_DESC: Work Order Own Labor Cost (Default Currency)
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY: from r5dwwocostdailysnap right outer join r5dwdates on (zdt_key = zwt_datekey ) left outer join r5dwworkorders on (zwt_wokey = zwo_key) left outer join r5dwbudgets on (zwt_budgetkey = zbu_key) left outer join r5dworganizations on (zwt_orgkey = zor_key) left outer join r5dwobjects on (zwt_objectkey = zob_key) left outer join r5dwmrcs on (zwt_mrckey = zmr_key) where zdt_date between :parameter.startdate and :parameter.enddate  @GROUPBYCLAUSE{ group by zdt_date }

FROM r5serviceproblemcodes s left outer join r5departmentstructure d 
on  (s.spb_code = d.dps_serviceproblem AND s.spb_org  = d.dps_serviceproblem_org)
where COALESCE(d.dps_mrc, '#')  = COALESCE(:param.mrc, d.dps_mrc, '#')
AND     COALESCE(d.dps_provider, '#') =COALESCE(:param.provider,d.dps_provider, '#')
AND     COALESCE(d.dps_provider_org, '#') = COALESCE(:param.providerorg, d.dps_provider_org, '#')
AND     COALESCE(d.dps_servicecategory, '#') =COALESCE(:param.svcategory,d.dps_servicecategory, '#')
AND     COALESCE(d.dps_servicecategory_org, '#') = COALESCE(:param.svcategoryorg, d.dps_servicecategory_org, '#')
AND     s.spb_notused = '-'
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5serviceproblemcodes s left outer join r5departmentstructure d
on  (s.spb_code = d.dps_serviceproblem AND s.spb_org  = d.dps_serviceproblem_org)
where COALESCE(d.dps_mrc, '#')  = COALESCE(:param.mrc, d.dps_mrc, '#')
AND     COALESCE(d.dps_provider, '#') =COALESCE(:param.provider,d.dps_provider, '#')
AND     COALESCE(d.dps_provider_org, '#') = COALESCE(:param.providerorg, d.dps_provider_org, '#')
AND     COALESCE(d.dps_servicecategory, '#') =COALESCE(:param.svcategory,d.dps_servicecategory, '#')
AND     COALESCE(d.dps_servicecategory_org, '#') = COALESCE(:param.svcategoryorg, d.dps_servicecategory_org, '#')
AND     s.spb_notused = '-'
AND     EXISTS (SELECT NULL FROM r5userorganization WHERE  uog_org  = s.spb_org AND    uog_user = :parameter.r5user AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND     (s.spb_org =   (CASE WHEN EXISTS
                                        (SELECT 1 FROM r5organization o WHERE  o.org_code = :control.org AND o.org_common = '-' )
                                        THEN :control.org ELSE s.spb_org END)
              OR    uog_common = '+')
)

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5pscategories p left outer join r5departmentstructure d 
on (p.psc_code = d.dps_provider AND p.psc_org  = d.dps_provider_org )
where COALESCE(d.dps_mrc, '#')  = COALESCE(:param.mrc, d.dps_mrc, '#')
AND     p.psc_rtype = 'PD'  
AND     p.psc_notused = '-'
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5pscategories p left outer join r5departmentstructure d
on (p.psc_code = d.dps_provider AND p.psc_org  = d.dps_provider_org )
where COALESCE(d.dps_mrc, '#')  = COALESCE(:param.mrc, d.dps_mrc, '#')
AND     p.psc_rtype = 'PD'
AND     p.psc_notused = '-'
AND     EXISTS (SELECT NULL FROM r5userorganization
 WHERE  uog_org  = psc_org AND    uog_user = :parameter.r5user AND uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND     (psc_org =   (CASE WHEN EXISTS
                                        (SELECT 1 FROM r5organization o WHERE  o.org_code = :control.org AND o.org_common = '-' )
                                        THEN :control.org ELSE psc_org END)
              OR    uog_common = '+')
)

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5organizationoptions, r5activities, r5events, r5worepairs  
WHERE evt_code = act_event   
AND act_event = wor_event
AND act_act = wor_act

 AND (act_seq = :param.headerjob OR :param.headerjob = 0)

from r5dwwoaccumsnap right outer join r5dwschedcompdates on (zvd_schcompkey = zws_schedcompdatekey) left outer join r5dwworkorders on (zws_wokey = zwo_key)left outer join r5dworganizations on (zws_orgkey = zor_key) left outer join r5dwmrcs on (zws_mrckey = zmr_key) left outer join r5dwobjects on (zws_objectkey = zob_key) left outer join r5dwservicerequests on (zws_srkey = zsr_key ) where zvd_schcompdate between :parameter.startdate and :parameter.enddate @GROUPBYCLAUSE{ group by zvd_schcompdate }

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5pscategories p LEFT OUTER JOIN r5departmentstructure d
ON ( p.psc_code = d.dps_servicecategory AND p.psc_org  = d.dps_servicecategory_org)
WHERE COALESCE(d.dps_mrc, '#')  = COALESCE(:param.mrc, d.dps_mrc, '#')
AND     COALESCE(d.dps_provider, '#') =COALESCE(:param.provider, d.dps_provider, '#')

AND (exists (select 'x'
                 from   r5install I
                 where  i.ins_code = 'JTAUTH'
                 and    upper( i.ins_desc ) not in ( 'YES', '+' ) )
       or exists (select 'x'
               from   r5jobtypeauth j
               where  j.jta_jobtype = e.evt_jobtype
               and    j.jta_status  = e.evt_status

                                                           from   r5userorganization

                                                           and    uog_role = :parameter.r5role )))
       or (exists (select 'x'
               from   r5jobtypeauth j
               where  j.jta_jobtype = e.evt_jobtype
               and    j.jta_status  = 'ALLSTATS'
               and    j.jta_update = '+'
               and    (j.jta_group= '*' or j.jta_group in (select uog_group
                                                             from   r5userorganization
                                                             where  uog_user = :parameter.r5user
                                                             and uog_role = :parameter.r5role )))

                        from   r5jobtypeauth j

                        and    j.jta_status  = e.evt_status
                        and    (j.jta_group= '*' or j.jta_group in (select uog_group

 AND (:param.bypassdeptsecurity = 'true' OR (:parameter.deptsec ='OFF' OR

			  FROM (SELECT rea_object,

SELECT <FIELDLIST_1>
FROM r5events e
WHERE  exists 
( SELECT 1 FROM r5ucodes u 
WHERE u.uco_rentity = 'JBTP'  
and u.uco_code=e.evt_jobtype 
AND u.uco_rcode IN ( '*', 'BR', 'ST' ,'PM') ) 
AND e.evt_rstatus <> 'C'
AND e.evt_rtype IN ('JOB', 'PPM') 
AND e.evt_person IN (SELECT per_code FROM r5personnel p
WHERE p.per_user=:parameter.r5user)
<FILTER_1> 
UNION
SELECT <FIELDLIST_2>
FROM r5requisitions 
WHERE ( req_rstatus='R'  OR req_rstatus='U' )  
AND req_rtype='RECV'
AND EXISTS (SELECT NULL FROM r5requislines WHERE rql_req=req_code)  
AND exists 
(SELECT NULL FROM r5auth a 
WHERE a.aut_rentity = 'REQ' 
AND a.aut_type = '+' 
AND ( a.aut_user  = :parameter.r5user OR (a.aut_group = (SELECT usr_group  FROM   r5users  WHERE  usr_code=:parameter.r5user) AND a.aut_user = '*' )) AND   a.aut_status = req_status AND   a.aut_statnew  IN (SELECT uco_code FROM   r5ucodes WHERE  uco_rentity='RQST' AND    uco_rcode IN ('C', 'A','J')))
AND req_dfltauth = :parameter.r5user
<FILTER_2> 
UNION
SELECT <FIELDLIST_3> 
from r5servicerequests s LEFT OUTER JOIN r5debtors d ON ( s.srq_customer = d.deb_code )
where srq_rstatus not in ('CLOS', 'CANC')
AND s.srq_assignedto IN (SELECT per_code FROM r5personnel p
WHERE p.per_user=:parameter.r5user)
<FILTER_3>
<SORT_BY>

rows.GRD_DESC: inbox for the new start center
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM R5HOME
LEFT OUTER JOIN R5HOMEUSERS ON (HMU_HOMCODE = HOM_CODE AND HMU_HOMTYPE = HOM_TYPE)
LEFT OUTER JOIN R5USERS ON USR_CODE = HMU_USER
LEFT OUTER JOIN R5FUNCTIONS ON FUN_CODE = HOM_EWSFUNCTION
LEFT OUTER JOIN R5KPISCORES ON (
  KPS_HOMCODE = HOM_CODE AND
  KPS_HOMTYPE = HOM_TYPE AND 
  KPS_LOWVALUE <= dbo.O7runinboxquery(HOM_SQLCODE,HMU_AUTOFRESH,HMU_USER,USR_GROUP,:parameter.deforg,:parameter.organization,:param.manufresh) AND 
  KPS_HIGHVALUE >= dbo.O7runinboxquery(HOM_SQLCODE,HMU_AUTOFRESH,HMU_USER,USR_GROUP,:parameter.deforg,:parameter.organization,:param.manufresh)
)
WHERE
  HMU_USER = :parameter.r5user AND
  HOM_TYPE = '-' AND
  ISNULL(HMU_TAB,'OPER') = :param.inboxtab AND
  (
    HOM_OPERATOR IS NULL OR HOM_VALUE IS NULL OR
    (HOM_OPERATOR = '>'  and dbo.O7runinboxquery(HOM_SQLCODE,HMU_AUTOFRESH,HMU_USER,USR_GROUP,:parameter.deforg,:parameter.organization,:param.manufresh) <= HOM_VALUE) OR
    (HOM_OPERATOR = '<'  and dbo.O7runinboxquery(HOM_SQLCODE,HMU_AUTOFRESH,HMU_USER,USR_GROUP,:parameter.deforg,:parameter.organization,:param.manufresh) >= HOM_VALUE) OR
    (HOM_OPERATOR = '>=' and dbo.O7runinboxquery(HOM_SQLCODE,HMU_AUTOFRESH,HMU_USER,USR_GROUP,:parameter.deforg,:parameter.organization,:param.manufresh) < HOM_VALUE) OR
    (HOM_OPERATOR = '<=' and dbo.O7runinboxquery(HOM_SQLCODE,HMU_AUTOFRESH,HMU_USER,USR_GROUP,:parameter.deforg,:parameter.organization,:param.manufresh) > HOM_VALUE) OR
    (HOM_OPERATOR = '='  and dbo.O7runinboxquery(HOM_SQLCODE,HMU_AUTOFRESH,HMU_USER,USR_GROUP,:parameter.deforg,:parameter.organization,:param.manufresh) != HOM_VALUE) OR
    (HOM_OPERATOR = '<>' and dbo.O7runinboxquery(HOM_SQLCODE,HMU_AUTOFRESH,HMU_USER,USR_GROUP,:parameter.deforg,:parameter.organization,:param.manufresh) = HOM_VALUE)
  )

from r5parts, r5ucodes,  r5activities
LEFT OUTER JOIN r5tasks ON(tsk_code = act_task AND tsk_revision = act_taskrev) ,
(SELECT TRL_EVENT,TRL_ACT,TRL_PART,TRL_PART_ORG,TRL_STORE,TRL_LINE, 
TRL_DIRECT,TRL_MATLIST,TRL_MATLISTREV FROM r5workorderpartsummary 
where trl_event = :param.workordernum UNION 
SELECT coalesce(e.evt_routeparent,l.trl_event),l.trl_act,l.trl_part,l.trl_part_org,l.trl_store,0 line,
case when trl_rtype = 'RECV' then '+' when trl_rtype = 'RR' then '-' when trl_rtype = 'I' then (case when trl_io = 0 then '+' else '-' end) 
end direct,cast(null as nvarchar) matlist,cast(null as numeric) matlistrev 
FROM r5transactions t,r5translines l,r5events e WHERE l.trl_trans = t.tra_code AND t.tra_torentity = N'EVNT' 
AND t.tra_fromrentity = CASE l.trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN N'COMP' ELSE t.tra_fromrentity END 
AND l.trl_rtype IN (N'I',N'RR',N'RECV') AND e.evt_code = l.trl_event 
AND e.evt_routeparent = :param.workordernum 
UNION  SELECT coalesce(e.evt_routeparent,l.trl_event),l.trl_act,l.trl_part,l.trl_part_org,l.trl_store,0 line,
case when trl_rtype = 'RECV' then '+' when trl_rtype = 'RR' then '-' when trl_rtype = 'I' then (case when trl_io = 0 then '+' else '-' end)
end direct,cast(null as nvarchar) matlist,cast(null as numeric) matlistrev 
FROM r5transactions t,r5translines l,r5events e WHERE l.trl_trans = t.tra_code  AND t.tra_torentity = N'EVNT' 
AND t.tra_fromrentity = CASE l.trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN N'COMP' ELSE t.tra_fromrentity END 
AND l.trl_rtype IN (N'I',N'RR',N'RECV') AND e.evt_code = l.trl_event 
AND (l.trl_event = :param.workordernum AND e.evt_routeparent is null)) x 
where act_event = trl_event and act_act = trl_act and trl_part = par_code and trl_part_org = par_org and ((trl_line != 0) or (trl_line = 0 and not exists (select 1 from r5matlparts, r5events, r5mrcs where mlp_part = trl_part and mlp_part_org = trl_part_org and mlp_matlist = act_matlist and mlp_matlrev=act_matlrev and trl_event = evt_code and evt_mrc = mrc_code and trl_store = mrc_store and (( isnull(mlp_code, isnull(evt_object,N'!@#$')) = isnull(evt_object,N'!@#$')  and isnull(mlp_code_org, isnull(evt_object_org,N'!@#$')) = isnull(evt_object_org,N'!@#$')) or (mlp_obrtype = 'C' and exists (select obj_code from r5objects where  obj_code = evt_object and obj_org = evt_object_org and obj_category = mlp_code))))))
and COALESCE(tsk_enableenhancedplanning, '-') = '-'
and act_trade IS NOT NULL
and uco_code = act_planninglevel
and uco_rcode = 'TP'
and uco_rentity = 'APLL'

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG: from r5shutdowns s , r5userorganization u, r5descriptions d where  d.des_rentity = 'SHUT' and  d.des_lang = :parameter.language and s.sds_code = d.des_code and  s.sds_org = u.uog_org and u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user and u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role and  ( u.uog_common = '+' or u.uog_org = :control.org )

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
from r5descriptions d, r5ucodes u
where d.des_rentity = 'UCOD'
and d.des_rtype = 'ESTP'
and u.uco_rentity = d.des_rtype
and u.uco_code = d.des_code
and d.des_lang = :parameter.language

from r5descriptions d, r5userorganization u, r5organization o
WHERE d.des_code = u.uog_org
AND        u.uog_org = o.org_code
AND        d.des_rentity = 'ORG'
AND        d.des_lang = :parameter.language
AND        u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND        u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND        COALESCE(uog_common,'-') = '-'
AND        o.org_accountingentity IS NOT NULL

rows.GRD_DESC: supplier catalogue reference LOV in PO Lines
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
FROM r5descriptions d, r5parts p ,r5catalogue c
WHERE d.des_org = p.par_org 
AND d.des_code = p.par_code 
AND p.par_notused = '-' 
AND d.des_rentity = 'PART' 
AND d.des_lang = :parameter.language
AND c.cat_ref IS NOT NULL
AND d.des_code = c.cat_part
AND d.des_org = c.cat_part_org
AND c.cat_supplier = :param.supplier 
AND c.cat_supplier_org = :param.supplierorg
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:
FROM r5userorganization u, r5descriptions d, r5parts p ,r5catalogue c
WHERE d.des_org = p.par_org
AND d.des_code = p.par_code
AND p.par_notused = '-'
AND d.des_rentity = 'PART'
AND d.des_lang = :parameter.language
AND p.par_org = u.uog_org
AND u.uog_user = :parameter.r5user
AND u.uog_role = :parameter.r5role
AND ( u.uog_common = '+'
or u.uog_org = :control.org )
AND c.cat_ref IS NOT NULL
AND d.des_code = c.cat_part
AND d.des_org = c.cat_part_org
AND c.cat_supplier = :param.supplier
AND c.cat_supplier_org = :param.supplierorg

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY: FROM r5descriptions WHERE des_rentity = 'OBJ' AND des_rtype = 'S' AND  des_lang = :parameter.language
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY_MULTIORG:

rows.GRD_DESC: table lookup for e-mail notification setup

rows.GRD_BASEQUERY:
SELECT <FIELDLIST_1>
FROM r5tasktrades,r5tabpermissions
WHERE tat_task = :param.task
                AND tat_revision = :param.revision
                AND :param.headerjobplan IS NULL
                AND trp_tab = 'TAT'
                AND trp_select = '?'
                AND trp_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5users WHERE usr_code = :parameter.r5user AND trp_group = usr_group)                
<FILTER_1>
UNION
SELECT <FIELDLIST_2>
FROM r5tasktrades,r5taskplanjobs,r5tasks,r5descriptions,r5tabpermissions
WHERE tpj_task = :param.task
                AND tpj_taskrev = :param.revision
                AND tat_task = tpj_jobplan
                AND des_code = tpj_jobplan
                AND des_rentity = 'JBPL'
                AND des_lang = :parameter.language
                AND CONVERT(VARCHAR, tpj_seq)+'#'+tpj_jobplan = CASE WHEN 'TAT_SHOWALLRECORDS' = :param.headerjobplan THEN CONVERT(VARCHAR, tpj_seq)+'#'+tpj_jobplan
                                ELSE :param.headerjobplan END
                AND tat_revision = (SELECT MAX(t.tsk_revision) FROM r5tasks t  WHERE t.tsk_code = tpj_jobplan  AND 'A' = CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.tsk_reusable, '+') = '+' OR (COALESCE(t.tsk_reusable, '+') = '-' AND :param.taskplanrstatus = 'A') THEN t.tsk_revrstatus ELSE 'A' END) 
   	    AND (COALESCE(tsk_reusable, '+') = '+' OR (COALESCE(tsk_reusable, '+') = '-' AND :param.taskplanrstatus not in ('C','J','S')))
                AND tsk_code = tat_task
                AND tsk_revision = tat_revision
                AND trp_tab = 'TAT'
                AND trp_select = '?'
                AND trp_function = :parameter.userfunction
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5users WHERE usr_code = :parameter.r5user AND trp_group = usr_group)
<FILTER_2>
<SORT_BY>

from r5descriptions d where d.des_rentity = 'UCOD' and d.des_rtype in (select e.ent_statent from r5entities e where e.ent_table = :parameter.maatable) and d.des_rtype not in ('IPST', 'ERST', 'NIST', 'LOST', 'VHST', '*','AAST') and d.des_lang =:parameter.language and des_code != isnull(:parameter.fromstatus,' ')

rows.GRD_DESC: used in supplier returns listview to list all reference numbers.
rows.GRD_BASEQUERY: from r5transactions, r5userorganization where tra_rtype = 'RETN' and tra_advice is not null and uog_user = :parameter.r5user and uog_role = :parameter.r5role and uog_org=tra_org

SELECT <FIELDLIST_1>
FROM R5AUDVALUES , R5AUDATTRIBS 
WHERE ava_table = :param.tablename
and ava_primaryid = :param.primaryid
and aat_code = ava_attribute
and (ava_secondaryid IS NULL OR ava_secondaryid = :param.secondaryid)
and ava_table <> 'R5OBJECTS'
 <FILTER_1>  
UNION
SELECT <FIELDLIST_2>
FROM R5AUDVALUES, R5PROPERTIES
WHERE AVA_TABLE='R5PROPERTYVALUES'
and AVA_ATTRIBUTE=0
and AVA_PRIMARYID = PRO_CODE
AND (AVA_SECONDARYID =:param.cfkeys  or AVA_SECONDARYID =:param.relatedcfkeys)   
<FILTER_2>  
UNION  
SELECT <FIELDLIST_3>
FROM R5OBJECTS, R5AUDVALUES , R5AUDATTRIBS 
WHERE obj_code =  :param.primaryid
and obj_org = :param.secondaryid
and ava_table = :param.tablename
and ava_primaryid = obj_code
and ava_secondaryid = obj_org
and aat_code = ava_attribute
and ava_changed >= obj_record
and ava_table = 'R5OBJECTS'
 <FILTER_3>  
UNION
SELECT <FIELDLIST_4>
FROM R5AUDVALUES , R5AUDATTRIBS 
WHERE aat_code = ava_attribute
and ava_table = :param.tablename
and ava_table = 'R5OBJECTS'
and ava_primaryid2 = :param.primaryid
and ava_secondaryid = :param.secondaryid
 <FILTER_4>  
<SORT_BY>
from user_objects where object_name like '%'+'MA'+'%'+substring(isnull(:parameter.tablename,''),1,24)+isnull(:parameter.tenant,'')+'%'  and object_type='TRIGGER'
